   About Ping Identity:   
 At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.  
 Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.  
 While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture.  We champion every identity.  One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.  
 We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.    The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for driving adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion within a defined portfolio of customers. You will act as the primary post‑sales relationship owner, orchestrating the right resources across Support, Product, Services, and Sales to ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes and view us as a strategic partner. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Customer Outcomes & Revenue 
 
 Own customer health, retention, and risk management for your portfolio, in partnership with Sales and Renewals. 
 Build, maintain, and execute customer success plans for priority accounts, with clear business outcomes, milestones, and owners. 
 Proactively identify renewal and churn risk, create save plans, and track mitigation activities. 
 Surface and qualify expansion opportunities (cross‑sell, up‑sell, use‑case expansion) and collaborate with Sales/Account Management to progress them. 
 
 2. Adoption & Value Realisation 
 
 Translate customer objectives into measurable outcomes and ensure progress is tracked and communicated. 
 Regularly review usage data, health scores, and telemetry to spot gaps, drive adoption plays, and prevent value erosion. 
 Deliver value‑focused reviews (e.g., Success Plan /EBRs), telling a clear story that connects product usage to business results. 
 
 3. Customer Engagement & Advocacy 
 
 Build and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with day‑to‑day contacts, project owners, and business sponsors. 
 Run a structured cadence of check‑ins, workshops, and governance reviews, tailored to customer segment and lifecycle stage.

title: Director, Global Equity
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - US
 

    About Faire   
 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive. 
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.    About this role  
 Faire is revolutionizing wholesale and helping local retailers and their suppliers succeed in a technology-enabled era. As a Director, Global Equity, you will own and continue to evolve Faire’s global equity programs, building on an existing foundation while enhancing the structure, rigor, and scalability required to support public company readiness. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, brings strong judgment, and wants to shape how equity operates with true end-to-end ownership. 
  As a Director, Global Equity You Will  
 
 Own and scale Faire’s global equity programs end-to-end, spanning plan design, administration, accounting, compliance, and employee experience across all equity award types and jurisdictions. 
 Serve as the senior owner of equity operations, partnering with Finance, Accounting, Payroll, Legal, and People to build durable, audit-ready processes that scale with company growth. 
 Lead public company equity responsibilities, including SEC reporting support, insider trading programs, audit readiness, and the design and operation of equity-related internal controls. 
 Oversee the full equity lifecycle, including grant issuance, vesting, exercises, releases, share pool management, and reconciliations between the equity platform and general ledger. 
 Design, implement, and optimize equity systems and workflows, including Shareworks (or equivalent) integrations with payroll, HRIS, and financial reporting systems. 
 Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for complex employee, executive, and stakeholder equity matters, exercising sound judgment and discretion. 
 Proactively manage global regulatory, tax, and compliance risk, partnering with Legal and external advisors to ensure equity programs remain compliant as Faire scales internationally.

   Be Part of Building the Future  
 Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.  Learn more at  www.dremio.com.      Thank you for your interest in Dremio! If you've found yourself here, we're guessing that means you may not have found your perfect match in our currently available opportunities just yet. That's okay! Let's keep in touch for opportunities to make waves together in the future. Let us know what areas and/or roles you're interested in and we'll let you know when an opportunity that aligns with your interests and professional experience is available.      What we value   
  At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.  
   Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.   
   Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.   
   Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click      here      to review the privacy notice.    
  Important Security Notice for Candidates  
  At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement  here .

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time.

title: Junior Customer Success Manager - Small Business
description: Notre mission   L'IA transforme déjà le fonctionnement des entreprises. Chez Modjo, nous voulons révolutionner la manière dont les équipes commerciales vendent.  Fondée à Paris en 2019, Modjo est en train de devenir le leader européen de l'IA appliquée à la vente.  Les équipes commerciales ont accès à plus de données que jamais, mais celles-ci sont dispersées entre les CRM, les e-mails, les outils de vente et les échanges avec les clients. Lorsque le contexte est fragmenté, des signaux essentiels se perdent, les pipelines ralentissent et les opportunités s'envolent.  Chez Modjo, nous développons un système d’agents IA qui comprend le contexte de chaque compte, de chaque opportunité et de chaque équipe. Nos agents aident les commerciaux à préparer leurs réunions, à gérer les objections, à exploiter pleinement les opportunités, à hiérarchiser les actions pertinentes et à faire avancer les dossiers.  Le défi n’est pas de créer un énième outil. Il s’agit de développer une IA suffisamment fiable et utile pour devenir un véritable coéquipier des équipes commerciales.  Avec une solution développée en France et des données hébergées en Europe, Modjo construit une alternative européenne souveraine en matière d’IA appliquée à la vente.  Rejoindre Modjo, c’est contribuer à redéfinir la manière dont des millions de commerciaux travailleront demain.    Pourquoi on recrute ?    Nous recherchons un ou une  Customer Success Manager 1 to Many  pour accompagner la réussite, l'adoption, la rétention et la croissance d'un portefeuille important de clients B2B grâce à une approche one-to-many scalable.  Il s'agit d'un rôle  structurant et à fort impact  : tu rejoindras l'équipe à un moment clé du développement de notre modèle de Customer Success à grande échelle et tu auras la responsabilité de l'expérience client d'environ 200 comptes.    Tes missions       Piloter l'onboarding et l'adoption à grande échelle  Onboarder les nouveaux clients à travers des kick-offs collectifs, des sessions de groupe, des webinars et un suivi structuré.  Aider les clients à identifier les cas d'usage pertinents et à tirer de la valeur des fonctionnalités clés de Modjo, notamment de ses fonctionnalités d'IA.  Identifier les clients peu engagés et concevoir des plans d'activation ciblés pour augmenter l'utilisation et l'adoption.   Piloter la rétention et la croissance grâce à la data  Suivre l'utilisation du produit, la santé des clients, les échéances de renouvellement et les autres signaux d'un portefeuille d'environ 200 clients.  Détecter rapidement les risques de churn, les situations de downsell et les opportunités d'upsell, puis construire des plans d'action clairs.  Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Account Management, Sales, Support, Product et Marketing lorsqu'une situation client nécessite une action transverse.   Être la voix du client et un ambassadeur de l'IA  Transformer les retours clients, les questions produit et les problèmes récurrents en insight

description: Description   KOMOJUについて：  KOMOJU(コモジュ)は、世界最大級のゲームプラットフォーム「Steam」やECプラットフォーム「Shopify」にも採用されている、KOMOJUが提供するオールインワン決済サービスです。直感的に理解しやすい、シンプルかつ統一的なAPIを提供することで、KOMOJUを導入するだけでクレジットカード、コンビニ決済、各種電子マネー、銀行振込、ペイジーなど複数の決済方法の利用を可能にしています。KOMOJUは今後も、様々な金融機関、決済ネットワーク、銀行、各種ウォレットと緊密な連携を行うことで、多くの国や地域、通貨、および現地の各種決済方法を選択でき、確実かつ迅速に多くの決済取引の処理を実現可能なものとしていきます。  募集背景：  事業拡大に伴い、当社の決済プラットフォームを利用する加盟店数・業種の多様性が急速に拡大しています。これまで加盟店審査業務はカスタマーサクセス部の一機能として運用してきましたが、リスク管理・コンプライアンス要件の高度化、ならびに審査件数の増加を背景に、加盟店審査部を独立した組織として運用・強化を進めています。  本ポジションでは、加盟店審査部の マネージャー ※本ポジションはマネージャーとしての採用ですが、ご経験・ご志向、および入社後の実績や適性に応じて、将来的に加盟店審査部の責任者（Head）をお任せする可能性もあります。  選考の中でHeadとしての適性を確認できた場合、Headポジションでのオファーをご相談させていただくこともあります。  Responsibilities（期待する役割）： At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal.

No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there:

  2. Build great things that help humans

  3. Demonstrate grit

  4. Never stop learning

  5. Pursue excellence

We're looking for a Senior or Staff ML Systems Engineer to join Quilter's Placer Team and build the infrastructure that moves research from prototype to production reliably and efficiently.

The Role

The Placer is responsible for automated component placement on PCBs. This role focuses on the systems and infrastructure that support the full ML lifecycle: training pipelines, data generation and cleaning, experiment management, orchestration, serving, A/B testing, and CI/CD.

You'll be building the infrastructure that moves research from prototype to production reliably and efficiently. You'll also play a key role in systems design review and long-range architectural planning as the team scales.

This is a fully distributed team. We expect high autonomy and high ownership.

  • Design, build, and maintain ML infrastructure across training, evaluation, serving, and monitoring

  • Own data pipelines including generation, cleaning, validation, and versioning

  • Build and improve experiment tracking, orchestration, and reproducibility tooling

  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and A/B testing infrastructure

  • Lead and formalize design review processes across the team

  • Identify architectural risks early and guide the team toward sustainable systems decisions

What Weʼre Looking For

  • 7+ years of industry experience building and operating ML systems in production

  • Proven track record as a key player in the success of a production-grade ML system end-to-end

  • Deep familiarity with training pipelines, serving infrastructure, and experiment management

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and systems design sensibility

title: Director of Quality Assurance
description:
At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. The Role:

As Director of Quality Assurance, you will lead our Quality function across three core areas: the quality management system, design quality assurance including software quality assurance, and supplier quality assurance including QC activities. As we approach on-market release, you will also prepare the QMS for customer facing activities including post-market surveillance and complaint handling.

This is a player-coach role: hands-on leadership rather than pure people-management. You will set direction and develop the team, but you will also write procedures, make decisions, and stay close to the product and organisation needs. You will work as a direct partner to our engineering teams and alongside our dedicated Regulatory Affairs leadership. Regulatory is not part of this role, but a function you will collaborate closely with.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership: Lead and develop our existing Quality team, instilling and maintaining a high performance culture.

title: Founding Data Analyst
description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of.

We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page.

À propos de Panora

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraime

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
description:
The question

Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

Sona's Labour AI team builds the forecasting, rules and scheduling tools that help hospitality and retail businesses get staffing right. Getting the tooling built is one problem. Getting it to actually work for a specific site, with its own trading patterns, staff and quirks, is another. That's what this role owns; working directly with customers to turn Sona's forecasting and scheduling tools into labour models that actually get used on site.

title: Palveluesihenkilöitä pääkaupunkiseudulle
description: Oletko tulosorientoitunut siivousalan osaaja, joka viihtyy vastuullisessa esihenkilötehtävässä? Langat eivät putoa käsistäsi kiireenkään keskellä? Saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö!Etsimme nyt kasvavaan joukkoomme kahta  Palveluesihenkilöä pääkaupunkiseudulle! Siivouksen esihenkilö- ja ohjaustehtävissä tulet vastaamaan asiakaskohteidemme siivouspalveluiden operatiivisesta suunnittelusta ja sujuvuudesta. Hakemamme tekijä on aidosti palveluhenkinen, asiakaslähtöinen ja viihtyy ajoittain kiireisessäkin työympäristössä organisoiden työnsä tehokkaasti - unohtamatta timanttista ongelmanratkontakykyä!  Tehtävissä menestyminen edellyttää aikaisempaa kokemusta siivousalalta, työnjohdollisista tehtävistä sekä asiakkuuksien tuloksellisesta johtamisesta. Hakemamme henkilön tulee kyetä kommunikoimaan vaivatta niin suomeksi kuin englanniksi ja aidosti viihtyä monikulttuurisessa työympäristössä.Tehtävänkuvan keskiössä ovat myös vahvat vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot sekä kyky toimia itseohjautuvassa esihenkilöroolissa - esimerkillä johtaminen ja alaisten motivoiminen ovat osa päivittäistä tekemistä. Tässä työssä tulet tarvitsemaan ajokorttia, oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Myös alan ammattitutkinnosta on sinulle etua.  Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan juuri sinulle sopivalla tavalla.RTK-Palvelu tarjoaa osaajilleen kattavan perehdytyksen ja sisäisten koulutus- ja etenemismahdollisuuksien lisäksi täyden tuen ammattitutkintojen suorittamiseen työn ohessa.Yrityksessämme vaalitaan hyvää työilmapiiriä ja auttamisen kulttuuria – tukenasi ovat osaavat kollegat ja kannustava esihenkilö.Meille on myös tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi! – vuosittaisessa työvirekyselyssä saimme työntekijäkokemuksesta erinomaisen arvosanan 4,1/5.Työsuhde solmitaan toistaiseksi voimassa olevana ja töiden aloitus on sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika tehtävissä on kokoaikainen. Palkkaus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan, aiempi kokemus- ja koulutustaustasi huomioiden. Työsuhteessa sovelletaan kiinteistöalan toimihenkilöitä koskevaa työehtosopimusta. Jos koet hyvän työyhteisön olevan sinulle merkityksellinen, viihdyt meillä varmasti! title: Operations Manager

title: Lead Business Partner / Head of Client Service
description: The Creative Store    www.thecreativestore.co.nz     Great Jobs. Great People.       This role is with an exceptional Auckland-based agency, a multi-disciplinary creative production studio. With a diverse team of talent from many disciplines, they work locally and globally with clients to create provocative ideas that live within advertising, design, entertainment, and technology.     They are looking for a Lead Business Partner / Head of Client Service to primarily lead one of the agency's most important and exciting clients, as well as drive stability and leadership of an absolutely brilliant team of Client Service talent.     This is a complex, high-profile portfolio account spanning some of New Zealand's best-known alcohol brands. The work is predominantly social-led, meaning this is a role that needs to be equally comfortable in the boardroom, on set and in the detail of a fast-moving content calendar. This isn't simply an account management role. You will be expected to think and operate like a business leader: understanding the business, shaping where you can take the relationship, spotting opportunities, challenging constructively, protecting the quality of the work and making sure every job makes commercial sense.      You will also have an important role as a senior leader within the agency. You will contribute to the vision, culture and growth of the wider agency, helping shape how they work, developing people and supporting the CEO as they continue to evolve. You will own the vision for the client service team, bringing together Strategy, Creative, Social and Production to deliver work that makes a difference for clients and prospects.      Don’t miss this opportunity to work with a globally recognised collaborative team in a forward-thinking, fast-paced and inclusive agency.      If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you, apply now.       Due to the volume of applications, we can only reply to candidates who are suitable for our current roles.       Send your CV to  Ginnaya Turner  at The Creative Store, email  Ginnaya@thecreativestore.co.nz , or call The Creative Store on (09) 365 1077 for more details.      Visit The Creative Store website www.thecreativestore.co.nz to view all our jobs online.

title: Customer Success Account Manager
description: Overview   The Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) is the primary post-sales success lead and trusted advisor for strategic enterprise customers. The purpose of the role is to connect the customer’s digital strategy with Microsoft’s technology capabilities, ensuring that deployed solutions deliver measurable business value, sustained adoption, and continuous evolution of the customer’s digital ecosystem.  The CSAM develops a deep understanding of the customer’s business objectives, technology maturity, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities across cloud, data, security, productivity, and artificial intelligence. From that vantage point, the CSAM anticipates needs, identifies risks, proposes paths to value, and orchestrates Microsoft resources to accelerate the customer’s digital transformation.  This is not a delivery-coordination role. The CSAM acts as a trusted advisor who connects strategic conversations with concrete technical execution.   Responsibilities     Strategic & Operational Customer Relationships — Build and sustain trusted relationships with executives, business leaders, technology teams, and operational stakeholders, moving fluidly between executive conversations and execution-level discussions.  Incident & Escalation Orchestration — Act as the customer’s advocate during critical incidents, coordinating CSS, Engineering, Product Groups, partners, and internal stakeholders to accelerate triage, drive effective communication, identify workarounds, and restore business operations as quickly as possible.  Customer Success Strategy — Lead the definition, refresh, and execution of the Customer Success Plan (CSP), translating business needs into concrete adoption, transformation, and value-generation initiatives.  Cloud & AI Adoption — Actively drive adoption, usage, and expansion of Microsoft cloud and AI solutions — helping customers identify relevant AI use cases, accelerate implementation, promote organizational adoption, and ensure measurable impact.  Delivery & Governance Leadership — Orchestrate the planning, prioritization, tracking, and execution of customer success programs across internal teams, partners, and customer stakeholders.  Risk & Customer Health Management — Monitor customer health; identify technical, operational, commercial, and adoption risks; and lead mitigation plans before issues escalate.  Cross-Functional Orchestration — Mobilize Microsoft resources, technical specialists, partners, and commercial teams toward common outcomes, influencing without direct authority.  Executive Engagement & Business Value — Lead impact- and outcome-focused conversations, communicating progress, risks, opportunities, and recommendations in a clear, executive, decision-oriented manner. title: Data Engineer / Scientist – Multimodal Clinical Data Integration & AI (m/f/d)
description:
About aiPTO

aiPTO is a TechBio startup spun off from the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), taking on one of medicine's hardest problems: brain cancer. We are building a disruptive approach — pairing next-generation patient-derived living tumor with fit-for-purpose virtual-tumor AI models. By recreating a patient's tumor biology in vitro and decoding it in silico, we aim to revolutionize brain cancer drug discovery and precision medicine. More details can be found on our publications (Individualized patient tumor organoids faithfully preserve human brain tumor ecosystems and predict patient response to therapy, DELPHAI predicts heterogeneous perturbation responses with learned single-cell fitness) and LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/aipto/).

The project

aiPTO has been selected as the data and AI partner of a newly funded Horizon Europe consortium that unites world-class neuro-oncologists, pathologists and drug-discovery pioneers across Europe. Together we are generating patient profiles of unprecedented depth: multi-omics, high-resolution digital pathology, 3D imaging and longitudinal clinical records, alongside single-cell drug-perturbation data from patient-derived organoids.

As the first member of our Heidelberg hub, you will build the data engine that turns these massive, disparate streams into AI-ready data atlas — the foundation for virtual tumor models and agentic systems designed to predict patient-specific drug response, decode resistance and reveal drug mechanisms.

What you will do

  • Architect the scientific data engine: design, build and scale the infrastructure that unifies multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, digital pathology, radiological imaging and clinical data

  • Make data AI-ready: harmonise and standardise multimodal datasets for deep-learning models and agentic workflows, working hand-in-hand with our machine-learning and computer-vision scientists

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

 

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

 

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

 

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

 

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

 

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

title: Account Manager (Remote - Mexico)
description:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

With a portfolio of approximately 100–130 Pros, you build strong, trust-based relationships by delivering consultative, tailored solutions aligned to each Pro’s business goals. You take a proactive, customer-focused approach to retention, identifying opportunities to increase engagement, strengthen partnerships, and drive measurable growth across your book of business.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Our success is their success.

title: Technical Writer
description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence.

In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes.

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

title: PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests
description:
Context:

This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources.

Objective:

To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size).

Description:

Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations.

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions. At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The opportunity.

We are seeking an experienced Financial Lead in processes and control to help modernise and scale a global finance function operating across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction environment.

This role sits at the intersection of finance operations, systems, data and business performance. You will be responsible for transforming core finance processes, improving controls, implementing enabling technologies and ensuring that transformation initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable business value.

Unlike a traditional programme management role, success will not be measured solely by project delivery. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, validate outcomes and ensure that process and system changes translate into tangible improvements in close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness and decision-making.

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
Waracle are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Developer to join our world-class digital technology consultancy. We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges, creating intelligent digital products and delivering business-critical IT transformation projects.


As a Senior .NET Developer, you will operate at an impactful level to design, build, and deliver robust backend features. We are looking for a pragmatic self-starter who is skilled at problem-solving, confident in taking ownership, and capable of figuring things out independently to deliver value quickly.

This position is an Inside IR35 Contract, initially for 6 months and is available on a Hybrid or Remote basis from Dundee, Glasgow, Edinburgh, or London.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architectural Delivery: Design and deliver end-to-end backend subsystems and features, ensuring code is modular, maintainable, and built to scale.

  • Problem Solving & Execution: Hit the ground running as a self-starter to analyse, troubleshoot, and solve complex technical challenges independently.

  • Quality & Security: Champion high standards through constructive peer code reviews, establishing defensive application security measures, and implementing thorough testing strategies across unit and service levels.

  • Consulting & Communication: Translate complex technical choices into clear, accessible language for clients and stakeholders, building strong, trusting relationships.

  • Delivery Accountability: Balance speed and high-quality standards thoughtfully to ensure the successful, sustainable delivery of features within required contract timelines.

title: Principal Solution Architect
description:
Waracle are looking for a Principal Solution Architect for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex  challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.


This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site 

The Role

Are you a visionary technical leader who thrives on bringing clarity to complex engineering challenges?

In this influential role, you’ll act as the bridge where mobile engineering, product strategy, security, and delivery converge. Partnering with high-profile clients, you will shape resilient, secure, and user-friendly digital mobile experiences that millions rely on daily. You will work ahead of delivery teams to resolve architectural ambiguity, steer platform evolution, and lead with empathy, collaboration, and purpose.

title: Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design
description:
Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design

Finom is building a brand that European entrepreneurs recognise and trust, and right now the visual side of that brand needs an owner.

We are looking for an Art Director to lead our Marketing Design team and take ownership of Finom's visual identity end to end. Not marketing design in isolation: the brand system itself, the guidelines behind it, and how consistently it shows up everywhere Finom appears.

You are joining at a genuine inflection point. Finom is growing fast, helping entrepreneurs around Europe take their businesses to the next level. We have over 200k users with ambition for millions more. Meanwhile, our customers rate us 4.8 on Trustpilot, the only business banking app above 4.7.

Our ambition brings with it a unique set of challenges. Your job will be twofold: raise the creative bar, and build the system that lets a team deliver at volume without the quality dropping.

title: Senior Registered Veterinary Nurse - HDU & Wards
description:
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
 
Hamilton Specialist Referrals are seeking a Senior HDU & Wards Nurse to become an integral part of our passionate, friendly team. If you are looking to take the next step in your career, and develop valuable leadership skills and experience, we would love to hear from you.
 
Make a difference, in a team you are proud to be a part of
 
We are seeking an experienced and confident Senior HDU & Wards Nurse to join our referral hospital and provide support to our Clinical Team Leader in a leadership role within our inpatient services. This position is ideal for an RVN with strong clinical experience in high-dependency and ward-based nursing who enjoys and mixture of providing hands on clinical care and supporting teams, coordinating patient flow and working closely with clinicians in a fast-paced referral environment.
 
As a Senior HDU & Wards RVN, you will provide excellent inpatient care and clinical leadership. On a rota with the HDU & Wards Clinical Team Leader you will provide an operational oversight across the HDU and inpatient wards, supporting the nursing team to deliver exceptional standards of care while ensuring safe, efficient workflow throughout the hospital.
 
Clinically, your role will focus on the recovery and ongoing care of hospitalised patients. You’ll collaborate closely with the veterinary team to maintain the highest standards of nursing care. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and takes pride in positively impacting the wellbeing of our patients.

title: Senior Orthopaedic Veterinary Nurse
description:
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

We are seeking a confident, knowledgeable Senior Orthopaedic Veterinary Nurse to join our team at Hamilton Specialist Referrals on a full-time basis.

 
Hamilton Specialist Referrals was born of the belief that there is room for a new wave of veterinary excellence across the UK. There is a strong focus on providing a personal and reassuring client experience from first contact through to discharge. Excellent clinical care delivered in a friendly and supportive manner to referring vets is paramount to the team. The hospital is operational 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and offers the most advanced treatment options for orthopaedic, neurology, soft tissue, and internal medicine cases. We have a dedicated Imaging suite, which includes a 16-slice CT scanner, a 1.5 Tesla MRI, fluoroscopy, and separate radiography and ultrasound rooms.
 
Our core ethos here at HSR is based on the appreciation of our staff. Curating and developing a friendly, close-knit team is a central part of our working environment. Further qualifications and certificates are encouraged and fully supported as we feel strongly about our employees' right to enjoy work and develop rewarding careers. We have a dedicated team of Specialists, Referral clinicians, RVNs and Support teams.
 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As a Senior Orthopaedic Veterinary Nurse, you will set the standard for excellence within the Orthopaedic Nursing Department, promoting high-quality patient care and clinical best practice.

TL;DR - Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.

You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

title: QA Lead
description:
About Foundation Health

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role

You'd be joining alongside our QA Lead in the US, with real ownership of building this out properly in the UK: strategy, tooling, standards, process — all still very much taking shape. There's no hands-off management here — everybody, at every level, is hands-on, and that includes you.

And because we're AI-native by design, testing here isn't testing conventional software. You'll be leading the charge on how we test AI-led products across the UK — agentic workflows, LLM-based features, non-deterministic behaviour that doesn't fit a traditional pass/fail script.

What you'll actually do:

  • Build out our QA function prop

AI for biology has a data problem, not a compute problem. Biological foundation models can predict, but they cannot run experiments, and the high-quality, large-scale data they need does not exist. Substrate generates it, with quality and provenance built in.

The role

You will build the molecular characterisation cascade that sits downstream of protein production and upstream of functional assays: the biophysical, analytical, and developability assays that decide what each molecule is and whether it holds up. The cascade will eventually run autonomously on Substrate’s automation platform. In the first phase, you develop each assay by hand, running protocols manually, setting reproducibility and quality thresholds, and proving each assay out before it moves onto instrumentation.

title: IT-Projektmanager (m/w/d)
description:
Die MESKRU GmbH ist ein IT-Beratungsunternehmen, das sich auf Atlassian-Tools spezialisiert hat. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Implementierung, Anpassung und Optimierung ihrer Atlassian-Tools, um beispielsweise das Projektmanagement und die Teamzusammenarbeit zu verbessern. Wir sind ein dynamisches Start-Up, das mit Leidenschaft die digitale Zukunft formt. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte als Teil unseres Teams innovative Lösungen mit Atlassian-Tools für eine sich rasant entwickelnde Arbeitswelt.

Aufgaben

  • Du leitest IT-Projekte bei unseren Kunden eigenverantwortlich von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zum Go-live
  • Du steuerst Scope, Zeitplan, Budget und Ressourcen und machst Fortschritt und Handlungsbedarf jederzeit transparent
  • Du nimmst Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Fachbereich und IT auf, schärfst sie und setzt Prioritäten
  • Du führst interdisziplinäre Teams aus Consultants, Entwickler:innen und Mitarbeitenden des Kunden – fachlich, ohne disziplinarische Verantwortung
  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für den Kunden bis auf Managementebene: Statusberichte, Steering Committees, Eskalationen
  • Du sprichst Risiken und Zielkonflikte früh an und führst Entscheidungen herbei, statt sie zu verwalten

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre in der eigenverantwortlichen Leitung von IT-Projekten – mit Budget- und Ergebnisverantwortung
  • Du hast mehrere Projekte von Kickoff bis Go-live gebracht, in denen mehr als eine Organisation mitgeredet hat
  • Sicherer Umgang mit klassischen, agilen und hybriden Projektmethoden und ein Gespür dafür, wann welche passt
  • Du verstehst IT-Systemlandschaften, Schnittstellen und Migrationsvorhaben gut genug, um technische Entscheidungen zu bewerten – selbst entwickeln musst du nicht

title: Head of Warehouse Projects
description:
At Rohlik, we own our end-to-end operations — from in-house technology and automated distribution centers to last-mile delivery. Delivering thousands of products same-day requires an operational backbone built on advanced warehouse automation, goods-to-person (G2P) systems, and highly efficient intralogistics.

The Automation department leads large-scale warehouse projects across the Group, enabling safe, high-performing, and customer-centric fulfillment operations in all our markets. As Head of Warehouse Projects, you will own the delivery execution of major CapEx implementation projects — from retrofits and G2P integrations in legacy sites to full layout rollouts for new expansion sites across Europe.

You are the single point of accountability for bringing approved designs to life. Taking an signed-off operational layout, you will drive the entire program through site readiness, vendor management, budget control, and commissioning — delivering fully operational sites on time, on budget, and ready for local teams.

Why this role is exciting

  • Single point of ownership: You own the delivery execution end-to-end — holding ultimate accountability for whether complex, multi-million euro automation projects land on time and perform as expected.

  • Cutting-edge automation: Direct hands-on delivery of large-scale CapEx projects involving advanced goods-to-person (G2P/AS-RS) systems, conveyors, racking, and automated material handling.

  • European expansion scope: Play a central role in scaling Rohlik’s operational footprint across multiple European countries.

  • High organizational visibility:

title: Senior Product Design Engineer
description:
At Rohlik Group, we are building the future of e-grocery for over a million active customers across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. We own our entire technology stack — from storefronts and apps to automated fulfillment centers and last-mile logistics.

Within the Customer Experience (CUEX) domain, we own every touchpoint a customer interacts with, from the homepage to checkout and real-time order tracking across web, iOS, and Android. Our five storefronts run on a single product spine with localized content, pricing, and brand layers. We operate as a deliberately tight-knit, high-performing team where a Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, two Product Designers, and a dedicated full-stack engineering team ship fast, iterate constantly, and take full ownership of the end-to-end user journey.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues — they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows.

Why this role is exciting

  • High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders.

  • True end-to-end ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle of product design — from initial problem definition and customer research to shipped A/B tests and real-world performance analysis.

  • AI-first execution: Rohlik is an AI-first company

title: Workplace and People Operations Manager

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.

You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.

You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.

— Grigory

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

How do you feel about owning a feature from the first customer conversation to the version that's live in production — writing the spec yourself, pairing closely with engineers through the build, and overseeing your design shipped in production exactly the way you designed it? Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

title: MyMiki Experience Manager
description: You're not just tracking play — you're designing what it feels like to be someone's favourite person to hear from. That means knowing which players want front-row seats to the biggest event of the year, which ones want a quiet "saw you hit your milestone" message at exactly the right moment, and which ones just want their withdrawal handled before they even finish typing the question. As a MyMiki Experience Manager, you build that experience — one relationship, one thoughtful move at a time.  This is a relationship role first, an operations role second. You'll know your players — not just their tier, but what actually makes them feel seen — and you'll be the person who creates change to improve the customer experience at Miki Ontario!  Here's the part that makes this one different: you'd be the first VIP hire at Miki Ontario. There's no established playbook to just follow — there's one to help write. You'll be building the relationships, the rhythms, and the standards that the entire VIP program gets measured against from day one, with real room to grow as the team and the program scale around you.   Responsibilities / What You'll Own     Your player book. Day-to-day relationships for your assigned players, from first outreach through every tier they climb.  Proactive outreach, not reactive support. You're working segmentation lists and Player Insights signals to reach players before they raise a hand — deposit velocity, session frequency, wager trends, tenure. If a player's about to become VIP-worthy, you're already in their inbox.  Personalized offers. Curating bonuses and missions that actually fit how someone plays — not blanket promotions.  A direct line, always open. You're the first point of contact for your players on payment escalations, tier questions, and general check-ins. No queues, no "please hold."  The moments that matter. Birthdays, big wins, anniversaries — the human touches that build real loyalty, tracked and acted on, not left to memory.  Live experience nominations. You know your players well enough to put the right names forward for the right events — this is judgment, not an auto-assignment.  Clean handoffs. Every interaction logged in Salesforce, so a promotion, a shift boundary, or a Customer Support handoff never means your player has to reintroduce themselves to someone new.  Overall CX enthusiast. You are constantly thinking about what we can do better, how we can improve our offering, and what we can rearrange to make the site more user friendly.  Responsible Gambling, built in, not bolted on. The same attention that spots a rising player also spots one who needs support. You'll flag anything RG-relevant to the RG team and stay the player's point of contact through it.  Tools You'll Use: Smartico, Salesforce, Slack, Confluence, Google Suite, Internal Back Office, PowerBI.     Requirements / What You'll Need     Experience in VIP account management, high-touch customer relationships, or iGaming operations

title: CRM & Retention Manager (m/w/d)
description: Gemeinsam für natürliche Gesundheit – von Herz zu Herz    Bei Nature Heart glauben wir an die Kraft der Natur und daran, dass Qualität bei Nahrungsergänzung keine Kompromisse zulässt.   Hinter Nature Heart stehen über zehn Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich hochwertiger Nahrungsergänzung. 2023 ist daraus unsere eigene Marke entstanden – mit dem Anspruch, natürliche Rohstoffe, durchdachte Rezepturen, unabhängige Laborprüfungen und eine Produktion in Deutschland miteinander zu verbinden.    Nature Heart wächst – und wir möchten unseren CRM- und Retention-Bereich gezielt weiter ausbauen.    Dafür suchen wir ab sofort einen erfahrenen CRM & Retention Manager mit starker Klaviyo-Expertise, der unseren CRM-Kanal nicht nur betreut, sondern strategisch weiterentwickelt. Im Fokus stehen automatisierte Customer Journeys, intelligente Segmentierung, kontinuierliches Testing und eine Kommunikation, die Wiederkäufe, Kundenbindung und Customer Lifetime Value nachhaltig steigert.    Deine Aufgaben      Du entwickelst unsere gesamte Klaviyo-Architektur weiter und baust bestehende sowie neue Flows strukturiert auf.   Du optimierst unter anderem Welcome-, Post-Purchase-, Second-Order-, Cross-Selling-, Winback- und Reaktivierungs-Flows.   Du entwickelst unsere Kampagnen- und Segmentierungslogik weiter und entscheidest datenbasiert, welche Zielgruppe welche Kommunikation zu welchem Zeitpunkt erhält.   Du etablierst eine konsequente Testing-Struktur mit regelmäßigen A/B-Tests, dokumentierten Learnings und klaren Rollout-Entscheidungen.   Du nutzt Klaviyo AI und Predictive Features wie Predictive CLV, Churn Risk und Expected Date of Next Order und integrierst diese sinnvoll in unsere Segmentierungs- und Flow-Logik.   Du analysierst unsere CRM-Performance und identifizierst Potenziale zur Steigerung von Wiederkaufrate, Customer Lifetime Value und Bestandskundenumsatz.   Du entwickelst unsere Kommunikation rund um Loyalty, Wiederkäufe und wiederkehrende Kunden weiter.   Du steuerst externe Agenturen oder Dienstleister fachlich und bewertest Empfehlungen anhand von Daten und Ergebnissen.   Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Performance Marketing und weiteren relevanten Bereichen zusammen.   Du nutzt KI-Tools und Automatisierungen, um Analysen, Prozesse, Segmentierungen und Content effizienter und besser zu machen.         Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen      Umsatzbeitrag aus CRM und E-Mail-Marketing   Umsatz und Conversion unserer automatisierten Flows   Wiederkaufrate unserer Bestandskunden   Customer Lifetime Value   Entwicklung relevanter Kundensegmente   Performance unserer Kampagnen und Customer Journeys   Qualität und Regelmäßigkeit unserer A/B-Tests   dokumentierte Learnings und daraus umgesetzte Optimierungen        Dein Ziel ist es, unseren CRM-Bereich zu einem immer stärkeren, planbaren und skalierbaren Wachstumskanal weiterzuentwickeln.    Dein Profil      Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im CRM, Retention Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing oder E-Mail-Marketing,

title: Customer Success Consultant Zorg
description: Customer Success Consultant – Zorgsoftware      Zaandijk | Curasoft EPD | HBO werk- en denkniveau     Wil jij jouw kennis van zorgprocessen combineren met software, klantcontact en consultancy? Vind je het leuk om klanten écht verder te helpen, processen slimmer in te richten en mee te denken over hoe software optimaal kan worden ingezet?      Voor Curasoft, onze EPD-software voor de zorgsector, zoeken wij een Customer Success Consultant.      In deze veelzijdige functie werk je nauw samen met onze klanten. Je adviseert hen over het optimaal gebruik van Curasoft, begeleidt implementaties en projecten, geeft trainingen en helpt bij complexere klantvragen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de vraag die op dat moment wordt gesteld: je wilt begrijpen hoe de klant werkt en waar processen slimmer, eenvoudiger of efficiënter kunnen.      Wat ga je doen?      Als Customer Success Consultant ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen onze klanten, Customer Care, je collega-consultants en Development.      Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:      adviseren van klanten over het optimaal inzetten van Curasoft en het verbeteren van hun processen;  begeleiden van nieuwe klanten bij implementaties en software-inrichting;  analyseren en oplossen van complexere klantvragen als tweedelijns support;  ondersteunen van Customer Care bij vragen die meer inhoudelijke of procesmatige analyse vragen;  geven van trainingen, presentaties en demonstraties, zowel online als op locatie;  opbouwen en onderhouden van goede, langdurige klantrelaties;  signaleren van klantbehoeften en mogelijke knelpunten voordat deze escaleren;  vertalen van klantfeedback en ontwikkelingen in de zorg naar input voor ons productteam;  bijdragen aan onze kennisbank, documentatie en best practices;  samenwerken met Development wanneer een vraag technische afstemming vraagt;  incidenteel deelnemen aan klantdagen, beurzen en andere evenementen.     Daarmee ben je niet alleen bezig met het oplossen van vragen, maar vooral met het succesvol maken en houden van onze klanten met Curasoft. Dit sluit rechtstreeks aan bij het nieuwe functieprofiel, waarin advies, implementatie, tweedelijns support, relatiebeheer en productfeedback de belangrijkste onderdelen vormen.      Wie zoeken wij?      We zoeken iemand die klantgericht én analytisch is. Iemand die graag doorvraagt, verbanden ziet en niet alleen vertelt wat een klant kan doen, maar ook meedenkt over hoe het beter kan.     Je beschikt bij voorkeur over:     minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau;  ongeveer 2 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld als consultant, implementatiespecialist, applicatiebeheerder of Customer Success Professional;  kennis van of affiniteit met de zorgsector en zorgprocessen;  affiniteit met software, IT en bij voorkeur SaaS-oplossingen;  ervaring met klantbegeleiding, implementaties en/of procesoptimalisatie is een sterke pré;  uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;  goede communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden;

title: Customer Service Manager
description: Key Responsibilities    Oversee day-to-day management of active customer service inbound tickets across multiple digital and telehealth platforms, ensuring timely, accurate, and empathetic resolution.  Build and formalize customer service processes, workflows, and SOPs where none currently exist, including ticket triage, escalation paths, and response-time standards.  Identify gaps in current internal infrastructure (tools, ticketing systems, knowledge bases) and drive improvements over time in partnership with Product, IT, and Operations.  Hire, train, schedule, and manage a team of customer service agents; set performance expectations and provide ongoing coaching and feedback.  Establish and track key performance metrics (e.g., response time, resolution time, CSAT, ticket volume/backlog) and report on team performance to leadership. Develop and maintain a knowledge base, macros/templates, and training materials to improve team efficiency and consistency.  Help define the long-term structure of the Customer Service & Customer Success division, including future roles, tiers of support, and success metrics.  Champion a customer-first culture across the organization.  Analyze recurring customer issues and identify root causes, trends, and systemic problems; partner with relevant departments to implement corrective and preventive actions.    Qualifications    5+ years of experience in customer service or customer success, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or management capacity.  Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving customer service processes, tools, or infrastructure from the ground up.  Experience managing a team of customer-facing agents, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.  Strong working knowledge of help desk / ticketing platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot Service Hub, or similar).  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to de-escalate and resolve sensitive customer issues.  Comfortable working with data - able to define, track, and report on team KPIs.  Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-growing environment.  Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.    Preferred Qualifications    Experience in healthcare, telehealth, pharmacy, or a related regulated industry.  Experience supporting customers across multiple digital platforms or product lines simultaneously.  Familiarity with quality assurance frameworks for customer service teams (call/ticket scoring, QA rubrics).

title: Embedded Payments Onboarding Manager

Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. description: Your Role   We are seeking a commercially minded poultry professional for a key customer-facing role that combines technical expertise, account management, export coordination, and practical customer support across New Zealand the Pacific Islands.  Reporting to the General Manager and based at our Ohoka office, you will lead customer relationships, coordinate internal delivery, and lead a tight knit sales and export team. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn technical knowledge into practical commercial value.   Key Responsibilities Include     Manage and grow key customer relationships across New Zealand and the Pacific Islands including regularly travelling to customers within NZ and the Pacific Islands as required.  Coordinate with internal teams to plan and deliver customer requirements.  Own sales forecasts, account plans, customer commitments, and identify market opportunities to support sustainable growth and reliable supply.  Support customers with practical technical advice and ensure they have access to the right expertise across the Hendrix Genetics network, from local specialists through to global subject matter experts.  Resolve customer issues, complaints, and technical claims professionally and promptly.     Your Profile     Poultry industry experience, ideally in breeder, hatchery, layer, technical, or customer-facing operations.  Strong relationship-building skills with customers, internal teams, and technical specialists.  The ability to translate technical information into clear, commercially relevant advice.  Commercial awareness, sound judgement, and a strong customer-delivery mindset.  Good planning, problem-solving, and organisational skills.  A willingness to travel regularly within New Zealand and the Pacific region as required.  Customer focused (internally and externally).    This role could suit an experienced poultry professional looking to transition from production or operations into a commercial role, or an agriculture industry professional with strong customer relationship skills who is ready for a new challenge.  If you enjoy building customer relationships, solving practical problems, and delivering outcomes in a fast-moving poultry business, we would like to hear from you.  Apply now and help support the next stage of growth with a globally recognized leader in animal genetics.

description: The Opportunity   At Purina, we're driven by one simple belief: Pets and People are Better Together. As a global leader in pet nutrition, we're passionate about creating healthier, happier lives for pets and the people who love them.  We're looking for an ambitious and commercially savvy Customer Business Manager to join our high-performing team on a  fixed term contract until 30 September 2027. If you're looking for a role where you can combine commercial expertise, strategic thinking, and your passion for building strong partnerships, we'd love to hear from you.  Apply today and help us create richer lives for pets and the people who love them. description: Location :  [add preferred location here]   Contract : [full time / part time] / [definite / indefinite]     Language(s) : [add preferred / required language(s) here]  Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications.  Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.  Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.  Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!   About the role:    Customer Success is a core pillar of Serrala's revenue organization. The Scaled Customer Success Manager owns the success of a high-volume portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers through a one-to-many, data-driven engagement model.  This role is being built from the ground up. You will design the playbooks, health scoring, and Early Warning System that didn't yet exist, on a product line being re-engineered in parallel. That means working with incomplete data, building structure as you go, and staying patient while the roadmap takes shape. We're looking for a resilient, can-do professional who is comfortable with ambiguity and builds the foundation rather than waiting for one.  You will manage 1,500+ customers spanning cloud and on-premise environments, and own their migration to Cloud. This is a multi-year transformation, not a routine renewal cycle, and you will own the customer relationship through it - protecting it, driving adoption, and making sure the move lands as a better experience rather than a disruption. You will be a key stakeholder of the Core Migration Team, and report progress into the program's weekly and monthly governance cadence.  The role will run a high-engagement cadence with the most strategic accounts (including QBRs), while managing renewals across the rest through scaled touchpoints. Your role is also central to other departments relying on health and customer experience information to make data-driven decisions.
