description: Organization- Park Hyatt Niseko    要約    会社概要   パーク ハイアット ニセコ HANAZONO は、北海道の雄大な自然に囲まれたラグジュアリーリゾートです。私たちは、ゲスト一人ひとりに寄り添ったパーソナライズされたサービスを通じて、期待を超える体験と心に残る思い出を創造しています。   職務内容   フロントオフィスマネージャーは、フロントオフィス業務全般を統括し、到着から出発まで一貫して温かく、洗練された、効率的なサービスを提供する責任を担います。  ゲストとの積極的な関わり、日々のオペレーション管理、売上・財務管理、チームメンバーの育成を通じて、ラグジュアリーリゾートにふさわしい高いサービス基準を実現していただきます。   主な業務内容     フロントデスク、ゲストサービス、到着・出発、手荷物、交通サポートなど、フロントオフィスの日常業務を統括  VIP、長期滞在、リピーター、記念日のお客様へのパーソナライズされたサービスの提供  お客様からのご要望や苦情への対応、サービスリカバリーおよび適切なフォローアップ  ハウスキーピング、コンシェルジュ、エンジニアリング、ファイナンスなど他部門との連携  客室状況、客室準備、事前ブロック、鍵管理、チェックイン、支払い、チェックアウト手続きの管理  冬季・夏季の繁忙期、送迎、アクティビティなど、リゾート特有の季節需要への対応  客室売上、稼働率、平均客室単価、アップグレード、付帯サービスなどの業績目標達成を支援  客室在庫、オーバーブッキングリスク、団体動向、到着パターンの確認および必要な判断  クレジット、現金管理、請求、売上保全、財務管理に関する手順の徹底  ペイロール、ロスター、人員配置、マルチスキル化の適切な管理  部門マニュアル、SOP、業務プロセス、サービス基準の整備および更新  部門報告書、予算、ビジネスプラン、業績レビューへの対応  アシスタントマネージャー、チームリーダー、トレーナーおよびチームメンバーの採用、育成、評価  デイリーブリーフィング、シフト引継ぎ、部門会議を通じた効果的なコミュニケーション  デューティーマネージャー業務および必要に応じた宿泊部全体のサポート  日本の法令、ハイアット方針、ホテル規則、防火・衛生・健康・安全・セキュリティ基準の遵守     適格性    応募資格     アップスケールまたはラグジュアリーホテル、 preferably リゾートホテルでのフロントオフィス経験  多様なチームをリードし、育成した経験  繁忙期やサービスリカバリー時にも冷静かつ適切に判断できる能力  宿泊売上、稼働率、ロスター、ペイロール、部門コスト管理に関する実務知識  お客様、従業員、上級管理職と明確に意思疎通できる優れたコミュニケーション能力  ホテルシステム、ゲストヒストリー、客室在庫、支払管理、運営報告に関する知識  高いゲストサービス意識と、パーソナライズされたラグジュアリーサービスへの理解  チームメンバーの育成、コーチング、フィードバックに対する意欲  守秘義務、安全、チームワーク、責任あるリーダーシップを重視できる方  英語および日本語での業務上のコミュニケーション能力がある方を歓迎

I dag är vi en internationell förpackningspartner som hjälper företag att skapa värde genom innovativa och hållbara lösningar inom förpackningar, etiketter, maskiner och tjänster. Vi finns i nio länder med drygt 200 medarbetare, över 10 000 kunder och en omsättning på cirka 1,6 miljarder kronor. Vår familjeägda grund präglar hur vi bygger relationer, fattar beslut och utvecklar Boxon vidare – med ambitionen att skapa hållbart värde över tid. Våra värderingar handlar om att vinna tillsammans, vara transparenta, göra det enkelt och ta ansvar.      Om rollen:      Som Account Manager ansvarar du för att utveckla och stärka relationerna med både befintliga och nya kunder. Du får ett etablerat kundunderlag med starka kundrelationer, men en viktig del av uppdraget handlar också om att skapa nya affärer och bygga framtidens kundportfölj.   Du arbetar nära kunderna för att förstå deras verksamhet, identifiera behov och hitta de mest värdeskapande lösningarna ur Boxons breda erbjudande. Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar samtidigt som du samarbetar tätt med Customer Fulfillment, marknad, inköp, lager och dina säljkollegor.      Det här är inte en förvaltande säljtjänst. För rätt person finns en unik möjlighet att vara med och påverka arbetssätt, utveckla affären och bidra till Boxons fortsatta tillväxtresa.       Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:      • Utveckla och stärka relationerna med befintliga kunder  • Aktivt bearbeta och vinna nya kunder  • Bygga en stark och långsiktig säljpipeline  • Identifiera kundbehov och presentera skräddarsydda lösningar  • Driva offert- och avtalsprocesser  • Planera och genomföra kundmöten  • Arbeta strukturerat i CRM och övriga affärssystem  • Säkerställa hög kundnöjdhet och lönsam tillväxt  • Driva förbättringsinitiativ tillsammans med kunder och interna funktioner       Vem är du?      Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning från förpackningsbranschen eller närliggande områden. Du är van att ta ansvar för din egen affär och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt relationsbyggande med ett aktivt säljarbete. Samtidigt lockas du av möjligheten att vara med och utveckla verksamheten, utmana befintliga arbetssätt och bidra med nya idéer.       Vi ser gärna att du har:      • Erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning med dokumenterat goda resultat  • Erfarenhe

title: Merchant CRM Manager
description: What we do at Qliro  At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people who together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We're now scaling our business here in Sweden and across the Nordics.  What your team does  You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales and Marketing, embedded in our Merchant Experience and Payment Platform domains and reporting to Head of Merchant Experience. You join sales standups, hear where deals stall or onboarding gets stuck, and decide what to do about it — sometimes that's a HubSpot fix, sometimes a training session, sometimes a nudge to Product.  What you will get to do    Focus on our commercial agenda and spot recurring bottlenecks —, stalled deals, and onboarding friction.  Take ownership of challenges by going directly to the right stakeholders, bringing the right teams together and driving cross-functional solutions from idea to execution.  Own HubSpot as our commercial engine: build and maintain flows, sequences and campaigns so the tool serves the sales process, not the other way around.  Design and run training for the Sales team to close knowledge gaps.  Research the competitive landscape and turn it into material Sales can pitch from and merchants can use to understand why Qliro is the right choice.  Move sign rate, onboarding rate, product adoption rate and churn — these four are your scoreboard    What you'll bring to the team    Hands-on experience running HubSpot or a comparable CRM/marketing automation platform — building flows, managing pipelines, creating campaigns. This matters more to us than formal sales training  3–5+ years in a cross-functional role spanning product, sales and/or marketing, ideally in fintech, payments, SaaS or e-commerce  A background either as a marketing automation specialist who's grown into a broader commercial remit, or as someone technically minded within consulting or engineering who's moved toward sales  Enough technical grounding to hold your own in a product conversation and brief a PM on how a checkout API or payment integration works  A track record enabling sales teams: training, collateral, competitive positioning  Comfortable without a fixed playbook, you diagnose problems and design your own interventions rather than waiting for a request  Fluent in English; Swedish and/or Finnish a strong plus    Sound like your next role? We'd love to hear from you — apply now.   Qliro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation or age.

title: Senterleder SATS Kalbakken
description: Vi søker senterleder til SATS Kalbakken! 🙌  Brenner du for å inspirere mennesker til et sunnere og gladere liv? Vil du lede et team som virkelig betyr noe hver eneste dag?  Hos SATS jobber vi for å skape positiv forandring ved å motivere medlemmene våre og gi dem en treningsopplevelse som skiller seg ut. Som senterleder går du foran med engasjement og tydelig retning, og har ansvaret for at senteret ditt leverer gode resultater både i drift og økonomi. Du har spesielt fokus på skikkelig god service, målrettet salgsinnsats og et høyt nivå på renhold, slik at medlemmene våre får de beste rammene og opplevelsene.  🌟 Dine ansvarsområder   Gå foran som leder!   Du får det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften i ditt senter og sørger for en livlig, imøtekommende og energifylt atmosfære for både medlemmer og ansatte.   Skap resultater!   Du tar eierskap for senteret ditt, inkludert resultater og utvikling, og har det fulle økonomiske ansvaret. Du jobber strategisk for å nå salgs- og inntektsmål, samtidig som du styrer kostnadene effektivt.   Bygg et fremragende team!   Du rekrutterer, onboarder, inspirerer og utvikler et dedikert team som konsekvent leverer service i verdensklasse og skaper ekstraordinære opplevelser for medlemmene våre.   Skap en kultur preget av kvalitet!   Gjennom synlig og involverende ledelse sørger du for at alle detaljer, fra kundeservice til renhold, sikkerhet og vedlikehold av utstyr, holder høyeste standard.   Sett trivsel i fokus!   Som leder har du ansvar for arbeidsmiljøet i senteret ditt, og du sikrer en trygg, positiv og motiverende atmosfære for både ansatte og medlemmer.   Sørg for et skinnende rent senter!   Sammen med teamet ditt bruker du tid daglig på å gjøre rent, slik at senteret alltid møter SATS’ høye standarder. Uansett når medlemmene trener, skal de bli møtt av et ryddig og innbydende senter.  🤩 Hvem er du?  Du er utadvendt, vennlig og karismatisk, og har en naturlig evne til å bygge sterke relasjoner, både med medlemmer og kollegaer. Du tar initiativ, er handlekraftig og trives med å ta ansvar, samtidig som du har et skarpt blikk for struktur og systematikk i hverdagen. Du engasjerer og motiverer andre med energien og arbeidsgleden din, og du leder ved å være et inspirerende forbilde.    Du har solid erfaring med salg og ledelse og motiveres av å skape gode resultater.  Det er et krav at du snakker og skriver flytende norsk og engelsk.  Du kan identifisere deg med våre verdier: Members First, Accountable, Professional & Extraordinary. title: Serviceledare Säkerhetsteknik - Securitas Solutions Delivery Skövde
description: Securitas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag. Oavsett om du vill jobba mycket eller lite, dag eller natt så behöver vi bli fler.  Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar.   Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.   Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.   Jobbeskrivning   Solutions Delivery Väst består idag av fem projektledare, varav tre är placerade i Göteborg, en i Skövde och en i Borås. Projektledarna ansvarar för genomförande av projektleveranser, medan service- och eftermarknadsaffären hanteras av två serviceledare.  Den här tjänsten ansvarar för serviceverksamheten i Borås, Skövde och Trollhättan och är en central funktion för kundvård, serviceavtal, förebyggande underhåll, extraservice samt samordning av underentreprenörer och servicepartners. En viktig framgångsfaktor är vår lokala närvaro och de etablerade relationerna till både kunder och underentreprenörer.  Rollen kombinerar kundansvar, affärsutveckling och serviceledning med planering, uppföljning och koordinering av leveranser. Du driver serviceaffären framåt samtidigt som du säkerställer hög kvalitet och kundnöjdhet i den dagliga verksamheten. Fokus ligger på att säkerställa kvalitet, god dialog och långsiktiga relationer, där både interna processer och extern samverkan är avgörande för ett framgångsrikt resultat.  Du fungerar som länk mellan kund och underentreprenörer, fördelar arbetet för teknikväktarna samt säkerställer att serviceleveranser sker enligt avtal, tidsramar och uppsatta kvalitetskrav. En viktig del av uppdraget är att vara ute hos kund, delta i kvartalsmöten, fånga upp nya behov och bidra till långsiktiga kundrelationer.  Personlighet, affärsmässighet och förmåga att balansera relationer är centrala framgångsfaktorer i rollen.  Ditt geografiska ansvarsområde är Borås, Skövde och Trollhättan – vilket innebär att du kör förmånsbil och regelbundet reser över dagen, och ibland också med övernattning. Det är därför naturligt att du är placerad i någon av dessa orter.  Exempel på arbetsuppgifter    ha ekonomiskt ansvar för avtalsportföljen, inklusive uppföljning och affärsmässiga prioriteringar  följa upp och hantera nya och befintliga samarbeten med underentreprenörer och servicepartners  fånga upp nya behov, avvikelser och förbättringsområden hos kund och omsätta detta i konkreta åtgärder  samverka nära med projektledare, sälj, teknikväktare och övrig driftorganisation  hantera kundbesök och vara del i kundpresentationer  säkerställa att serviceavtal följs

title: Client Success Consultant (CMMS)
description: RM3,500–5,000/month · Ara Damansara, Petaling Jaya · Full-time, in the office five days a week · 1–3 years experience     Picture this. A chiller at a hospital trips at 2am. The technician on duty opens Cerev on his phone, sees the full service history, and knows exactly what was done last time. That moment only happens because someone set the system up properly, trained the team, and made sure they kept using it.  That someone is you.  We build Cerev CMMS, maintenance software used every day by factories, government buildings, hospitals and property groups across Malaysia. As a Client Success Consultant, you will be with our clients from their first day on Cerev, and you will stay with them long after.      Why we exist   Most buildings and factories in Malaysia still track maintenance on paper, in Excel, or over WhatsApp. Equipment breaks down earlier than it should, not because no one cares, but because no one has a clean record of what needs fixing and when. We want Cerev to be the standard way maintenance is tracked in this country. That does not end once a client is set up. A client who stops using the system after month two has not actually been helped. Someone has to keep them using it properly, long after the excitement of the demo has worn off.      How we work   We are a small team in one office in Ara Damansara, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Small means you are never far from an answer. The engineer who built the feature your client is asking about sits a few desks away. You will hear sales calls, product debates and the odd argument about coffee beans, and you will pick up more in a month here than in a year somewhere bigger. Good news gets shared with the whole team. Problems get solved together, out in the open, not passed around by email.      A real look at our culture   We work by five values: composure, ownership, innovation, candor and excellence. Every company says something like this. Here is what it actually looks like.   Composure. A client wants their whole site live in two weeks, when the data alone will take three. They push, they escalate, they are not happy. The right move is not to agree just to keep them calm, and it is not to get defensive either. It is to explain, clearly and without getting rattled, what is realistic and why, and to hold that line even when the client keeps pushing.  Ownership. We used to track every client in one flat list. If a rollout stalled, it was not clear whose job it was to notice. We rebuilt it so every client has a project, and every project has a stage, with a named owner at each stage. No more "I thought someone else was handling that."  Innovation. New joiners used to learn onboarding by shadowing someone and hoping they remembered everything. We built a proper playbook instead, with templates, scripts and checklists for every stage of a client rollout. It gets updated whenever someone finds a gap. If you find the gap, you get to fix it. title: Vil du være med og utvikle den digitale kundereisen i Nordens største IT-selskap?
description: Atea eCommerce utvikler og forvalter plattformene som utgjør en viktig del av den digitale kundereisen for våre kunder. Nå søker vi en eCommerce Specialist til et 18 måneders svangerskapsvikariat som vil bidra til gode kundeopplevelser og sikre at kundene lykkes i våre løsninger.   Om rollen    Du blir en del av teamet som følger opp kunder i Det Frie Valg og sørger for god onboarding, operativ drift og videreutvikling av kundeforholdene våre.  Rollen passer for deg som liker skjæringspunktet mellom kunde, teknologi og forretning. Du blir et viktig bindeledd mellom kunder, salgsorganisasjonen og tekniske fagmiljøer.  Dette får du gjøre :    etablere og følge opp kunder i Ateas ehandelsløsninger   sikre god onboarding og operativ drift   delta i kundemøter og representere eCommerce   forstå kundebehov og finne gode løsninger sammen med kollegaer   støtte salgsorganisasjonene i regionene   bidra i prosjekter og anbudsprosesser knyttet til Det Frie Valg       Arbeidssted:   Oslo   Ansettelsesform:   Svangerskapsvikariat, 18 måneder   Hvem tror vi vil trives?    Du trenger ikke kunne alt fra dag én. Dette er en rolle du kan vokse i. Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig, liker å ta initiativ og ønsker å utvikle deg videre innen eCommerce og digitale kundeplattformer. Du har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter og teknisk forståelse. Det er ønskelig med relevant utdanning innen IT, teknologi, eller et beslektet fagområde. Arbeidsspråk er norsk og engelsk.  Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med:    kundeoppfølging eller digitalt salg   B2B-løsninger eller ehandel   digitale kundeplattformer       Hvorfor Atea eCommerce?    Hos oss blir du en del av et inkluderende og kompetent fagmiljø med gode utviklingsmuligheter. Du får samarbeide med kollegaer i Norge og resten av Norden, jobbe med løsninger som er viktige for kundene våre og bygge kompetanse innen digital handel, teknologi og kundeopplevelser.  Vi tror at mennesker presterer best når de får tillit, ansvar og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag. Derfor legger vi til rette for faglig og personlig utvikling gjennom spennende prosjekter, kunnskapsdeling og samarbeid med noen av Nordens fremste fagmiljøer.  I tillegg tilbyr vi konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, fleksibilitet i arbeidshverdagen og et aktivt arbeidsmiljø der vi heier på hverandre og lykkes sammen.   Hos Atea får du muligheten til å utvikle deg, påvirke og skape verdi, samtidig som du blir en del av et sterkt fellesskap med mennesker som brenner for det de gjør.     Høres dette interessant ut? Da håper vi at du vil sende oss en søknad!   Ved spørsmål om stillingen kan du ta kontakt med Gard Andresen (Manager) på e-post: gard.andresen@atea.no

description: Jobbeschreibung    Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an.   Wir bei bexio leben die Philosophie, dass erstklassige, effiziente und smarte Softwarelösungen für jedes KMU zugänglich und erschwinglich sein müssen. Mit dieser Mission sind wir heute die führende Anbieterin für webbasierte Business-Software in der Schweiz.   Unser Expansionskurs geht steil nach oben: Über 100'000 zufriedene Kunden, mehr als 7'000 Treuhand-Partner und ein starkes Team von über 150 motivierten Mitarbeitenden sprechen für sich. Um diese Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir tatkräftige Unterstützung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel!    Stellenanforderungen     Was du bei uns bewegst      Du leitest ein Team aus Partner Success Managern und sorgst dafür, dass sich jeder – egal auf welchem Erfahrungslevel – gezielt weiterentwickelt. Als Sparringspartner im Tagesgeschäft hilfst du deinem Team, die eigenen KPIs und Ziele zu erreichen.   Dein Team organisiert Schulungen, beantwortet Anfragen und entwickelt Wachstumsstrategien für Partner. Du musst das nicht alles selbst machen, aber du verstehst die Herausforderungen dahinter und optimierst Prozesse wie das Onboarding, damit sie für dein Team und die Partner reibungslos laufen.   Deine klare Mission ist das Enablement, nicht der klassische Verkauf. Du entwickelst neue Strategien und Massnahmen, um die Partnerbindung und das Produkt-Know-how unserer Partner nachhaltig zu maximieren.   Du analysierst fortlaufend die Partner-Performance, wertest Reports aus und leitest daraus strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für die Geschäftsleitung ab.   Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend eng mit Vertrieb, Marketing und Produktmanagement zusammen und bringst dich bei komplexen Anliegen von grossen Partnern aktiv als Lösungsfinder ein.         Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle      Du hast bereits Teams geleitet und bringst das Gespür mit, Menschen zu motivieren und zu einem starken Team zu formen.   Du weisst aus eigener Erfahrung, wie Partner Success funktioniert und kennst die Bandbreite der Aufgaben – von alltäglichen Anfragen bis hin zur strategischen Account-Planung.   Du siehst dich selbst als Beziehungsmanager und Enabler. Anstatt Produkte mit Druck in den Markt zu pushen, sorgst du dafür, dass Kunden unsere Lösungen richtig nutzen und den Mehrwert erkennen.   Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung oder im Enablement mit, idealerweise direkt aus dem SaaS-Umfeld oder mit Berührungspunkten zur Treuhand-Branche.   Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich, da das für unseren Alltag absolut unverzichtbar ist. title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Customer Success
description: Job Requisition ID #   26WD99315   募集職種概要   Autodeskでは、日本のエンタープライズ顧客を担当するCustomer Success Manager（CSM）チームを率いるSenior Manager, Enterprise Customer Successを募集しています。  本ポジションはCustomer Success Leaderに直接レポートし、日本市場における顧客価値創出、利用定着、契約更新、ビジネス成長を推進するCustomer Success組織のリーダーとして活躍いただきます。  担当チームは主にAEC（Architecture, Engineering & Construction）業界のお客様を支援していますが、一部Design & Manufacturing（D&M）業界のお客様も担当しています。  このポジションには、組織を率いるリーダーシップと、お客様の成功を実現する現場力の両方が求められます。  Customer Success Managerの育成だけでなく、重要な顧客との対話や課題解決にも主体的に関与していただきます。  Customer Success Managerと共に顧客に向き合い、複雑なビジネス課題の解決や価値創出をリードできる「Player-Coach型」のリーダーです。  お客様の経営課題や事業戦略を深く理解し、エグゼクティブレベルのステークホルダーとの信頼関係を構築しながら、Autodeskソリューションを通じたビジネス成果の実現を支援していただきます。  また、日本国内のチームを率いるだけでなく、APACおよびグローバルのCustomer Success、Sales、Technical Sales、Supportなどの関係部門と連携しながら、お客様の成功とAutodeskの成長を推進していただきます。   主な業務内容   Customer Successチームのリーダーシップ    Enterprise Customer Success Managerチームの採用、育成、コーチング、評価  高い成果を生み出すチームカルチャーの構築  メンバーのキャリア開発およびパフォーマンス向上支援  Customer Successのベストプラクティスの浸透と継続的改善の推進  顧客成果を中心としたチーム運営および組織強化    顧客価値創出とビジネス成果の実現    戦略的重要顧客とのエグゼクティブレベルでの関係構築  Customer Success Managerと連携した顧客課題解決の推進  顧客の事業目標に基づくCustomer Success戦略の策定と実行  利用定着、顧客満足度向上、契約更新および利用拡大の推進  エスカレーション案件や重要顧客案件へのリーダーシップ提供    ビジネス課題への理解と提案    顧客の事業戦略、業務プロセス、経営課題の理解  顧客の成功指標に基づいた価値提案の推進  Autodeskソリューションを活用した業務改善・デジタル変革支援  業界動向や市場変化を踏まえた戦略的アドバイザリーの提供    クロスファンクショナルな連携    Sales、Technical Sales、Technical Support、Consulting、Partnerチームとの連携  顧客リスクや成長機会の特定および対応計画の策定  顧客利用状況やビジネス成果に関する分析とレポーティング  APACおよびグローバルチームとの連携によるベストプラクティスの展開     応募資格（必須）     Enterprise Customer Success、Strategic Account Management、Consulting、または関連する顧客対応領域での経験  Customer Successまたは顧客対応組織におけるPeople Management経験  エンタープライズ顧客との長期的な関係構築および経営層との折衝経験  顧客のビジネス課題を理解し、成果につながる解決策を導いた経験  チームメンバーの育成・コーチングを通じて成果を創出した経験  優れた問題解決能力およびステークホルダーマネジメント能力  日本語および英語での高いコミュニケーション能力（読み書き・会話ともに必須）  グローバル環境での業務経験、またはグローバルチームとの協業経験     歓迎する経験・スキル     SaaS企業におけるCustomer Success Leadership経験  AEC（建築・エンジニアリング・建設）業界での業務経験、または同業界顧客への支援経験、Design & Manufacturing業界への知見など  BIM、建設DX、デジタル変革プロジェクトに関する経験  Autodesk製品または関連ソリューションへの理解  顧客利用状況、価値実現、契約更新などの指標を活用したデータドリブンな組織運営経験     このポジションで活躍する方     お客様の成功に強いオーナーシップを持てる方  チームを率いるだけでなく、自ら顧客課題の解決に入り込める方  Customer Successをビジネス成果を創出する戦略的な役割だと考えている方  顧客の経営層と対話しながら信頼関係を構築できる方  ビジネス課題とテクノロジーを結び付けて考えられる方  グローバル環境での協業を楽しめる方  「お客様の成功が私たちの成功につながる」という考え方に共感できる方    Position Overview  Autodesk is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Manager, Customer Success to lead a team of Enterprise Customer Success Managers supporting strategic customers across Japan. Reporting directly to the Customer Success Leader, this role is responsible for driving customer value realization, adoption, retention, and growth across a portfolio of enterprise customers. The team primarily supports customers in the Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC) industry, while also partnering with customers in the Design & Manufacturing (D&M) sector. title: 【急募】カスタマーサクセス リーダー
description: ＜＜求人ポイント＞＞  ・[年収最大1,200万円／将来のマネージャー候補] 実績と成果を正当に評価し高年収を実現。成長企業のキーマンとして組織を牽引できます。  ・[顧客の成功を一気通貫でプロデュース] オンボーディングからグロース提案、解約防止まで幅広く関わり、事業成長にダイレクトに貢献できます。  ・[自社プロダクトの圧倒的競争力] SaaSとPaaSを両立した独自のECプラットフォームを武器に、圧倒的な成長領域で挑戦できます。     ■年収範囲  6,000,000 ～ 12,000,000円     ■企業概要  自社開発100％の高品質なECプラットフォームを提供する成長IT企業。SaaSとPaaSの両軸展開により、あらゆる規模のEC事業者の課題解決と売上最大化を強力に支援しています。     ■勤務地  東京都中央区（主要駅から徒歩圏内、ハイブリッドワーク導入）     ■ポジション  カスタマーサクセス リーダー（将来のマネージャー候補）     ■業務内容  自社ECプラットフォームを利用するクライアントに対し、サイト構築・導入時のオンボーディングから運用開始後の利活用推進、グロース提案（アップセル・クロスセル）、解約率改善施策の立案・実行まで一貫して担当します。また、開発や営業チームへの顧客フィードバック、担当チームのマネジメント、全社プロジェクトへの参画など、事業成長に直結する幅広い業務を担っていただきます。     ■本ポジションのやりがい  オンボーディングから成功支援まで一気通貫で伴走できるため、顧客の成長を最も近くで実感できます。部分的なサポートにとどまらず、プロダクト改善提案や全社プロジェクトへの参画、チームマネジメントなど、幅広い領域で主導権を持って成果を出せる環境です。経営陣との距離も近く、組織作りや事業拡大の最前線で自身のキャリアと市場価値を大きく飛躍させることができます。     ■募集要項  必須スキル  - カスタマーサクセスまたはカスタマーサポート部門での経験（5年以上）  - 法人営業の経験（5年以上）  - EC業務の経験（5年以上）  - Webおよびデジタルマーケティングの経験（5年以上）  - コンサルティング業界での経験（5年以上）  - SIerでのPM、PL、プリセールス経験（5年以上）  ※上記いずれかの経験を5年以上持ち、卓越した実績を出されている方

title: Salesforce Functional Lead - Saudi Arabia
description: Salesforce Functional Lead  Location: Riyadh or Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia  At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: you're only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for ambitious companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. We make this standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design and technology to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone.   We use these values to fuel superior results:     Lock Arms   We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good.   Show Hustle   We're not ones to sit on our hands and wait. We anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional.   Embrace Change   From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what's next.   Elevate Empathy   We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.   Never Settle   We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.   About The Role   We're looking for a Salesforce Functional Lead based in Saudi Arabia to shape and lead the functional design of a large-scale Salesforce programme for a major enterprise client in the Kingdom.  You'll need the confidence to lead cross-functional teams, the ability to partner with other project leads, and the client advocacy skills to manage stakeholders at every level of an organisation. You'll bring a strong passion for experience strategy, experience design and digital platform development, and a track record of running substantial client projects and driving success at account level.  You'll be at your best building today's agreed solution while also making the case for tomorrow's next step. You enjoy working through the complexity that large digital programmes bring, and you inspire and motivate your team every day to do compelling, commercially successful work. title: Apple Business - Channel Sales Lead for KSA
description: Summary  The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.  Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. Our sales team, is in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers.  At the end of the day, we are here to grow Apple’s channel business through partnering with our reseller’s sales force. We develop strategies that enable businesses to transform the way people work. To realize this goal, we build relationships, develop partner capabilities and ensure execution across the businesses. We collaborate closely with internal and external partners to create plans and programs that scale the business and adoption of the Apple ecosystem.  As our Business Channel Sales Lead in Saudi Arabia, you'll own both the strategy and the execution for one of the most important pillars of Apple's B2B growth in the Kingdom — shaping where our channel goes next, while staying close enough to the ground to get things done every day. This role is for someone who moves fast, thinks big, and is energized by ambiguity as much as by results. If you want to help build a core channel for Apple from the ground up, and leave your fingerprints on how we grow in Saudi Arabia for years to come, this is the opportunity.   Description  We develop account plans that align Apple and the partner’s growth strategies to expand adoption of the Apple ecosystem in the B2B segment.  We effectively execute on plans by cross-functionally collaborating with Sales Operations, Finance, Inside Sales, Systems Engineers, the Reseller teams and Strategic Partners.  Through working closely with our partners' sales force, we capture their hearts and minds for Apple. We use sales programs, enablement tools, and training to develop partner capabilities. We regularly assess and communicate the strength and effectiveness of the partnership.  We identify new business opportunities and support them through closure. We make certain that any client issues and/or concerns are raised and addressed. We share status, progress and facilitate sales activity across the reseller and Apple sales teams.   Responsibilities    No matter the audience, you are an expert at presenting. And, you’re cool under pressure. You make the complex simple and you command an audience by bringing them along for the journey. You empower others to learn, to be curious and ultimately, share your passion for the Apple story. title: Retail, Industrial & Mining CX Head France Iberia
description: Opportunity   Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and has been an industry pioneer for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.  At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organization reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.  With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.  Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.   We offer   This is an exciting career opportunity in an international, challenging business setting known for diversity and being a high-paced environment. You will get to focus on creating valuable relations with current and new customers and work with highly professional teams in an environment where you will be valued, recognized and well rewarded. You will work with amazing and diverse colleagues with a deep sense of commitment to live Our Values and together, go all the way for our customers, society and for each other.   Key Responsibilities   Lead the vertical portfolios of global Key Client, Enterprise Client and Strategic Clients to unleash the value of mutual partnerships for Maersk and the customer. Accountable for the function that has the most daily engagements with KC, EC and SC customer’s and their critical supply chain partners (vendors, shippers, importers, LSPs etc.). Leverage the global community of peers managing KC, EC & SC to offer unique insights to the Global Account team, and engage actively to plan, present and delivery on growth plans across the ‘by Maersk’ models.   Drive Key Client, Enterprise Client and Strategic Client CX strategy and outcomes      Actively and consistently engage with global account team (KCD, GAO and CPD) on account team plans and execution.  Actively build own and team(s) awareness and insights in customers supply chain plans and priorities.  Ensure KC, EC and SC CX drives proactive customer support and issue resolution for a seamless customer experience in cross-functional teams, and across all products in scope  Accountable to own, create, maintain and test a business continuity plan for critical customer processes in Ocean and L&S.  Participate in Account team engagements with exposure to customer stakeholders and Maersk CX account communities  Partner closely with Regional and Area leadership teams to drive strategic initiatives and Must Win Battles (MWBs), ensuring alignment between customer priorities, CX objectives and broader business goals. title: Head of Customer Success Nordics
description: MetaCompliance · Stockholm (hybrid) · Reports to VP Group Customer Operations & International Expansion (UK)       The context in short   MetaCompliance is the leading European Cyber Security Awareness platform - on an ambitious growth journey, backed by Keensight Capital. Recently acquired, Junglemap, the brand Swedish customers know and love, is now coming together with MetaCompliance's wider Nordic customer base under one portfolio, and you own that transition. title: Vi söker en chef med kund- och försäljningsansvar för konsultuppdrag i Stockholm
description: Är du en erfaren ledare med god erfarenhet av förvaltningsavtal, AFF och att leda samt driva försäljningsarbete och utveckla kundberarbetning? - Då är detta kanske något för dig!     För kunds räkning söker vi nu en chef med kund- och försäljningsansvar med start omgående, men senast början av november. Uppdraget beräknas pågå i ca 1,5 år på 100 %. Du utgår från kundens kontor som är placerat söder om Stockholms innerstad.      Om tjänsten   I uppdraget är du chef för 5 kundansvariga och spelar en nyckelroll i marknadsområdets ledningsgrupp. Rollen är både operativ och strategisk där du driver arbetet med att utveckla kundstocken och affären. Du arbetar tillsammans med hela marknadsområdet för att stärka och vidareutveckla befintliga kundrelationer och utveckla affären utifrån kunders behov.      Dina arbetsuppgifter består främst av följande:    Leda och utveckla ett team om 5 kundansvariga medarbetare.  I nära samarbete med kundansvariga, leveranschefer och övriga delar av verksamheten ansvarar du för att öka kundnöjdheten och säkerställa god lönsamhet i uppdragen.  Skapa förutsättningar för att kunderna ska välja att stanna kvar hos företaget.  Analysera kundstock, avtal och relevanta nyckeltal som grund för ett strukturerat arbete med kundbearbetning och kundvård.  Utveckla avtalsaffären med befintliga kunder, identifiera potentialer och skapa merförsäljning.  Tillsammans med teamet driva sälj- och kundaktiviteter såsom mässor, kundevent och riktade säljinsatser.  Ingå i marknadsområdets ledningsgrupp och bidra till den strategiska utvecklingen.       Kvalifikationer    Akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, marknadsföring, fastighet eller annat relevant område.  God erfarenhet av att leda tjänsteförsäljning inom fastighet.  God erfarenhet av förvaltningsavtal och kunskap inom AFF.  Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att genom ledarskap driva försäljningsarbete, utveckla kundbearbetning och skapa resultat.  Van att använda analys och insikter för att planera, prioritera och följa upp strukturerade sälj- och kundaktiviteter.  God kommunikationsförmåga i både tal och skrift.  Flera års erfarenhet av personalansvar.  Erfarenhet från fastighetsbranschen i liknande roll.  Meriterande är erfarenhet från arbete med bostadsrättsföreningar.       Personliga egenskaper   Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är affärs- och kundorienterad, lyhörd och ansvarstagande. Du drivs av att utveckla kunder och affärer och har lätt för att se nya möjligheter. Du är trygg i ditt ledarskap och har förmågan att entusiasmera och engagera andra.      Du skapar förtroende, bygger starka relationer och får med dig både kunder och kollegor. Du har ett starkt affärsmannaskap och förmågan att både tänka strategiskt och agera operativt. description: TRAINING MANAGER   In Rocco Forte Hotels ci guidano valori forti che rispecchiano la cultura della famiglia Forte e promuoviamo l’unicità delle nostre destinazioni grazie alla personalità dei nostri collaboratori. Rocco Forte Hotels è una Compagnia di alberghi di lusso, fondata da Sir Rocco Forte e sua sorella Olga Polizzi nel 1996, che ha l’obiettivo di offrire esperienze uniche e personalizzate in località europee iconiche come Roma, Firenze, Sicilia, Puglia, Regno Unito, Germania e Belgio.  Villa Igiea conta 100 camere e suite, con vista sui rigogliosi giardini e sul Golfo di Palermo. Un bellissimo Centro Benessere è a disposizione per il relax e la cura del corpo e una sala fitness per gli amanti dello sport. Completa la proprietà una piscina ad uso esclusivo degli Ospiti, ombreggiata dalla vegetazione del giardino e affacciata sul mare.    Di cosa ti occuperai?    In quanto Training Manager, sarai responsabile della pianificazione, dell'erogazione e della valutazione di una formazione di alta qualità che fornisca a tutti i Team Member le competenze e i comportamenti attesi per raggiungere l'eccellenza del servizio e gli obiettivi aziendali. Il ruolo prevede la progettazione e la gestione di percorsi formativi in diverse modalità – in presenza, online e  blended  – e la collaborazione con le parti interessate per garantire che la formazione sia tempestiva ed efficace. Erogare sessioni di formazione di onboarding e filosofia aziendale in conformità con le linee guida aziendali, garantendo un'esperienza positiva per tutti i Team Member.   Pubblicare i calendari formativi mensili e promuovere i vantaggi delle sessioni per sensibilizzare e incentivare la partecipazione.   Creare ed erogare percorsi formativi interattivi (workshop, online, brevi moduli) utilizzando i principi dell'apprendimento.   Mantenere aggiornato tutto il materiale informativo e i contenuti per i neoassunti, assicurandosi che siano coinvolgenti e in linea con la filosofia della Compagnia.   Collaborare con i Manager per garantire l'implementazione delle performance review e dei piani di sviluppo personale per i rispettivi reparti.   Comprendere gli obiettivi per il raggiungimento dell'eccellenza del servizio (LQA/Revinate) e analizzare tutti i canali di feedback degli Ospiti.   Collaborare con i responsabili della qualità, i formatori di reparto e i capi dipartimento per identificare opportunità di miglioramento e creare action plan.      Cosa ti offriamo?       Opportunità di crescita unica: offriamo

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d) | Hybrid in Freiburg🌄
description:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung

Experience using  AI tools . title: Service & Logistics Manager, Outbound & Trading

You will play a key role in developing and harmonizing our outbound operations across markets, improving processes, tools and ways of working. At the same time, you will build a collaborative team culture where people share knowledge and best practices to continuously improve performance.  This is a great opportunity to combine people leadership, operational excellence and international process development in a role with real impact.  With our current Outbound Logistics leader transitioning to a new challenge within the organization, we are looking for a passionate and results-driven professional to lead the function and help take our logistics performance to the next level. We welcome candidates with strong functional expertise and proven leadership skills who are ready to grow into a people management role with direct reports.  Drive operational performance and customer excellence by monitoring KPIs, service levels and targets, identifying improvement opportunities and ensuring a smooth order-to-delivery process.  Participate in carrier and LSP partnerships, including performance follow-up, escalations, contract negotiations and implementation of new carriers.  Develop and harmonize Trading Sales fulfillment processes across the Nordic countries and Paris JV, identifying gaps and driving improvements in ways of working, tools and systems. We need someone who can keep on top of it all, permanently. title: Technical Manager and Projects
description: Hvis du motiveres af at være den person, der kan samle teknik, projekter, salg og HQ – og hvis du trives med at have fingrene nede i teknikken samtidig med, at du holder det store overblik – så kan dette være den rigtige næste rolle for dig.      For vores klient Georg Fischer A/S søger vi en stærk og struktureret profil til en rolle som ”Technical Manager og Projects” ansvarlig.      Du får en helt central rolle på tværs af teknik, projekter og salg   Fra Georg Fischer A/S´ kontor i Roskilde bliver dit stærke overblik og din evne til at skabe struktur helt afgørende for din succes i rollen. Du skal sikre fremdrift i projekterne, involvere de rette personer på det rette tidspunkt og sørge for, at relevant information bliver omsat og koordineret mellem salg, teknik, kunde og HQ.     Det er en rolle for dig, der trives med mange bolde i luften, kan holde det store overblik og samtidig har teknisk forståelse nok til at gå ned i detaljen, når det er nødvendigt.     Du bliver en central person i organisationen og det naturlige tekniske og projektmæssige bindeled mellem virksomhedens eksterne og interne salg, kunder, rådgivere og HQ i Schweiz.     Du får det overordnede projektmæssige og tekniske overblik på tværs af Danmark – ansvaret bliver stort og omfatter bl.a.:   Teknisk sparring til salgsorganisationen  Projektkoordinering på tværs af Danmark  Kontakt og koordinering med HQ i Schweiz  Teknisk afklaring med kunder, rådgivere og samarbejdspartnere  Koordinering af større projekter fra idé til løsning  Sammen med salgschefen sikre fremdrift i projekter og opgaver       Din baggrund   Vi forestiller os, at du har en ingeniør- eller maskinmesterbaggrund – alternativt en anden relevant teknisk uddannelse eller erfaring, der giver dig en stærk forståelse for tekniske systemer, installationer og projekter.     Har du erfaring med kølesystemer til datacentre, er det en klar fordel.     Du skal have en solid forståelse for plastrørsystemer og de komponenter, der får et komplet system til at fungere, herunder at kunne forstå samspillet mellem:    Rørsystem → ventil → aktuator → styring → proces.       Du skal derfor have erfaring med – ventiler, aktuatorer og deres funktion i komplette systemløsninger.     En vigtig del af rollen bliver at kunne forstå og udføre relevante tekniske beregninger. Du skal kunne forstå tallene og bruge dem til at træffe de rigtige tekniske beslutninger.     På IT-siden SKAL du have erfaring med SAP og være stærk i Excel. Du taler og skriver engelsk ubesværet – kan du tysk er det en fordel men ikke et krav.      Dig som person   Vi forventer ikke, at du kan alt. Faktisk forventer vi, at du ikke kan alt. Til gengæld skal du have en stærk lyst til at lære.     Du skal være typen, der tænker:  “Det har jeg ikke arbejdet med før – men det skal jeg nok få styr på.”     Du skal kunne sætte dig ind i nye produkter, teknologier, beregningsmetoder og applikationer – og derefter omsætte din nye viden til noget, resten af organisatione

title: Appointment Setter / Inside Sales
description:
Headquarters:  Tampa, Florida USA
      URL:   https://www.elementalclaims.com 
 

 We are looking for a confident, highly fluent English-speaking  Appointment Setter  to join our  public adjusting firm . 
 We work with homeowners throughout the United States who may need assistance  filing and navigating property insurance claims . Your primary responsibility will be communicating with potential clients who have already responded to our outreach. 
 You will use our proven system to answer text messages, qualify interested homeowners, make calls when necessary, and schedule appointments for our field representatives/public adjusters. 
  What you'll be doing:  
 • Responding to homeowners who engage with our outreach regarding potential property insurance claims
• Speaking with homeowners who may need assistance filing an insurance claim for damage to their property
• Calling interested or potentially interested homeowners when needed
• Following our existing scripts and proven appointment-setting system
• Answering basic questions and handling objections naturally
• Qualifying potential clients and identifying homeowners who may have a valid reason to file a property insurance claim
• Scheduling qualified appointments for our field representatives/public adjusters
• Updating leads and appointments inside our CRM 
  Who we're looking for:  
  Near native American spoken English is REQUIRED.  
 We are specifically looking for someone who is extremely comfortable communicating with American customers and understands U.S. conversational culture. You should be able to have a natural conversation rather than simply read from a script. 
 You do  NOT  need to live in the United States. 
 Experience working with U.S. customers is strongly preferred. Previous experience in appointment setting, outbound sales, call centers, roofing, insurance, public adjusting, real estate, home improvement, or other U.S. home-service industries is a major plus. 
 You should be: 
 • Confident on the phone
• Persuasive without being overly aggressive
• Comfortable handling objections
• Reliable and consistent
• Comfortable using a CRM and learning new software
• Able to follow a system while still sounding natural
• Available during U.S. business hours 
  Compensation:  
 This position offers a  $1,000 monthly base salary plus performance-based commission.  
 In addition to the base salary, you will earn  $200 for every lead that results in a signed client.  
 Our performance expectation is approximately  10 signed clients per month . At that level, compensation would be: 
 • Base Salary:  $1,000/month 
• 10 Signed Clients × $200:  $2,000 commission 
• Expected Total Monthly Compensation:  $3,000  
 There is no set limit on commission—the more qualified leads you convert into signed clients, the more you can earn. 
 We provide the leads, systems, scripts, and workflow. Your responsibility is to communicate with homeowners, identify and qualify potential clients

description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE ROLE


En lien direct avec le studio de création, vous traduisez les croquis et les intentions du directeur artistique en volumes et en premiers patronages. Vous êtes garant(e) de la silhouette, des proportions et du bien-aller des pièces de la Maison.

Backed by $11M from senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, and DeepMind, White Circle processes 100M+ API calls monthly and runs its own LLMs in production.

You will

  • Build scalable RL and post-training pipelines, including smoke tuning runs for quality testing and ablations.

  • Design data control systems for rollouts, replay, filtering, evaluation, and policy updates.

  • Tune training and inference end-to-end for throughput: networking, memory, scheduling, data loading, storage, checkpointing, I/O.

  • Build infrastructure for model iteration (experiment runs, artifacts, evals, dashboards, reproducibility, cost visibility) and inference infrastructure for post-training and eval loops.

  • Build agentic development environments: coding-agent harnesses, tool integrations, runtime sandboxes, multi-agent orchestration.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience designing and running distributed RL/post-training systems at scale (rollouts, replay buffers, reward signals, policy updates, eval loops).

  • Strong Python (concurrency, async, multiprocessing, performance optimization) and PyTorch or JAX.

  • Debugging distributed GPU workloads across CUDA, drivers, containers, NCCL, networking, storage, and checkpointing.

  • Profiling across the stack (py-spy, PyTorch profiler, Nsight, perf, tracing).

title: QA Engineer
description:
We're looking for a QA Engineer to join White Circle, an AI Safety company building the policy enforcement and optimization layer for AI systems. Backed by $11M from senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, and DeepMind, White Circle processes 100M+ API calls monthly and runs its own LLMs in production. This is a manual-first product QA role, with automation as a key tool.

You will

  • Manually test new features and fixes across the web platform and APIs in fast release cycles, sometimes as short as one working day.

  • Identify the highest-risk areas, run exploratory, smoke, regression, and integration testing, and give clear release feedback.

  • Write concise test plans and checklists, investigate unexpected behavior, and file reproducible bug reports.

  • Work with engineers and product owners to clarify requirements and improve testability before development is complete.

  • Automate stable, business-critical flows with Playwright and Python, and integrate them into CI/CD.

Requirements

  • 2+ years in QA automation, including building frameworks from scratch.

  • Strong Playwright experience for E2E UI testing and scalable test suite design.

  • Clean Python automation code (pytest, fixtures, parametrize).

  • Hands-on CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar).

  • Practical use of AI coding agents and LLM-powered developer tools in testing workflows.

description:

You will be tasked with proactive outbound prospecting and managing inbound leads. Given the technical nature of our product, a high technical aptitude is crucial to understand and articulate the value proposition effectively to potential clients. This role demands a combination of technical understanding, sales acumen, and relationship-building skills to drive significant impact and contribute to the company's success.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Proactively build, qualify, and close a new logo sales pipeline, ensuring you meet or exceed quota and drive steady bookings growth.

  • Be responsible for outbound motions to create pipeline.

  • Strategically prospect into Network Engineering management & technical end users, understanding their unique challenges and requirements.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with prospects using a consultative sales approach, leading to increased trust and deal velocity.

  • Work on both the acquisition of net new customers and the revenue expansion of existing customer accounts.

  • Work with the Channel team to develop indirect opportunities.

  • Work with the Customer Success team for expansion into existing accounts.

title: Responsable Déploiement / Implementation Manager
description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

 

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

 

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

 

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations

Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.

L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Nous accompagnons chaque hôpital de A à Z dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.

title: Group Cost Controller
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Group Cost Controller at Harmattan AI, you will take ownership of the Group’s Industrial, R&D & other operational costing, working closely with the FP&A Manager to structure, develop, and continuously improve Industrial P&L, Cost performance monitoring, and decision-support capabilities across multiple entities.

The role combines hands-on analytical execution with higher-level structuring responsibilities, including Industrial P&L creation & development, Industrial & R&D cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and KPI definition.

Responsibilities

  • Build the industrial P&L and the costing framework. Create the industrial P&L, define the standard cost calculation methodology, and set up the performance tracking processes that go with it.

  • Monitor and challenge production and inventory performance. Track production costs, inventory levels and variances, identify deviations early, and work with operations to close them.

Unternehmen nutzen unsere Plattform, um kurzfristig einsatzbereite Mitarbeitende in Echtzeit zu buchen, während Studierende unsere App nutzen, um Nebenjobs zu finden, die sich optimal mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Studierende und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen großen deutschen Städten teilen unseren Glauben daran, dass gute Arbeit kein Zufall ist. Sie ist das Ergebnis innovativer Technologie und echter Leidenschaft. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier.

Als (Senior) Enterprise Sales & Partner Manager verantwortest die Akquise, den Aufbau und die Entwicklung strategischer Enterprise Kunden und Partnerschaften in diesem Segment.

Du spielst die zentrale Rolle in unserem Vertrieb für dein Vertical. Die Rolle ist spannend und abwechslungsreich, da du sowohl als Hunter als auch als Farmer tätig bist. Mit deiner Sales Power hilfst du dabei, neue Großkunden und Partnerschaften zu akquirieren und entwickelst diese gemeinsam mit dem Account Management deines Verticals weiter und rollst sie national aus. Du arbeitest eigenständig und entwickelst sowie verantwortest deine Vertriebsstrategie in deinem Segment.

description:

Vos missions

  • Assurer une étude scientifique rigoureuse, visant à comparer les performances des modèles VLM sur la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes.

Activités principales

Le sujet traite de la problématique générale de la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes dans l’industrie. L’industrie doit se doter d’outils d’inspection de confiance rapidement déployables en production. Les solutions d’IA supervisées les plus performantes reposent sur une activité préalable longue et coûteuses d’étiquetage d’images par des experts-process (plusieurs centaines d’étiquetages d’images). title: Growth Intern - Automation & AI (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

We are growing this team while it delivers, on a platform with real history, and some of what we currently believe will turn out to be wrong. The incumbent HR suites are consolidating and buying their way into this space, so the clock is real. 

The problem underneath it is genuinely unsolved. Nobody has built software that knows what a person needs to be able to do next week, teaches it in the few minutes they actually have, and observes whether it landed without asking them. Not the language apps, which have the habit but not the stakes. Not the platforms, which have the content but not the attention. Not the HR suites, which have the data but have never made anything a person voluntarily opens. 

If that sounds like a problem worth several years, we should talk. 

As our Senior Product Manager for the learner experience, you own the surface where learning actually happens, for the person actually doing it. It is the most visible product role in the company, because everything else in our strategy depends on somebody coming back on a Tuesday. Today weekly active learners sits close to one percent. That number is the job.

title: Sales Success Specialist (B2B)
description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Success Team

Thumbtack is the leading marketplace platform connecting customers with local professionals for all their project and service needs.

We are a rapidly growing organization looking for highly motivated individuals to join us in scaling our success team. Our culture prides itself on diversity and inclusion and our mission is to empower independent pros to grow their businesses, and that's where you come in.

 

About the role

As a Success Specialist, you'll be on the front lines, helping our pros unlock their full potential and build thriving businesses on Thumbtack. It's all about being a strategic partner and champion for our pros. You'll be the ultimate guide for our pros, helping them navigate their journey to success. We're looking for someone who is not just great at building rapport but is also a consultative partner who can dive deep into a pro's business, marketing strategy, and growth goals. Your day will be packed with high-impact activities building trust and loyalty and driving revenue and departmental goals.

 

What you’ll do

  • Partner with our pros on our platform by listening to their needs and providing the best solutions - you’re the expert! Pro satisfaction and longevity will be your #1 priority.

  • Maintain excellent knowledge of Thumbtack’s products and services, as well as industry standards and best practices for home maintenance and repairs and other service industries.

  • Participate in at least 50 outbound interactions per day with our pros to determine the best solution to help them get hired. This can include using tools such as AI to optimize their accounts.

  • Successfully build rapport with the pros and be able to anticipate their needs and long term business goals.

  • Conduct comprehensive profile reviews, guiding pros through key areas like response time, reviews, profile pictures, and quick replies to help them shine. You’ll encourage them to complete product recommendations and set competitive budgets, setting them up for success.

  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell additional products or services to existing pros.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About Dutchie

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

As a Business Development Representative on our outbound team, you'll find and open doors with dispensaries that haven't discovered Dutchie yet. You'll build target lists, run sequences, and start conversations that turn into qualified meetings for our Account Executives and Account Managers. To succeed here, you'll need to be curious about the businesses you're prospecting into, resourceful when a first attempt doesn't land, and genuinely energized by the grind of top-of-funnel outbound — the volume, the research, the follow-up.

This role sits on a strong, growing sales team and comes with real coaching and mentorship as you ramp. You'll need to move comfortably across systems and adapt quickly as our outbound motion takes shape — prioritizing the accounts and activities that create the most pipeline. Your success will be rooted in consistent activity, sharp messaging, and a coachable mindset that keeps improving week over week.

  • Multi-Channel Outreach: Run cold and warm outreach across call, email, and social, using the Dutchie Revenue Playbook to deliver consistent, proof-point-driven messaging that resonates with dispensary owners and operators.
  • Meeting Generation: Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and Account Managers, and manage a clean handoff so context and momentum aren't lost.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once – from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools that sit at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll work on making sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets to hit our goals, help allocate those levers across markets, and dig into problem areas to find and fix root causes. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations – one for someone who's as comfortable building a model as they are diving into why a specific market is off plan.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations & courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

title: Customer Success Manager - Finland
description: Are you someone who enjoys guiding customers, solving complex challenges, and driving both operational and commercial results?    As a Customer Success Manager at Staria, you’ll take the lead for our ERP customers – ensuring seamless service delivery, strengthening collaboration, and unlocking new opportunities for growth. If you thrive on building strong customer partnerships and long-term value, this role offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact for our customers’ success.    What It’s All About   Staria’s ERP Continuous Services help growth‑driven companies keep their NetSuite environments running smoothly, efficiently, and in a way that supports their business goals. Our services cover everything from day‑to‑day operational support and ticket coordination to long‑term roadmap planning, development initiatives, and proactive value creation – all tailored to each customer’s evolving needs.  Here, you’ll join a team of Customer Success Managers, working closely with our Head of Customer Success in the daily operations and with our Head of Continuous Services on more complex cases and development initiatives. Alongside key account executives, service delivery teams, project managers, and colleagues across different functions, you’ll help deliver seamless, high‑quality ERP services that drive customer satisfaction and long‑term growth.   Journey that awaits you   As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll lead a portfolio of 20–25 ERP customers, ensuring service delivery stays on track, expectations are clear, and collaboration flows effortlessly. You’ll bring structure to complex setups, align stakeholders, and help customers get the full value out of their NetSuite investment.  In this role, you will take ownership of the commercial development of your accounts, identifying upsell and cross‑sell opportunities, advising customers on new features, and strengthening the long‑term growth and profitability of your portfolio. Whether it’s coordinating delivery teams, managing escalations, or uncovering new ways to create value, you’ll be the strategic partner who keeps everything moving in the right direction.  In addition to leading customer relationships and service delivery, you'll also work directly with customers in a hands-on advisory capacity, helping them develop their NetSuite environment. A significant part of the role involves delivering billable customer work, with approximately 50% of your time spent on advisory and development activities such as roadmap planning, issue resolution, and value‑adding analysis.  Another exciting part of this role is the timing: you’d be joining just as our Continuous Services model is evolving. Instead of stepping into a rigid setup, you’ll join at a moment where ways of working, collaboration models, and customer success practices are actively being refined. You’ll therefore have the space and trust to influence and put your mark on how we operate and shape the customer journey.  In practice

Nos 125 collaborateurs assurent le confort de toute la Normandie. title: CX Planning Manager
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     토스씨엑스의 CX Planning Team에 속해있으며, 계열사별 각 계열사·도메인의 CX 운영을 계획 기반으로 선제 대응하는 팀이에요.  서비스 운영지표(SLA, CSAT 등)를 분석하고, 문제 구조화 → 실행 설계 → 성과 측정의 사이클을 주도해요.  주요 상담 데이터를 적재·분석해 각 계열사의 안정적인 상담 운영을 지원하고, 고객사 만족과 지속적인 동반 성장을 위한 전략을 기획·실행해요.       합류하면 함께할 업무예요      1️⃣ 고객 문의 데이터를 기반으로 CX 운영 구조의 비효율을 진단하고 개선해요.    VOC, 문의유형, 리드타임 등 데이터를 분석해 인입 구조의 문제를 발견하고, 반복·오류 문의의 원인을 분류해 개선 우선순위를 설정해요.   2️⃣ 계열사별 CX·운영 이슈에 대한 실행 전략을 구체화하고, 운영 환경·정책·시스템을 개선해 문의량 자체를 줄이는 프로젝트를 주도해요.    상담 프로세스, 어드민 기능, 정책 개선을 통해 문의 유입을 차단하고, FAQ·챗봇·자동응답 등 고객 자가처리 경험을 향상시켜요.  운영 개선 관련 커뮤니케이션 및 프로젝트를 리딩해요.   3️⃣ 각 계열사 전담팀 리더와 협업하며, 데이터로 발견한 문제를 화면 플로우·기능 정의서 등 프로덕트팀이 이해할 수 있는 형태로 구체화해 제품 기능과 정책에 반영해요.    작고 큰 이슈를 함께 대응하고, 선행적인 대응 체계를 수립해나가요.   4️⃣ 다양한 이해관계자와 주도적으로 커뮤니케이션하고, 공감대를 바탕으로 전략 실행력을 확보해요.      이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     5년 이상의 CX 경력을 바탕으로 고객 여정, 상담 흐름, 인입 구조 등에 대한 높은 이해도를 갖추신 분이 필요해요.  문제 해결 과정을 화면 기획, 플로우차트, 와이어프레임 등 시각적 형태로 구조화해 프로덕트팀과 소통해본 경험이 있는 분이 필요해요.  운영 비효율을 데이터 기반으로 진단하고, 정량적 개선 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있는 분이 필요해요.  복잡한 상황을 구조적으로 정리하고 명확하게 커뮤니케이션할 수 있는 역량을 갖춘 분이 필요해요.  제품·정책 조직과 협업해 운영 개선을 시스템화·정책화한 경험이 있는 분이면 좋아요.  100명 이상 규모의 CX 조직에서 운영기획·서비스기획·VOC 개선 프로젝트를 주도해본 경험이 있는 분이면 좋아요.  단순 분석을 넘어 '문제정의 → 개선실행 → 효과검증'까지의 완결된 개선 사이클 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     데이터 분석을 기반으로 문제를 정의하고, 개선을 실행해 성과를 만든 사례가 있다면 구체적으로 작성해주세요.  제품팀·정책팀·운영팀 등과의 협업 과정에서 역할·기여·커뮤니케이션 방식을 명확히 적어주시면 좋아요.  문제를 화면/프로세스 개선안으로 구체화해 제안하고 실제 반영까지 이어간 경험이 있다면, 어떤 형태(기획서, 플로우차트, 와이어프레임 등)로 커뮤니케이션했는지 함께 적어주시면 좋아요.  우선순위를 조정하며 효율적으로 프로젝트를 수행한 경험도 함께 작성해주시면 좋아요.       토스씨엑스로의 합류 여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격 및 입사  장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요.       꼭 확인해 주세요     신도림 본사에서 근무하는 포지션이에요. (신도림역 디큐브시티)  이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  토스씨엑스 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소 될 수 있어요.       함께할 동료를 위한 한마디      "회사의 올바른 결정을 위해 데이터에 기반하여 문제를 도출 및 해결할 수 있어요."    다양한 의견을 조율해 하나의 목표를 향한 액션 아이템을 도출해 나가고, 팀 목표 달성을 위한 프로젝트를 기획하고 추진할 수 있어요. 특히 기획 단계부터 실행하는 과정까지 모든 직군과 소통하면서 신선한 원팀 의식을 느낄 수 있고요. 기획 전략부터 인사/재무 전략까지 팀을 위한 다양한 전략을 기획하고 참여해 보세요.

title: CX & Quality Manager
description: Atlantigo es un grupo de empresas que conforman una solución integral para construir el futuro de los riesgos de viaje.      Intermundial: líderes en distribución de seguros de viaje y gadget.  Servisegur: expertos en servicios asociados al seguro de viaje.  Mana: experiencia e innovación en la gestión del riesgo turístico.  Tourism & Law: asesoramiento legal preventivo para empresas turísticas.      Este es el propósito que, desde hace más de 30 años, nos impulsa a seguir trabajando, innovando, aprendiendo y creciendo para crear las soluciones más completas de riesgos de viaje, que potencien el sector del turismo y garanticen al viajero una experiencia única.     Actualmente estamos buscando un Buscamos incorporar un/a  CX & Quality Manager  para liderar la función corporativa de Customer Experience y Calidad del Grupo.  La posición tendrá dependencia directa de Dirección General y asumirá la responsabilidad de definir, desarrollar y consolidar el modelo corporativo de Customer Experience y Calidad, integrando la voz del cliente, el análisis de datos y el conocimiento de la operación para identificar oportunidades de mejora, impulsar iniciativas transversales y garantizar la medición de su impacto.  Se trata de una posición de carácter estratégico y transversal, con capacidad de interlocución con las principales áreas de la organización y con responsabilidad sobre la evolución del modelo de CX y Calidad a nivel corporativo.     Principales responsabilidades     Estrategia y gobierno de Customer Experience y Calidad   Definir y desarrollar la estrategia corporativa de Customer Experience y Calidad, alineada con la estrategia y prioridades del Grupo.  Establecer estándares, metodologías, indicadores y modelos de seguimiento para la gestión de CX y Calidad.  Diseñar y mantener un roadmap corporativo de iniciativas, estableciendo prioridades, responsables, plazos e indicadores de impacto.  Coordinar el gobierno transversal de las iniciativas de CX y Calidad y realizar el seguimiento de su evolución.  Liderar la interlocución con las diferentes áreas de negocio y elevar a Dirección General los principales riesgos, oportunidades y decisiones requeridas.  Promover una cultura de mejora continua y orientación al cliente en el conjunto de la organización.      Voz del cliente, análisis y reporting ejecutivo   Integrar y analizar las diferentes fuentes de información relacionadas con la experiencia del cliente: NPS, encuestas, reclamaciones, reseñas, incidencias, Speech Analytics, métricas operativas y observación directa.  Identificar tendencias, fricciones y oportunidades de mejora mediante el análisis cuantitativo y cualitativo.  Profundizar en las causas de los problemas detectados y contrastar las hipótesis antes de formular recomendaciones.  Segmentar la información por servicios, canales, productos, mercados y perfiles de cliente, cuando resulte relevante.  Elaborar informes y presentaciones ejecutivas orientados a la toma de decisiones.

title: Team Manager Customer Success | SMB (Milan)
description: At   Lexroom   we set the bar for legal AI - clear, fast, and built for trust.   In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by  thousands of legal professionals across Europe .  Our mission is clear:  make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable , giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.  We’re scaling rapidly, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team dedicated to rigor, clarity, and impact.  Today, Lexroom is a  trusted partner , shaping the future of legal AI with discipline and purpose.   Why   Lexroom  ?     Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.   Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.   Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.     At  Lexroom , we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts:  a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.   The Role  We are looking for a  Customer Success Team Manager (SMB)  to lead and scale our high-velocity SMB Customer Success engine.  In this role, you will take full ownership of our SMB CS execution: driving account health, optimizing scalable customer journeys, and building a high-performing team in the legal AI space. You will report directly to CS Leadership and work closely with cross-functional teams to maximize customer retention and expansion.  Key Responsibilities    Strategy & Execution: Own and execute bottom-up retention, adoption, and expansion strategies for a high-volume, fragmented SMB account base.   Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and coach team members to achieve target health, retention, and growth metrics (NRR, GRR).   Playbook Optimization: Build and refine scalable onboarding, engagement, and renewal playbooks tailored to thousands of legal professionals.   Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Enterprise CS, Customer Care, Product, and Sales to refine customer feedback loops and align go-to-market efforts.   Data-Driven Insights: Monitor account health signals, usage patterns, and churn risks to proactively implement retention and cross-sell initiatives.     What We Are Looking For    1–2 years of experience as a Team Lead or People Manager in B2B Customer Success.   SMB SaaS Expertise: Proven track record in B2B SaaS managing high-volume, fragmented SMB customer bases at scale.   Hybrid CS & Commercial Mindset: Strong balance between driving customer value/product adoption and owning commercial metrics (NRR, expansion, renewals).   Collaborative Leadership: A peer-partnership mindset focused on supporting team execution, removing roadblocks, and fostering professional growth.   Language Skills: Fluency in both English and Italian (spoken and written).

title: Customer Acquisition & Growth Sales Manager
description: Do you know how to turn customer insight into commercial results?   As customer expectations evolve and new technologies create new opportunities, Fortum is strengthening how we acquire, serve and grow our customer base.  We are looking for a Manager, Customer Acquisition & Growth to lead the development of our sales channels and commercial partnerships in Norway, driving growth through strong commercial execution, customer insight and data-driven decision making.
