In Norway, you will play a key role in making that happen.  As Manager, Customer Acquisition & Growth, you will be responsible for developing our sales channels and partnerships and driving commercial performance across our B2B business. A key part of the role is to continuously develop how we reach and serve customers as their needs and expectations change. title: Mid-Market Account Success Manager – Cyber Security
description: About Accenture   Accenture helps organizations not only win with technology—but realize value from it. Our cyber security practice combines global delivery, advanced tooling, and deep expertise to ensure lasting client outcomes.  Within the  Mid-Market Cyber Security team , Account Success Management is critical—ensuring every client engagement delivers measurable value while unlocking growth opportunities across the portfolio. title: Customer Success Manager
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     토스뱅크 Customer Success Manager는 Customer Experience Team의 구성원으로서 함께 할 예정이에요.  Customer Experience Team은 토스뱅크 상담 경험 개선을 위한 정책을 수립하고 운영하고 있어요.  만족스러운 고객경험을 위한 운영 전략을 수립하고, VOC 분석을 통해 고객의 문제를 해결하고 있어요.  VOC 유형을 분석하여 Pain-Point를 도출하고 개선하는 역할을 하고 있어요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요      VOC 통역가로 불리며 서비스를 고객의 언어로 전달하고, 고객의 언어를 제품팀의 언어로 번역해서 전달해요.  은행 업무에 대한 전문적인 지식을 바탕으로, 고객 상담을 위한 가이드라인 및 Q&A 등을 제작하여, 상담 팀원과 AI 상담원이 프로페셔널하게 상담할 수 있도록 가이드해요.  채팅 AI , 유선상담의 QA 기준과 평가항목을 설계하고 특성에 맞는 QA 체계를 기획해요.  AI QA 품질을 점검하고, 지식· 응대 로직 등 개선 요건을 도출해 제품팀과 협업해요.  QA 결과를 바탕으로 고객센터 대상 피드백과 교육방향 수립 등을 통해 응대 품질을 지속적으로 향상시켜요.  상담시스템 개발 및 기획요건을 도출하고 제품팀과 협업하여 기능을 개선해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     금융 상품의 도메인 지식과 상품기획 부서와의 협업 경험을 3 년 이상 가지고 계신 분이 필요해요.  채팅상담   AICC 를 통한 고객상담 프로세스에 대해 전반적인 이해가 있으신 분이 필요해요.  상담 품질관리(QA) 기준을 직접 설계하거나 평가  분석해 본 경험이 있다면 좋아요.  도급사 SLA(Service Level Agreement) 운영을 통한 고객센터 효율화를 이뤄내신 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요.  SQL 및 SAS, Python, R 등 통계 Tool 을 활용해 직접 데이터를 추출하고, 분석할 수 있는 역량이 있다면 더 좋아요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     토스뱅크 Customer Success Manager 에 지원한 동기와 합류 후 목표에 대해 구체적으로 소개해주시면 좋아요.  금융상품을 다뤄본 업무 경험과 이해도에 자세하게 기재해주세요. (특정 영역의 강점이 있다면 구체적으로 작성해주세요. / 예: 신용카드 교육 업무 3 년)  상담품질 관리나 응대 평가·분석을 경험한 적이 있다면, 어떤 기준으로 무엇을 개선했는지 구체적으로 작성해주세요.  고객관점에서 문제를 발견하고, 개선까지 이끌어 낸 경험이 있다면 구체적으로 작성해주세요.       토스뱅크로의 합류 여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격 및 입사       꼭 확인해주세요     이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우, 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  토스뱅크 내부규정상 결격사유 해당자 또는 금융기관 인력 채용 상 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요.       함께 할 동료를 위한 한마디   "토스뱅크 고객센터는 최고의 앱 경험이 고객상담에도 이어지고, 고객의 궁금증을 사전에 감소시켜 고객의 소중한 시간을 아끼고 있어요."    은행의 여러 상품의 기획 단계에 참여하여 고객이 불편한 지점을 미리 찾아서 반영하고, 출시 후에 발생하는 문제들을 빠르게 개선하고 있어요.  고객과 가장 가까운 곳에서 여러 문제를 해결하며 하루하루 발전되는 경험을 하고 있어요. 은행 도메인의 A~Z까지 경험하고 싶다면, 망설이지 말고 토스뱅크에 합류하세요!

title: Serviceleder til Bygningsautomatik
location: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du spille en central rolle i at sikre, at vores medarbejdere, kunder og opgaver når sikkert i mål? Har du erfaring med bygningsautomatik og trives du med at skabe struktur, motivere kollegaer og have både drift og udvikling for øje? Så kan denne mulighed være lige noget for dig.   Til vores BMS-afdeling i Odense søger vi en Serviceleder, der kan være med til at sikre, at Bravidas vækstplan lykkes, samtidig med at der leveres en høj kvalitet på opgaveløsningen. Du bliver en del af et stærkt specialistmiljø med en kultur, hvor man støtter hinanden, deler viden og er stolte af sit fag. Du får en nøglerolle i at sikre, at både kunder og teknikere oplever en struktureret, professionel og tryg hverdag.   Dine arbejdsopgaver   Du får en bred og varieret rolle, hvor du både arbejder tæt på kunderne og tæt på teknikerne. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:    Bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling og vækst af BMS-forretningen.  Ansvaret for kunder og leverancer af mindre installations- og serviceopgaver.  Håndtering og godkendelse af salgsopgaver i samarbejde med BMS salgsteam  Ansvaret for aftalers og opgavers økonomiske resultater, tekniske kvalitet og dokumentation.  Håndtere ordremodtagelse, materialebestillinger og indkøb.  Håndtering af kundehenvendelser på både mail og telefon samt opsøgende dialog om nye opgaver.  Faglig sparring og teknisk støtte til dine tekniker.  Bidrage til udvikling af teamet og afdelingens faglige niveau.     Hvem er du?   Vi forestiller os, at    Du har 1-2 års erfaring med bygningsautomatik (BMS/CTS), og gerne at du har en vis erfaring med ledelse og/eller koordinering af servicearbejde.  Du er udadvendt, tillidsskabende og god til at opbygge relationer både internt og eksternt.  Du er resultatorienteret og kan sætte mål både på kort og langt sigt.  Du har mod på at udvikle dig og dygtiggøre dig i et stærkt fagligt miljø.  Du kan tage fat og støtte op om serviceopgaver på samme niveau som teknikerne, når det kræves.  Du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes – det er et krav til stillingen.     Vi tilbyder   Hos Bravida bliver du en del af Nordens førende leverandør af tekniske installations- og serviceydelser. Du indgår i et stærkt og erfarent BMS-team, hvor faglig stolthed og samarbejde er i centrum. Stillingen giver stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge en afdeling i fortsat udvikling, samtidig med at du får adgang til et professionelt netværk på tværs af fag og regioner, hvor sparring altid er tæt på. Kulturen er præget af høj fokus på trivsel, sikkerhed og fællesskab, og der er gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling. Derudover tilbyder vi løn efter kvalifikationer, pension, forsikring og andre goder på konkurrencedygtige vilkår samt firmabil ordning.   Interesseret?   Vil du høre mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingsleder Michael Korsbæk på mobil 2525 3520 eller på michael.korsbak@bravida.dk   Ansøgning:   Hvis du allerede nu kan se dig selv i ovenstående, så upload dit CV snarest

Työssäsi pääset loistamaan kentällä: toimit 15 työntekijän esihenkilönä, johdat ja innostat tiimiäsi kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita, ennakoit ja varmistat työturvallisuuden sekä huolehdit alueesi resursoinnista. Työsi on monipuolista – teet aktiivista asiakasyhteistyötä, kehität palvelun laatua ja varmistat huoltotöiden sujuvuuden. Tapaat sekä tiimiläisiäsi että asiakkaita kohteissa viikoittain, joten työssä yhdistyy ihmisten kohtaaminen ja käytännön tekeminen. Kenttätyön rinnalla hallitset tuotannonohjausjärjestelmiä, sähköisiä huoltokirjoja sekä viestintää sähköpostien ja Office 365 -työkalujen avulla. Johdat työtäsi ja tiimiäsi napakasti, mutta ihmislähtöisesti. Otat luontevasti ja oma-aloitteisesti haltuun oman vastuualueesi, mutta loistat myös tiimityössä ja nautit yhteistyöstä tiiviin tiimin kanssa. Monipuolinen osaaminen ja kokemus kiinteistöalalta antaa vahvan pohjan tehtävässä onnistumiselle. Sinulla on jo useamman vuoden kokemus kiinteistöhuollon tehtävistä sekä alalle soveltuva koulutus (esim. kiinteistöpalvelualan AT/EAT, LV, LVI tai sähkö). Olet kerryttänyt aikaisempaa kokemusta tulosvastuullisesta esihenkilötyöstä ja operatiivisen arjen johtamisesta – omaat vahvaa taloudellista ymmärrystä sekä osaamista nykyaikaisista it-välineistä johtamisesi tukena. Ajokortti on välttämätön, sillä vietät osan työajasta kentällä. Tehtävässä vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, englannin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi. Fluency in Finnish is a requirement for this position.        Tarjolla on seuraavat edut ja mahdollisuudet:      Luotealla pääset kasvamaan ja kehittymään – sekä kiinteistöalan asiantuntijana että lähijohtajana. Meillä jokainen päivä on mahdollisuus oppia uutta ja tehdä asiat vähän fiksummin kuin eilen.       Saat ympärillesi huipputiimin: mahtavia kollegoita, tiimiläisiä ja asiakkaita, joiden kanssa yhteistyö sujuu mutkattomasti. Tukenasi on esihenkilö, joka sparraa ja auttaa aina kun tarvitset.       Näet kiinteistöpalvelualan kokonaisuuden pintaa syvemmältä. Pääset tutustumaan toimintoihimme ja laajentamaan ymmärrystäsi liiketoiminnasta.       Työsi on monipuolista ja mielenkiintoista. title: Operations Manager, Customer Care
description: As Operations Manager, Customer Care, you'll run and improve pony’s customer care teams, operations and systems.  You will keep ticket volumes under control, reduce resolution time and cost without compromising quality, and build a leaner, more automated Customer Care operation. You will own the team’s workflows, capacity planning, tools, knowledge base and response guidelines, as well as the performance of our internal agents and external human and AI partners. You will also build a systematic way to identify recurring user issues and work with other teams to reduce how often they happen.  Pony handles 20,000+ Customer Care tickets every month across 24 European cities. This gives you a large operational playground for testing new processes, improving quality and building AI processes and agents that can resolve cases end-to-end.  This is a hands-on position with full ownership of Customer Care operations. You will manage a team of 4 and coordinate our external partners, it can be a first management role. A big part of the job is building processes and systems, while staying close to the day-to-day operation.  You will report to Grégoire, Head of Operations, and work closely with Product, Tech and Data. The Customer Care team keeps riders moving, 24/7.  Main Responsibilities   Run the operation     Keep ticket volumes and backlog under control and within objectives    Plan staffing, capacity, schedules and coverage based on expected ticket volumes.    Set and monitor clear service levels across the internal team and our external partners.    Track response and resolution times, CSAT, productivity, quality and cost per contact.    Step into operational issues, identify their root causes and fix them.    Build simple workflows, escalation paths and playbooks that work at scale.       Manage the team, partners and response quality     Manage a team of 4 Customer Care agents: set clear expectations, give regular feedback and help each person progress.    Own the performance and quality of our external human and AI partners. title: Customer Onboarding Manager
description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 다른 플랫폼에서 비즈니스를 만들어온 고객사들이 아임웹을 사용하고 있습니다. Customer Onboarding Manager는 이전해오는 고객사의 오픈과 온보딩을 직접 책임지고, 고객사가 아임웹을 사업의 핵심 성장 도구로 사용하도록 돕는 역할입니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    신규 이전 고객사의 온보딩을 담당해, 오픈까지 걸리는 시간을 단축합니다.  킥오프에서 요구사항과 오픈 일정을 파악하고, 오픈까지 필요한 과제를 관리합니다.  데이터 이전, 도메인 연결, 결제 연동, 초기 세팅을 고객사와 함께 진행합니다.  도입 단계에서 반복되는 문의를 구조화해 유관 부서 및 AI 자동화를 통해 개선합니다.  도입 가이드와 온보딩 자료를 정비해 도입 방식을 표준화합니다.       [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 도입 지원, 온보딩, 영업 지원 등 2년 이상의 경력이 있으신 분  여러 고객사의 도입 건을 동시에 진행하며 일정과 과제를 관리해보신 분  제품의 기능을 고객의 업무 언어로 풀어 설명해보신 분  도메인, 결제, 데이터 이전 등 기술적인 설정을 고객과 함께 진행하는 데 거리감이 없으신 분  고객사 실무진, 사내 유관 부서와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  반복되는 문제를 가이드나 프로세스로 만들어 해결하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험  쇼핑몰 구축이나 플랫폼 이전을 직접 지원해본 경험  고객사 도입 프로젝트를 리딩해본 경험  도입 가이드나 교육 프로그램을 만들어 문의량이나 도입 속도를 개선해본 경험  반복되는 문제나 비효율을 AI 자동화를 통해 개선해본 경험       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

title: HEYTEA KOREA 교육 담당자(Training Supervisor/Manager) 채용

title: Manager Operational Risk & Change
description: Vil du utfordre det etablerte og drive frem smartere måter å jobbe på?      Norfund er i en spennende utvikling. Etter flere år med høy investeringsaktivitet har vi bygget en stor og kompleks portefølje. Videre vekst – i portefølje, antall investeringer og organisasjon – stiller økte krav til bevisst og systematisk organisasjonsutvikling. Målet er å sikre at vi kan vokse videre uten at rapportering, krav og organisatorisk kompleksitet øker i samme takt.     Vi styrker nå arbeidet med organisasjonsutvikling, risikostyring, rapportering og operasjonell effektivitet. I rollen som Manager Operational Risk & Change vil du få en sentral rolle i dette arbeidet.     Som Manager Operational Risk & Change får du en nøkkelrolle i å forme og drive organisasjonsutviklingen i Norfund. Du vil jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom forretning, teknologi, prosess, organisasjon og risikostyring, og omsette strategiske ambisjoner til varige endringer og konkrete resultater.     Vi ser etter deg som kombinerer et helhetlig organisasjonsblikk med operativ kraft, og som har erfaring fra komplekse organisasjoner. Du har et «consulting mindset», er nysgjerrig, strukturert og løsningsorientert.     Arbeidsoppgaver   Identifisere områder hvor vekst driver økt kompleksitet, og hvor rapportering, prosesser, systemer, organisering eller arbeidsformer kan forenkles eller forbedres  Vurdere hvordan teknologi, automatisering og bedre bruk av data kan bidra til økt effektivitet og kvalitet  Lede tverrfaglige initiativer fra problemdefinisjon og prioritering til implementering og gevinstrealisering  Bidra til å styrke Norfunds risikorapportering og sikkerhetsarbeid  Drive forbedringer knyttet til operasjonell risiko, prosesskvalitet og robuste arbeidsformer  Utfordre eksisterende prosesser og arbeidsmåter når det finnes bedre alternativer  Etablere struktur, fremdrift og beslutningskraft i initiativer som går på tvers av fag- og organisasjonsgrenser      Vi ser etter deg som har:   Høyere utdanning innen økonomi, teknologi, organisasjon eller et beslektet felt  Minst 7 års erfaring fra prosjektledelse, endringsledelse eller organisasjonsutvikling  Erfaring med å lede komplekse, tverrfaglige initiativer med mange interessenter og uten formelt linjeansvar  God forståelse for virksomhetsstyring, risikostyring og/eller internkontroll  Evne til å kommunisere presist og skape engasjement og forståelse rundt prosjekter  Flytende norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig      Det er også en fordel om du har:   Erfaring med digitalisering, prosessautomatisering eller teknologidrevet prosessforbedring  Erfaring med helhetlige forbedringsprogrammer og organisasjonsutvikling  Interesse for og forståelse av utviklingsfinans og Norfunds samfunnsoppdrag      Søknadsfrist: Snarest      The Norwegian Investment Fund for Developing Countries, Norfund, invests in the private sector in developing countries to create jobs, improve lives and support the transition to net zero. title: Partner Manager, Gusto Pro
description:
Headquarters:  Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; Phoenix, AZ - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Toronto, Ontario - Remote
 

    
 
  About Gusto  
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve. 
  
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our  Total Rewards philosophy . 
  
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.    About the Role:  
 As a Partner Manager at Gusto, you will be responsible for driving the strategy and growth of a portfolio of Gusto Pro's largest and most strategic accounting firm partners. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and expanding current revenue and usage within these firms, as well as identifying, pitching, and facilitating growth opportunities. You should be comfortable building deep relationships at all levels of a partner organization, from staff accountants to managing partners, and adept at managing complex partner relationships and product configurations. Use AI-powered workflows as a core part of how you sell: running assigned tools daily, surfacing friction and inefficiencies as you find them, and collaborating with your team to influence what gets built or improved next. You will also work cross-functionally with senior members of Gusto’s team to strengthen the partner relationship, coordinate joint efforts, and provide input as we evolve our Gusto Pro product roadmap and processes. 
  About the Team:  
 Gusto Pro is a game-changing, cloud-based platform built specifically for accounting firms. It empowers firms to streamline payroll, people operations, and advisory services for their clients, all within a single, integrated platform. Gusto Pro boasts powerful features like client dashboards, automated workflows, robust reporting, and seamless integrations with other accounting software, enabling firms to elevate their client service and skyrocket their practice growth. title: Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer - Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.

As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems.

This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to.

Your work will shape the high-voltage battery system at the center of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture and carry it through to certification.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA) Manager supporting our Emerging Enterprise (EE) segment, you will build, lead, and inspire a team of DSAs who help our most innovative, fast-growing customers accelerate their journey from idea to production on the Databricks Platform.

Your team will focus on accelerating use case onboarding, enabling production workloads, and driving success in production, ensuring every customer achieves measurable outcomes and business value. You will set strategy, coach technical excellence, and ensure your team remains at the forefront of modern Data and AI architecture.

You will report to the Director of Delivery Solutions Architecture for the Emerging Enterprise Unit.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Build and Lead a High-Performing Team: Hire, coach, and grow DSAs capable of guiding EE customers to production success across a wide range of Data, AI, and ML workloads.
  • Accelerate Path to Production: Inspire your team to minimize friction, remove blockers, streamline onboarding, and enable customers to get high-impact workloads into production faster.
  • Maintain Technical Excellence: Ensure you and your team stays ahead of the curve with advanced knowledge of Databricks and the broader Data and AI ecosystem, continuously learning and achieving certifications.
  • Collaborate for Customer Growth: Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Architects, Support, Product Engineering, and Professional Services to build integrated customer plans that accelerate adoption and deliver tangible ROI.
  • Champion Operational Rigor: Establish mechanisms for tracking, forecasting, and communicating workload progress, usage growth, and customer health.
  • Be a Thought Leader and Sponsor: Serve as the technical sponsor for select EE accounts, engaging tech leads and executives to shape customer success strategy at scale.
  • Contribute to the DSA Practice: Drive initiatives that enhance consistency, scalability, and innovation across the DSA organization.

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles (Architecture, Field Engineering, or similar roles with a focus on Data and AI), including 3+ years leading technical teams.
  • Experienced in cloud-based Lakehouse architectures, specifically in guiding customers through migrations and modernization, leveraging cloud-native architectural principles.
  • Proven track record in accelerating workloads to production and enabling sustained success on cloud-native platforms.
  • Deep understanding of and ability to guide complex architectural discussions related to distributed data systems and cloud-native platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in SQL, an Object-Oriented Programming Language (preference for Python, SQL, or Scala), code reviews

title: Technical Consultant, Workday Financials
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. You'll be partnering with Customer Activation & Account Management teams to identify, prioritize and build financial solutions for new and existing customers so that Ramp continues to scale with their needs.

You will act as the technical and financial subject matter expert for our customers, and design solutions that address the customer's needs through Ramp and partner integrations. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers.

You will define the customer's financial & technical success criteria from onboarding through activation and expansion. You will represent Product, Design and Engineering externally and will operate with deep conviction and understanding of Ramp's technical capabilities. The role requires technical skills necessary to understand and educate on robust accounting features, and integrate them across all the touchpoints and surface area of a customer.

This role is specifically focused on Enterprise and Strategic Enterprise customers running Workday, supporting large, complex organizations with multi-entity environments, advanced ERP integrations, and highly customized financial workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary Technical Consultant for Enterprise and Strategic Enterprise accounts running Workday, supporting complex, high-impact customers with multi-entity, multi-ERP, and global financial environments

  • Act as a technical advisor to customers and Ramp's internal teams while supporting high-value implementations and expansion opportunities

title: Customer Solution Engineer - AI Native/Consumption Quote to Cash
description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

 

The Opportunity


A technical SaaS solutions engineer who drives the technical win on billing and quote-to-cash opportunities and acts as a technical SME for the most strategic customers in our install base — with real fluency in consumption/usage-based monetization and AI-native environments. You'll scope, configure, and build QTC solutions hands-on, not just demo them

  • Deliver technical presentations for business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership — translating architecture and pricing-model tradeoffs into business value.
  • Support technical health and adoption on your accounts — ensure customers realize value against agreed outcomes, and identify expansion across business units, cross-sell, and add-ons.

title: People Business Partner
description:
Playson is looking for a People Business Partner with knowledge of the Ukrainian language who can operate close to the business, work directly with leaders on organisational challenges, and help maintain a high-performance environment without turning the company into a bureaucratic HR machine.

This role is not about running HR processes for the sake of process.

We are looking for someone who can:

  • help leaders make strong people decisions;

  • maintain high talent quality;

  • Identify organisational risks early.

  • and ensure leadership, hiring, and performance problems do not silently accumulate over time.

The PBP works primarily through leaders - not around them.

What you’ll bring

  • Knowledge of the Ukrainian language is a must

  • 5+ years of experience in HRBP, Head of People, HRD, organisational partnership, or similar leadership-facing roles.

  • Strong experience working with leaders in fast-moving environments.

  • Ability to challenge stakeholders directly, constructively, and without unnecessary politics.

  • Strong judgment and ability to operate in ambiguous situations.

  • High level of ownership, maturity, and communication clarity.

  • Ability to connect people and topics with business reality and execution impact.

  • Comfortable with difficult conversations, organisational tension, and imperfect environments.

  • Ability to remain calm, structured, and pragmatic under pressure.

  • Ability to build trust with strong personalities and leadership teams while still being able to challenge them when needed.

  • Ability to simplify complexity instead of adding bureaucracy.

  • Strong business and organisational awareness.

  • Interest in scalable organisational practices, operational clarity, and AI-supported People infrastructure.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with leaders on hiring, team structure, organisational effectiveness, performance, ownership gaps, and delivery risks.

  • Push discussions toward decisions and outcomes instead of endless alignment loops.

  • Help leaders define what “strong” actually means for critical roles and challenge weak hiring compromises.

  • Support leaders in addressing underperformance early and directly.

  • Identify early organisational signals such as leadership gaps, burnout, unhealthy dependencies, misalignment, or execution risks.

  • Help improve feedback quality, leadership practices, and decision consistency across teams.

title: Account Executive (MM/ENT)
description:
Let’s fix hospitality, for good.

Hospitality is tough – margins are thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built Nory.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once:

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

Genesis AI is building Genesis World, a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house path traced photorealistic renderer that powers the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. title: Robot Learning Engineer

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

description:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

title: Territory Sales Partner
description:
Build Your Own Sales Business with Omada.ai

Omada.ai is the AI-powered marketing platform built for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so local business owners can stop being reluctant marketers and get back to doing what they love.

We’re venture-backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing fast, and looking for independent, ambitious sales partners across the UK who want to earn serious money introducing local businesses to Omada.

The Opportunity

This isn’t a job — it’s a partnership. As an Omada Territory Sales Partner, you run your own independent sales operation. You choose your hours, your territory, your approach. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free.

  • Guaranteed Weekly Draw: £500/week guaranteed minimum — as long as you’re hitting your trial targets. This isn’t commission-only.

  • Commission: £250–£350 per closed account (tier-dependent) with uncapped earnings. Top partners earn £4,000–£8,000+ per month.

  • Structure: Self-employed (sole trader or limited company). You invoice us. You manage your own tax.

  • Location: Your local city. Must be based in the United Kingdom.

  • Schedule: Entirely your own. Work when it suits you — mornings, eve

description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. title: Senior Credit Underwriter | UK
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is looking for a Senior Underwriter to join our Underwriting team in Europe. You’ll evaluate businesses applying to Ramp, make credit and risk decisions, and help improve how we assess customers across our products.

This is an early regional role supporting EU and US applicants. We’re looking for someone with strong financial judgment who can work independently, make clear decisions with incomplete information, and help us build scalable underwriting processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Review applications for Ramp’s corporate card and bill pay products across the EU and US.

  • Analyze financial statements, bank data, bureau information, and other risk signals

About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

title: Internship - Founders' Office
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

description:

About the role

Our Engineering and Product Design teams are building multiple verticals on our platform at high speed, leveraging AI and building agentic functionality into the platform itself. As we scale into the world's largest regulated financial institutions, identity and access management (IAM), authorization, and fine-grained permissions have become foundational to our enterprise readiness.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to join the team building Taktile's IAM and permissions platform: the authorization backbone that powers enterprise-grade access control across our product.

Joining us, you'll design and build permission models and access controls end-to-end, from the React/TypeScript access-management and admin UIs down to the Python (FastAPI) authorization services. You'll take on the problems that make enterprise authorization genuinely hard: multi-tenant isolation, fine-grained permission checks in the hot path of millions of decisions a day, audit and access trails, and the constraints of regulated financial services.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate core authorization primitives such as roles, policies, and fine-grained permission checks (RBAC/ReBAC), along with the authentication and SSO/OAuth/OIDC flows that sit on top of them.

title: Werkstudent:in Content & Social Media (m/w/d)
description:
Worum es geht

Wir sind OK ROGER. Im Kern eine Markenberatung: Unsere Kunden können etwas — nur sieht man es ihnen oft nicht an. Zwischen dem, was sie sind, und dem, was ankommt, liegt Rauschen. Wir räumen es weg.

Aber Markenberatung ist nur eine Sparte. Wir wachsen gerade stark und unternehmerisch, in mehrere Richtungen gleichzeitig. Für dich heißt das: Du steigst über einen klaren Bereich ein — und bleibst nicht darauf beschränkt.

Dein Einstieg ist die Content-Produktion für unsere Social-Media-Kunden. Das ist der Anfang, nicht die Decke. Weil wir wachsen, wächst die Rolle mit — in mehr Verantwortung, in neue Bereiche, so weit du willst.

Was du bei uns machst

Dein Einstieg: Content für unsere Kunden.

  • Du produzierst Content: Redaktionsplanung, Grafik und Text, fertige Posts — mit eigener Handschrift.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen mit. Formate, Aufhänger, Posts — nicht nur Umsetzung, sondern Einfälle.

  • Am Anfang arbeitest du eng an unserer Seite. Nach dem Onboarding übernimmst du eigene Kunden — du planst, produzierst und verantwortest ihren Auftritt, wir schauen nur noch an den richtigen Stellen drauf.

  • Du holst Freigaben bei Kunden ein und stimmst Operatives ab. Die Kundenbeziehung selbst bleibt bei uns.

  • Du hältst die Qualität, auch im Detail. Bei uns liest der Markt Sorgfalt als Substanz.

Dein Blick über den Tellerrand.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit uns zusammen und bekommst Einblick, wo andere Werkstudierende nie hinkommen: wie eine Beratung geführt wird, wie Entscheidungen fallen, wie aus einer Idee ein Unternehmen wird.

  • Konkret packst du beim Aufbau eines weiteren unternehmerischen Projekts mit an, das wir gerade hochziehen.

  • Ja, manches davon ist Organisieren und Mitdenken im Alltag. Aber nichts davon ist Beschäftigung — jede Aufgabe zeigt dir ein Stück davon, wie Unternehmen entstehen.

title: Palvelupäällikkö taloushallinnon tiimiin Ouluun
description: Johda tiimiä ja kehitä asiakkuuksia   Haluatko yhdistää tiimin ja asiakkuuksien johtamisen sekä kehittämistyön roolissa, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan? Meillä pääset vetämään asiantuntevaa tiimiä ja rakentamaan sujuvaa arkea sekä asiakkaille että omalle porukallesi.  Haemme taloushallinnon tiimiin palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa Oulussa ja lähipaikkakunnilla. Työntekopaikkana toimii Oulun seutu ja odotamme työskentelyä pääosin Oulun tai lähikuntien toimistollamme.      Mitä työ pitää sisällään?    Tiimin toiminnan johtaminen annettujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti   Töiden organisointi ja resursointi  Asiakkuuksien johtaminen, kehittäminen ja asiakashuolenpito  Asiantuntijoiden sparraus ja osaamisen kehittäminen  Palvelun laadun varmistaminen  Toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittäminen sekä muutosten jalkauttaminen omassa tiimissä       Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?    Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan  Osaavan ja tukevan kollegaverkoston, esihenkilön ja hallinnon palvelutiimit  Mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi osaamista  Kilpailukykyiset edut: laajennettu työterveys, suoritukseesi perustuva tulospalkkio sekä joustavat hyvinvointiedut (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi, työmatkat...)       Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?    Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta  Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida  Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja innostat muita onnistumaan  Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä  Haluat kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäin       Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa    yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa  tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava  arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen       Toimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti:  Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn.  Yhdessä  muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. Strategiamme ydinajatus kulminoituu Aallon sloganiin Tilitoimistoni.     Tutustu meihin lisää verkkosivuillamme ja lue Hae töihin-osiosta, mitä tarjoamme sekä mitä odotamme sinulta työntekijänä. title: Palvelupäällikkö valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen Vantaalle
description: RTK-Palvelu Oy on suomalainen kiinteistöpalvelujen monialayhtiö jo 50 vuoden kokemuksella. Yhtiön 3000 ammattilaista antaa asiakkailleen päivittäin mahdollisuuden keskittyä olennaiseen. Olemme aidosti ylpeitä liiketoimintamme jalommasta tarkoituksesta, jonka myötä olemme omistajamme kautta jo vuosikymmenten ajan tukeneet lasten ja nuorten urheilua ja hyvinvointia valtakunnallisesti.   Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset Haemme valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen palvelupäällikköä, joka osallistuu niin asiakkuuden ohjausryhmätyöskentelyyn kuin kentän operatiiviseen toimintaan. Tuet nimetyn siivousasiakkuuden palvelutuotantoa, esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä eri puolilla Suomea sekä huolehdit siitä, että sovitut toimintatavat toteutuvat yhdenmukaisesti. Toimit luontevasti asiakkaan, oman organisaation ja eri yksiköiden kanssa ja viet sovitut asiat käytäntöön. Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.Tehtävässä tarvitset kokemusta tiimien johtamisesta, henkilöstön innostamisesta ja yhteistyöstä yli organisaatiorajojen. Osaat johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti sekä tukea esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Arvostamme pitkää esihenkilökokemusta siivousalalta ja siivousalan erikoisammattitutkintoa.Tunnet siivouksen operatiivisen toiminnan, asiakkuuksien hoidon ja palvelusopimusten vaatimukset. Hallitset työssä tarvittavat järjestelmät ja hyödynnät tietoa toiminnan seurannassa, raportoinnissa, päätöksenteossa ja kehittämisessä. Varmistat palvelun laadun, sovittujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen ja arjen sujuvuuden yli yksikkörajojen. Tarvittaessa osallistut myös käytännön työhön kentällä.Kehität omaa työtäsi, palvelutuotantoa ja asiakkuutta pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä asiakkaan ja organisaation eri toimijoiden kanssa. Etsit käytännön ratkaisuja, joilla parannetaan laatua, tehokkuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen, ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan

title: Myymäläpäällikkö
description: Hae tähän työpaikkaan  Myymäläpäällikkö  Innostutko muiden onnistumisen mahdollistamisesta, tavoitteellisesta myynnistä ja tiimin johtamisesta? Tule tekemään kanssamme suomalaisten silmistä maailman onnellisimmat! Etsimme Loimaa, Forssa ja Somero -tiimiin myymäläpäällikköä, joka johtaa tiimiä esimerkillä ja innostavalla otteella. Tarjoamme työn, jossa pääset toimimaan vahvan asiantuntijuuden, avoimen yhteistyön ja asiakkaiden tarpeita kuuntelevan kulttuurin keskellä.   Esimerkillä johtamista ja henkilöstön kehittämistä   Myymäläpäällikön roolissa yhdistyy myynnillinen tekeminen ja valmentava esihenkilötyö. Valmennat 16 näkemisen asiantuntijasta koostuvan tiimisi toimintaa kokonaisvaltaisesti ja varmistat omalla esimerkilläsi, että tekeminen on Silmäaseman konseptin mukaista ja etenee tavoitteiden suuntaisesti. Rakennat ja ylläpidät tiimiisi kulttuuria, jossa autetaan toisia, jaetaan osaamista ja onnistutaan yhdessä. Myymäläpäällikkönä vastaat myymälöidesi toiminnasta, tuloksesta ja tiimin onnistumisesta.  Tulet osaksi Länsi-Suomen myymäläpäällikkötiimiä, jossa työskentelee 11 kollegaasi. Arjessa tukenasi ovat apulaismyymäläpäällikkö sekä esihenkilösi, aluejohtaja Joni Viili. Olet tärkeä esimerkki muille ja varmistat, että tekeminen on asiakaslähtöistä, tavoitteellista ja sujuvaa joka päivä.  Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Aloituspäivä sovitaan yhdessä tehtävään valitun henkilön kanssa, toivomme, että voisit aloittaa marraskuun alussa. Vastuullasi ovat Loimaan, Forssan ja Someron myymälät, joiden välillä liikut säännöllisesti. Työ painottuu vahvasti myymälöihin ja tiimin arkeen, mutta osa työstä on mahdollista tehdä joustavasti myös etänä. Käytännössä vietät suurimman osan työajasta myymälöissäsi valmentaen ja kehittäen tiimisi osaamista. Pyrkimys on päästä käyttämään 60 % ajasta tiimisi valmentamiseen, 20 % hallinnollisten tehtävien parissa ja 20 % suunnittelutyöhön   Tulevalta kollegalta odotamme seuraavia ominaisuuksia   Meillä Silmäasemalla menestyt, kun suhtaudut työhösi asiakaslähtöisesti, olet utelias oppimaan uutta ja toimit luontevasti osana tiimiä. description: "한국의 이야기를 미국의 언어로, Babechat의 첫 미국 유저 경험을 함께 만들어갈 당신을 기다립니다."     안녕하세요, AI 캐릭터 채팅 서비스 'Babechat'과 'Tookit'을 성공적으로 선보이고 운영해 온 주식회사 일레븐입니다. 우리는 사용자와 AI 캐릭터 간의 경계 없는 소통을 통해 새로운 즐거움과 관계의 가능성을 만들어가고 있습니다.     한국과 일본, 대만에 이어 이제 미국 시장으로 향합니다. 미국 유저가 Babechat을 처음 만나는 순간부터 계속 머무르는 경험까지, 서비스 운영과 콘텐츠 현지화를 한 손에 쥐고 이끌어 갈 US Operation Manager를 찾습니다.     📌 이런 일을 해요 (주요 업무)   미국 서비스 출시를 준비하고, 런칭 이후 운영 전반을 오너십을 갖고 담당해요.  미국 유저의 문의(CS)와 피드백을 모니터링하고, 운영 이슈에 빠르게 대응하며 유저의 목소리를 팀에 전달해요.  헬프데스크·FAQ·유저 가이드 등 CS 채널을 처음부터 구축하고 관리해요.  디스코드·레딧 등 영어권 커뮤니티를 운영하며, 유저가 머무르고 싶은 공간을 만들어요.  현지 크리에이터와 소통하며 미국 유저에게 맞는 콘텐츠 소싱을 지원해요.  미국 시장 트렌드와 경쟁 서비스를 모니터링하며, 인사이트를 운영에 반영해요.  국내 콘텐츠·마케팅·제품팀과 긴밀하게 소통하며 한국과 미국을 잇는 다리 역할을 해요.         🎯 이런 분을 찾아요 (자격 요건)   한국어와 영어로 원활하게 업무할 수 있는 분  미국 문화와 온라인 콘텐츠에 대한 이해도가 높은 분  꼼꼼하게 운영 업무를 관리하고, 이슈에 빠르게 대응할 수 있는 분  AI 캐릭터챗, 웹소설, 웹툰, 게임 등 콘텐츠 서비스에 관심이 있는 분         ✨ 이런 분이면 더 좋아요 (우대 사항)   미국향 앱·웹 서비스 운영 경험이 있는 분  디스코드·레딧 등 영어권 커뮤니티 운영 경험이 있는 분  초기 서비스에서 다양한 업무를 주도적으로 수행해 본 분  콘텐츠 번역 또는 현지화 경험이 있는 분         🤝 합류 여정  서류 전형 → 1차(실무진) 인터뷰 → 2차(리더십) 인터뷰 → 레퍼런스 체크 → 최종 합격 및 오퍼 미팅     이력서와 함께 번역·현지화 또는 서비스 운영 경험을 보여줄 수 있는 자료(번역 샘플, 운영 사례 등)가 있다면 함께 제출해 주세요.        🎁 최고의 동료와 함께, 성장에만 집중하세요 (복지 및 문화)   📈 성장을 위한 전폭적인 지원    업무 관련 성장을 위한 식대, 교육, 도서, 소프트웨어 구독 비용은 법인카드로 자율적으로 사용해요.  업계 최고 사양의 장비와 유료 소프트웨어를 지원하며, 회사 인근 주차도 지원해 드려요.  매월 10만 원의 체력단련비와 연 1회 프리미엄 건강검진으로 건강까지 든든하게 챙겨요.    💻 유연하고 효율적인 근무 문화    주 2일 오피스 출근을 기본으로, 나머지 요일은 원격 근무로 유연하게 일해요.  코어타임 외 자율적인 시간 조율, 별도 승인 없는 자율 휴가제로 신뢰 기반의 문화를 만들어요.    💰 성과에 대한 확실한 보상    개인의 기여를 투명하게 반영하여 매년 1회 연봉을 협상해요.  분기별 목표 달성 시 현금 인센티브를 제공하고, 2년마다 유급 리프레시 휴가와 휴가비를 지원해요.         Babechat의 미국 진출을 최전선에서 함께 이끌어 갈 동료를 기다립니다. 많은 지원 부탁드립니다!

title: Front Office Manager

title: Front Office Manager
description: Per una realtà alberghiera 4 stelle a gestione familiare, caratterizzata da un approccio fortemente orientato all’ospitalità e alla cura dell’esperienza dell’ospite, siamo alla ricerca di un/una  Front Office Manager .     La persona inserita avrà la responsabilità del reparto ricevimento, diventando il punto di riferimento per il team di Front Office e per la Direzione, con un ruolo chiave nel garantire elevati standard di servizio e nel mantenere una relazione autentica e personalizzata con la clientela.     Si tratta di un’opportunità rivolta a professionisti del settore alberghiero che desiderano entrare in un contesto dove il ruolo non è limitato alla gestione operativa del desk, ma prevede un coinvolgimento diretto nell’organizzazione del reparto, nel miglioramento dei processi e nello sviluppo della qualità del servizio.      Main Activities:       Coordinamento e supervisione del team Front Office;  Organizzazione dei turni e gestione delle attività quotidiane del reparto;  Supervisione delle procedure di check-in/check-out e della guest experience;  Gestione delle richieste degli ospiti e delle eventuali criticità;  Formazione e affiancamento delle risorse del team;  Collaborazione diretta con Direzione e reparti operativi per garantire un servizio eccellente;  Monitoraggio degli standard qualitativi e proposta di azioni migliorative.       Skills:       Esperienza di almeno 6/8 anni maturata in strutture alberghiere di target similare;  Esperienza nel coordinamento di risorse all’interno del reparto Front Office;  Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (requisito indispensabile);  La conoscenza di una seconda lingua sarà considerata un plus;  Ottime capacità relazionali, orientamento all’ospite e forte senso dell’accoglienza;  Approccio pratico, autonomia e capacità di gestione delle priorità.      Sede di Lavoro: Roma (zona Nord)     RAL Prevista: €45.000-50.000      Si prenderanno in considerazione esclusivamente le candidature corredate da Curriculum Vitae.

title: Sales & Customer Relationship Manager
description: Kalevala Korun kasvun ytimessä on monikanavainen asiakaskokemus, jossa oma myynti ja vahva jälleenmyyjäverkosto täydentävät toisiaan. Noin 140 jälleenmyyjän verkostomme tuo Kalevalan lähelle kuluttajia ympäri Suomen ja on tärkeässä roolissa rakentamassa brändin tunnettuutta, saavutettavuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Roolissasi rakennat kasvua yhdessä jälleenmyyjäkumppaneidemme kanssa, kehität asiakkuuksia kaupallisesti kannattavasti sekä vahvistat Kalevalan asemaa jälleenmyyntikanavissa.     Tehtäväsi on tunnistaa uusia myyntimahdollisuuksia, rakentaa yhdessä kumppaneidemme kanssa kaupallisia toimenpiteitä sekä luoda pitkäjänteisiä ja kannattavia asiakassuhteita. Varmistat hyvän yhteistyön avulla, että Kalevala on jälleenmyyntikanavissa näkyvä, haluttu ja myyvä brändi, jolla on oikea valikoima, erinomainen saatavuus ja vahva asema asiakkaiden valinnassa.     Tehtävässäsi raportoit Suomen Business Leadille ja työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä myynnin, markkinointitiimin ja asiakaspalvelutiimin kanssa. Kokemus tekoälypohjaisten työkalujen käytöstä B2B-myynnissä sekä B2B-verkkokaupan hyödyntämisestä katsotaan eduksi.  Vahvaa suomen ja englannin kielen osaamista  Satunnaista matkustusvalmiutta B2B-asiakkaidemme luo       Tarjoamme sinulle    Merkittävän roolin suomalaisen designin tukkumyynnissä  Noin 80 kollegaa, jotka välittävät toisistaan ja joilla on erinomainen työvire  Modernin työympäristön, jossa työskennellään hybridimallilla  Osa liiketoiminnan tuloksesta jaetaan henkilöstölle ja hyväntekeväisyyteen  Henkilöstöedut — kalevala.fi/rekrytointi

title: Senior Consultant/Manager i CX Transformation-teamet
description: I frog, part of Capgemini Invent, tror vi at de beste virksomhetene skapes gjennom ekstraordinære opplevelser. description: 회사 소개   쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      직무 소개   CCX Planning 팀은 CX 성과 지표를 관리하고, 조직 목표를 달성하는데 전념합니다. 데이터 기반으로 현재 상황을 분석하고 인사이트를 도출하며, 목표를 달성하기 위한 종합적인 계획을 수립합니다. 주요 이해 관계자와 긴밀히 협력하여 전략적인 솔루션을 제안하고 효과적인 실행을 지원합니다. 또한, 조직의 문화 활동을 지원하여 최고의 조직으로 성장하는데 기여합니다.      업무 내용   CCX performance metrics 수립, 관리, 분석을 통한 insight & action item 도출   고객 여정(Customer Journey) 분석 및 데이터 기반 Pain Point 발굴  CX 개선 프로젝트를 end-to-end로 기획, 실행 및 성과 관리  비즈니스 우선순위를 기반으로 CX 로드맵 수립 및 실행 관리   주요 이해 관계자로부터 비즈니스 우선순위를 명확히 이해하고 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 관련 데이터를 분석을 통해 효과적인 솔루션 제안 및 이행  Ad-hoc 프로젝트성 업무에 참여하여 개발, 데이터, 프로그램, 운영팀 등 여러 부서와의 협업을 통해 프로젝트 추진하여 최고의 고객 경험 창출에 기여      자격   요건    PM / 프로젝트 관리 경력 5년 이상 있으신  디테일에 민감하며 심층 분석에 대한 의지가 있으신 분  분석적이며 구조적인 사고의 보유자로서 여러 데이터에 대한 이해도가 높고 인사이트를 도출하실 수 있는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경/업무를 즐기고 멀티태스킹이 가능하신 분  능동적인 업무처리하고 항상 기존에 것에 대한 질문을 품고 최적화 하실 수 있는 분  다양한 이해관계자 관리 능력 있으신 분  소비자 지향적 사고방식 지니신 분       우대   사항    재무 / 컨설팅쪽 유관 경력이 있으신 분  프로젝트 기획 / 운영 경험이 있으신 분  비즈니스 영어가 가능하신 분  CS 관련 업무 경험이 있으신 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항    전형절차    서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.    참고사항    본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.  고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.    개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/    서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.  당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.  단, 위 1

title: Delivery & Project Manager
description: Kan du holde mange initiativer i luften på én gang, uden at tabe overblikket?      Comm2ig søger en Delivery & Project Manager til vores Services & Delivery organisation. Vores serviceforretning er i vækst, og vi udvider leveranceorganisationen for at følge med efterspørgslen fra både nye og eksisterende kunder.     Du bliver omdrejningspunktet, når en aftale går fra salg til leverance. Du får også en central rolle i, hvordan vores serviceportefølje udvikler sig.      Om jobbet:   Som Delivery & Project Manager driver du en portefølje af kundeleverancer og interne initiativer parallelt. Det er ikke ét stort projekt ad gangen; det er typisk fem til ti forløb i forskellige faser, som alle skal holdes i bevægelse. Du arbejder tæt sammen med salg, koordinatorer og de tekniske specialister i vores organisation.      Primære ansvarsområder:    Drive onboarding af nye kunder på vores managed services fra kontrakt til stabil drift  Lede implementerings- og udrulningsprojekter hos kunder  Være kundens primære kontaktpunkt i leverancefasen  Holde styr på scope, tidsplan, økonomi og fremdrift på tværs af din portefølje  Drive og bidrage til design og videreudvikling af services sammen med vores tekniske specialister  Sikre at nye services er klar til at blive leveret i skala, inden de går på markedet  Understøtte salgsorganisationen med leveranceperspektiv i tilbud og kundedialog  Identificere muligheder for at udvide samarbejdet med eksisterende kunder       Hvem er vi?   Comm2ig er blandt Danmarks største leverandører af it-infrastruktur og samarbejder med nogle af landets mest betydningsfulde private og offentlige organisationer. Vi er i dag omkring 170 medarbejdere fordelt på vores lokationer i Allerød, Aarhus V, Svenstrup J. og Kokkedal. Med en omsætning på ~1.5 mia. kroner i seneste regnskabsår står vi stærkt i markedet.      Arbejdssted   Stillingen besættes med primært arbejdssted i  Aarhus  eller  Svenstrup J . Der må påregnes rejseaktivitet til kunder og til vores øvrige lokationer.      Vi tilbyder    En central rolle i en serviceforretning i vækst  Bred kontaktflade til kunder, salg, tekniske specialister og koordinatorer  Reel indflydelse på, hvordan vores serviceportefølje udvikler sig  Et fagligt stærkt miljø med høj trivsel og uformelt arbejdsmiljø  Fleksibilitet i hverdagen og plads til at præge både stillingen og vores løsninger       Er det dig?   Du har bred erfaring med it-leverancer og nok teknisk fundament til at tale med både specialister og kunder uden en oversætter. Du behøver ikke selv kunne bygge løsningen. Du skal kunne gennemskue den, udfordre den og forklare den. Du trives med mange bolde i luften og med at prioritere skarpt, når noget skal vente.      Kompetencer    Erfaring med projektledelse og leverance af it-løsninger eller services, gerne fra leverandør- eller MSP-side  Projektledelsesværktøjskassen i orden – og pragmatisk sans for, hvor meget metode den enkelte opgave kræver  Kommerciel forståelse: du ka

title: Asiakkuusvastaava
description: Kasvun myötä haemme nyt Fennoalle toista aktiivista ja kasvuhaluista  Asiakkuusvastaavaa  kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen tehtävään. Tehtävä sopii hyvin kaupallisen uransa alkuvaiheessa olevalle henkilölle. Olisitko sinä etsimämme hiomaton timantti kasvamaan osaksi kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista asiakkuustiimiämme?💎   Mistä tehtävässä on kyse? 🔍   Tehtävässä toimit sinulle nimetyn portfolion ensisijaisena yhteyshenkilönä ja vastaat asiakkuuksien tyytyväisyydestä sekä kasvattamisesta. Portfoliosi koostuu jo olemassa olevista asiakkaista, joihin olet aktiivisesti yhteydessä etäkanavia hyödyntäen (puhelin, Teams ja sähköposti), tarjoten heille apua ja lisäarvoa. Analysoit saatavilla olevaa tietoa ja hyödynnät tunnuslukuja sekä AI:ta asiakkuuksien hoitamisessa. Asiakastyön lisäksi rooliin kuuluu sisäisissä projekteissa työskentely ja avustaminen esim. viestiliikeenteeseen liittyvissä tehtävissä.  Asiakkuuksien hoitaminen on kuitenkin tiimityötä ja saatkin selkänojaksi työllesi esihenkilön sekä erittäin osaavan 8 hengen asiakkuustiimin tuen. Tässä tehtävässä sinulla on loistava mahdollisuus kehittyä, oppia uutta ja kasvaa tulevaisuudessa kohti laajempia vastuita.   Millaisia taitoja ja osaamista arvostamme?   Tehtävässä hyvin menestymistä pohjustaa soveltuva koulutustausta (esim. KTM tai Tradenomi) sekä mahdollinen aikaisempi työkokemus B2B-kentästä asiakkuudenhoidon ja/tai myynnin tehtävien parista. Aiempi työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä ei kuitenkaan ole välttämätöntä, vaan etsimme ennen kaikkea henkilöä, joka on valmis oppimaan ja kasvamaan tehtävässä.  Tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksia, mitä toivomme sinulta, ovat proaktiivisuus, asiakaslähtöinen työskentelyote, erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot ja halu kehittyä. Olet vahva tiimipelaaja ja näet, että asiakkuuksien menestyksekäs hoitaminen on tiimityötä. Olet analyyttinen ja kiinnostunut hyödyntämään aktiivisesti myös dataa ja AI:ta asiakkuuksien hoitamisessa. Lisäksi aito kiinnostus seurata toimialan trendejä ja halu oppia uutta auttaa sinua menestymään.   Mistä lähdetään liikkeelle?   Haluamme varmistaa, että saat parhaan mahdollisen startin ja ensimmäinen askel perehdytysjakson jälkeen onkin Fennoan tuotteeseen ja tilitoimistomarkkinaan tutustuminen.  Fennoalla et jää yksin: tukenasi ovat tiiminvetäjä ja Asiakkuusjohtajamme Jesse, kokenut asiakkuustiimi sekä muut loistavat myynti- ja markkinointiosastomme kollegat, jotka kaikki auttavat ja sparraavat sinua matkan varrella.  Asiakkuusvastaavan palkkamalli koostuu kuukausipalkasta (3000-3500€/kk) sekä tavoitteisiin perustuvasta kvartaalibonuksesta, mikä antaa sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvattaa ansioitasi oman menestyksesi perusteella.   Miksi Fennoa?   Fennoa on täysin etäorganisaatio, joten meillä voit työskennellä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Tarjoamme kotitoimistollesi kaiken tarvittavan sähköpöydästä langattomiin kuulokkeisiin ja maksamme myös kodin internet-yhteytesi, jotta työskentely olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa missä tahansa oletkin. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.  QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.  Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.  QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.   Job Purpose Summary   The incumbent is primarily responsible to support the Customer Relationship Executives / Managers in managing and servicing QNB First account holders, including the timely provision of excellent banking services and ensuring all transactions instructed by the customer are completed in timely, manner handling day to day queries from customer professionally and handling customer in the branch premises.   Essential Duties & Responsibilities By Dimensions   Shareholder & Financial    Support Relationship Managers and Executives in handling customer queries and complaints.  Ensure timely complaint resolution and enhance customer satisfaction.  Contribute to customer acquisition and retention initiatives.  Support achievement of service KPIs and quality standards.  Promote operational efficiency and cost consciousness.  Act within delegated authorities and approved policies.    Customer Service    Deliver high-quality customer service and exceed customer expectations.  Assist customers visiting the branch and respond to inquiries promptly.  Handle customer requests within established turnaround times.  Promote and cross-sell QNB products and services.  Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.  Participate in customer communication activities, loyalty programs, and promotional campaigns.  Maintain complete confidentiality when dealing with customer information.  Proactively identify customer needs and recommend suitable banking products and solutions.    Internal Processes    Work closely with QNB First Relationship Managers to improve service quality and resolve customer issues.  Manage implementation of customer products, services, and applications in accordance with service standards.  Accept shift work schedules as per bank po

title: Customer Success Lead till Svea Billing Services
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens kundupplevelse inom Billing Services? Vi befinner oss i en spännande förändringsresa där vi stärker vårt erbjudande, utvecklar våra arbetssätt och bygger en ännu mer kundfokuserad organisation. Nu söker vi en Customer Success Lead som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla kundresan, skapa struktur och säkerställa att våra kunder får maximalt värde av våra lösningar.  Det här är inte en traditionell Customer Success-roll, utan vi söker dig som kombinerar strategisk höjd med operativ handlingskraft och som trivs med att driva förändring genom samarbete och inflytande.   Om rollen   Som Customer Success Lead ansvarar du för att utveckla och samordna kundarbetet genom hela kundresan, från onboarding och implementation till långsiktig kundutveckling, retention och ökat kundvärde. Du kommer att jobba nära den kommersiella verksamheten, produktorganisationen och utvecklingsteamet. Rollen innebär såväl deltagande i det dagliga kundbemötandet och operativa arbetet, liksom fokus på att skapa effektiva arbetssätt, förbättra kundupplevelsen och säkerställa att vi arbetar proaktivt med våra kunder. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:    Utveckla kundresan och stärka kundvärdet genom hela kundlivscykeln.  Driva kundutveckling i nära samarbete med affär, produkt och utveckling.  Identifiera och prioritera initiativ som ökar kundnöjdhet och lojalitet.  Omsätta kundinsikter till förbättrade erbjudanden, processer och arbetssätt.  Bygga struktur, uppföljning och KPI:er för ett datadrivet kundarbete     Vem är du?   För att lyckas i rollen är du en prestigelös person som trivs med att växla mellan strategiskt utvecklingsarbete och operativt genomförande. Du är drivande och initiativtagande, tar ansvar för att föra arbetet framåt och ser vad som behöver göras utan att invänta instruktioner.  Du är också en naturlig lagspelare som bygger förtroende, skapar engagemang och får människor att samarbeta mot gemensamma mål. Samtidigt har du ett analytiskt och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt, där du identifierar förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätter idéer till konkreta resultat.    Minst 5 års relevant erfarenhet inom Customer Success, Customer Experience (CX) eller liknande område  Erfarenhet från SaaS-, tech- eller produktbolag  Erfarenhet av onboarding, implementation och kundutveckling  Förmåga att arbeta tvärfunktionellt mellan kund, affär, produkt och teknik  Erfarenhet av att utveckla processer, arbetssätt och kundflöden  Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift    Det är meriterande om du även har:    Erfarenhet av fintech, betalningslösningar eller närliggande branscher  Erfarenhet av projektledning eller implementeringsprojekt  Erfarenhet av kundnöjdhetsarbete, retention och användardata  Erfarenhet av att leda genom inflytande utan formellt personalansvar  Kunskaper i norska eller finska      Om Svea     Svea Bank är en finansiell koncern med över 2000 anställda och verksamhet i fle

title: Yhteyspäällikkö, Kuopio
description: Mandatum on rahan ja hengen erikoisosaamisen yhdistävä merkittävä finanssipalvelujen tarjoaja. Yhtiö tarjoaa asiakkailleen laajan valikoiman palveluita kattaen omaisuuden- ja varainhoidon, säästämisen ja sijoittamisen, palkitsemisen ja sitouttamisen, eläkeaikaan varautumisen sekä henkilövakuuttamisen. Mandatumin liiketoiminnan menestyksen keskiössä ovat osaava henkilöstö, vahva brändi ja onnistuminen sijoitustoiminnassa.       Mandatumissa panostetaan inspiroivaan ja hyvinvoivaan työyhteisöön ja toimitaan yhtenä joukkueena. Työ meillä on tavoitteellista, mielenkiintoista ja täynnä haasteita. Monipuolisissa tehtävissämme työskentelee yli 600 innostunutta ja kehittymisestään kiinnostunutta rahan ja hengen ammattilaista.       Haluatko rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja luoda kasvua? Hae yhteyspäälliköksi Kuopioon ja tule rakentamaan menestystä yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa.       Sinun roolisi      Yhteyspäällikön tehtävässä toimit yritysasiakkaidemme luotettuna kumppanina auttaen heitä hyödyntämään Mandatumin asiantuntemusta riski- ja eläkevakuuttamisen, varainhoidon sekä henkilöstön palkitsemisen ratkaisuissa. Asiakkaasi koostuvat yrittäjistä sekä pienistä ja keskisuurista yrityksistä, ja työsi painottuu aktiiviseen asiakashankintaan, asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen ja pitkäjänteisten kumppanuuksien rakentamiseen.     Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Mandatumin asiantuntijoiden kanssa, kuten yksityisvarainhoitajien, palkitsemiskonsulttien ja juristien kanssa. Vastaat asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistamisesta ja oikeiden asiantuntijoiden osallistamisesta asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen.      Onnistumisen edellytykset      Olet tavoitteellinen ja asiakaslähtöinen myynnin ammattilainen, joka innostuu uusien mahdollisuuksien löytämisestä ja asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan ymmärtämisestä. Sinulla on näyttöjä tuloksellisesta myyntityöstä sekä halu kehittää osaamistasi finanssialan asiantuntijaympäristössä.     Lisäksi toivomme, että   sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva kaupallinen koulutus  hahmotat laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja osaat esittää ne selkeästi  sinulla on erinomaiset vuorovaikutus-, kuuntelu- ja esiintymistaidot  työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti ja viet asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin  nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja aktiivisesta asiakastyöstä.       Johda urasi Mandatumiin       Panostamme palkittuun työntekijäkokemukseemme. Mandatum on valittu useasti Great Place to Work -tutkimuksessa Suomen parhaiden työpaikkojen joukkoon suurten organisaatioiden sarjassa ja on viime vuosina ansainnut Siqni-henkilöstökyselyyn perustuvan Future Workplaces -sertifikaatin erinomaisesta työntekijäkokemuksesta.  Osaamispääoman kasvattaminen. Tuemme työtä huolellisella perehdytyksellä ja jatkuvalla osaamisen kehittämisellä. Tukenasi on valmentava esihenkilö sekä positiivinen ja motivoitunut tiimi.   Työyhteisössämme positiivisuus ja tekemisen asenne tarttuu. Menestyäksemme tarvitsemme toisiamme ja ammattitaitoisia kollegoita. Työskentelemme joustavassa hybridityömallissa
