title: Head of Account Management
description: Om JP/Politikens Hus og Business Media   JP/Politikens Hus er en af Skandinaviens førende medievirksomheder og tæller udgivelser som Politiken, Jyllands-Posten, Ekstra Bladet, samt Politikens Forlag, Saxo og distributionsvirksomheden Dao. JP/Politiken Business Media er en særskilt forretningsenhed i JP/Politikens Hus med omkring 500 medarbejdere. Vi er et  house of brands  og driver en vifte af digitale, abonnementsbaserede titler, herunder Watch Medier, Finans, Marketwire, Dezeen og senest Altinget og Mandag Morgen. Vores titler og vidensprodukter henvender sig til professionelle aktører i erhvervslivet i hele Norden samt i Tyskland og UK. Til en ny kommerciel rolle i Århus søges en:      Head of Account Management   Vil du stå i spidsen for at udvikle en moderne og datadrevet Account Management organisation med fokus på at fastholde og vækste nogle af JP/Politiken Business Medias største kunder? Og motiveres du af muligheden for at præge processer, målepunkter, organisation og ledelse? Så kan denne nye rolle hos JP/Politiken Business Media være et naturligt næste karriereskridt for dig.  JP/Politiken Business Media søger en ambitiøs kommerciel leder, der kan løfte arbejdet med kunder på tværs af Danmark, Norge og Sverige. title: Head of Support Excellence & Transformation
description: Department:  Customer Support   Employment Type:  Permanent   Location:  Madrid   Reporting To:  Christian Wolf   Description    About osapiens   osapiens helps global companies build transparent, compliant, and sustainable supply chains.  Our platform powers 2 500 + enterprise clients — from leading DAX and S&P 500 companies, to key players in manufacturing, to most major retailers, and all the way down the supply chains to cacao farmers in some of the most remote regions of the world.  If our systems are down, imports into Europe could halt, production lines across industries would stop, and thousands of trucks could no longer deliver worldwide. Our holistic platform for supply-chain transparency, resilience, and automation helps businesses grow responsibly — with sustainability and scalability always in focus.  That’s why our Support organization is mission-critical. When we perform well, global supply chains keep moving; and sustainability goals become reality.   The Challenge   Our Support team currently handles around 2000 tickets per month, ranging from simple knowledge questions to production-critical incidents.  As osapiens continues to scale rapidly, your mission is to decouple customer growth and solution adoption from ticket and FTE growth, by transforming Support into an intelligent, automated, and continuously improving organization. This is not a typical maintenance role, it’s a transformation mission and mandate.  Your Responsibilities     Lead & Inspire: Build and develop a high-performing global Support team that thrives on ownership, learning, and customer obsession.    Transform & Automate: Redesign processes, implement automation, and build scalable systems that absorb growth efficiently.    Drive Deflection: Reduce repetitive tickets by steering customers toward documentation, refining the AI support assistant, and expanding self-service.    Eliminate Root Causes: Analyze ticket data, identify recurring drivers, and translate insights into concrete improvements for Product, Delivery, and Engineering.    Operational Excellence: Define and track KPIs (MTTR, CSAT, deflection, backlog, SLA compliance); lead weekly performance reviews.    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Customer Success, Delivery, Product management and Development, and our platform teams, to ensure seamless handovers and issue prevention.    Lead in Crises: Act as the calm, structured, and transparent leader, both customers and teams rely on during major incidents and change processes.    Continuous Improvement: Embed retrospectives, feedback loops, and measurable experiments that raise the bar every month.     Your Experience    7+ years’ experience in Digital Transformation, Process Excellence, or Customer / Support Operations, ideally in SaaS or enterprise technology.   Background in strategic consulting roles focused on (Digital) Transformation. Ideally from leading IT-transformation consultancies or high-growth tech scale

title: Customer Operations Manager - Cyber
description: Customer Success Manager - Cyber        À propos de HARVEN   La plupart des failles de sécurité n'ont rien de sophistiqué : un mot de passe volé, une mise à jour oubliée, un clic de trop. Le vrai problème, c'est que les équipes IT sont trop débordées pour vérifier en continu que les bons réflexes sont en place, surtout dans les ETI qui ont l'infrastructure d'un grand groupe et les ressources cyber d'une PME.  Résultat : les équipes passent 80 % de leur temps à mettre en place des contrôles de sécurité et seulement 20 % à corriger les failles.      HARVEN inverse ce ratio  : nos agents IA surveillent en continu, repèrent les failles avant qu'elles soient exploitées et les corrigent automatiquement.     Derrière HARVEN, deux fondateurs experts :  Arthur Auclair  et Pierrick Filippi, choisis par le startup studio  CyGO-Entrepreneurs  (co-fondé par Aurélie Clerc, ex-FDJ, et Laurent Hausermann, ex-Sentryo/Arkoon), qui ne finance que  2 startups par an . On a lancé l'activité et bouclé notre première levée début d'année, on onboarde de nouveaux clients chaque mois, et on vise un  x10 sur les 18 prochains mois .     Votre rôle : faire de HARVEN un indispensable pour nos clients  Notre produit est packagé : le dernier client a été onboardé en  30 minutes , avec des résultats en 1-2 heures et un taux de transformation POC → client de  75-80 % . La valeur ne se joue donc pas sur la technique, elle se joue sur la  relation, l'adoption et la satisfaction .     On cherche la personne qui pilote chaque client du kick-off au run, qui s'assure qu'il tire un maximum de valeur d'HARVEN, et qui construit au passage nos process et nos outils en mode  IA-native . Un rôle clé, au contact direct des clients comme des fondateurs.     C'est un poste business : tu es le  client interne  de la tech et du produit (tu testes, tu remontes les frictions à Pierrick), et tu relaies les opportunités à Arthur sans être commercial toi-même.  Les missions:   1. Déploiement & onboarding -> 25 %     Garant du déploiement  de chaque client, du kick-off au run : tu possèdes le compte de bout en bout. title: Plasma Microwave Modelling Physicist (ECRH, Gyrotrons)
description:
Proxima Fusion is hiring an Alpha Plasma Microwave Modeler in Munich to own the physics simulation pipeline connecting our gyrotron sources to plasma performance. You will model the propagation, polarization and absorption of millimeter waves in the Alpha stellarator, running ray-tracing and beam-tracing codes such as TRAVIS and RAYTRAX and validating against W7-X experimental data to drive the design of the Alpha ECRH launcher. You will model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive and build Python post-processing pipelines. It suits physicists with hands-on experience of an EC propagation or absorption code.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run ray-tracing and beam-tracing simulations of EC wave propagation and absorption using codes such as TRAVIS, RAYTRAX and more complex beam or full wave model codes

  • Develop an integrated modeling framework that couples wave deposition to transport codes, enabling temperature and density profile optimization and validation of the heating scenario performance

  • Build and maintain Python-based post-processing pipelines to automate scenario scanning and interface simulation outputs with the Alpha integrated design framework

  • Model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive (ECCD) and assess its ability to modify rotational transform and equilibrium in the Alpha quasi-isodynamic configuration

  • Contribute to design reviews, interface control documents, and technical reports to ensure simulation results are traceable and actionable

WHO YOU ARE

  • PhD (or equivalent demonstrated expertise) in plas

title: Manager Customer Support
description: Deze organisatie zoekt een Manager Customer Support die het verschil maakt door klanten écht goed te helpen en continu te verbeteren. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor een team van circa 15 medewerkers, waarbij klantbeleving centraal staat en processen steeds slimmer, efficiënter en klantgerichter worden ingericht. Je krijgt volop ruimte om jouw eigen visie toe te passen en samen met het commerciële team bij te dragen aan betrouwbare support voor klanten in de farmaceutische logistiek.   Omschrijving    Wat je gaat doen:    Je geeft leiding aan circa 15 medewerkers binnen het customer support team en stimuleert hen om vanuit de klant te denken.  Je ontwikkelt het team door coaching, begeleiding en het creëren van een positieve werkomgeving waarin plezier en eigenaarschap centraal staan.  Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, samenwerking en systemen zodat de dienstverlening steeds klantgerichter wordt.  Je realiseert samen met het team de klanttevredenheidsdoelstellingen door klanten snel, professioneel en met aandacht te helpen.  Je initieert verbeterprojecten om processen slimmer, efficiënter en effectiever te maken binnen de internationale klantomgeving.  Je bouwt sterke relaties op met andere afdelingen om optimale samenwerking in de hele keten te realiseren.  Je zorgt ervoor dat communicatie intern én richting klanten helder, gestructureerd en oplossingsgericht verloopt - vaak ook in het Engels.  Je stimuleert het team om verwachtingen helder te managen en steeds te zoeken naar oplossingen die zowel voor klanten als voor de organisatie werken.  Je draagt bij aan een serviceorganisatie die betrouwbaar, professioneel en klantgericht is door continue verbetering van processen.  Je vertaalt verbeterkansen naar systemen die de klantbeleving versterken en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.       Wat je meeneemt:    Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde HBO-opleiding waarmee je beschikt over relevante theoretische kennis.  Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als coachende leidinggevende binnen customer service of support teams.  Je beheerst de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord én geschrift waardoor je effectief kunt communiceren in internationale context.  Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring opgedaan in een internationaal georiënteerde omgeving waardoor je gewend bent aan complexe klantvragen.  Je denkt procesmatig en baseert beslissingen graag op data zodat verbeteringen meetbaar zijn.  Je hebt een sterke klantmindset: je luistert goed naar behoeften, denkt vooruit en vertaalt deze naar praktische verbeteringen.  Je communiceert helder, professioneel en oplossingsgericht met klanten, collega's én stakeholders.  Je bent flexibel ingesteld waardoor je snel kunt schakelen bij veranderingen of onverwachte situaties.  Affiniteit met logistiek of farmaceutische branche is een pré waarmee je extra waarde toevoegt aan het team.  Je bent mensgericht, vooruitstrevend en verantwoordelijk - passend bij de kernwaarden van de organisatie.

description: About Struck    Struck exists to resolve the chaos of good intentions. Regulations should lead to better buildings, not stalled projects. title: Head of Partnerships
description: Head of Partnerships   Quartermaster is a Toronto-built home services marketplace where every Pro is referred by a verified neighbour before they can be booked. Homeowners find local Pros, request quotes, manage bookings and documents, pay in-app, and pass their own referral down the street — all from one platform. It's word of mouth, turned into infrastructure.     The model is a deliberate rejection of how the category works. Most platforms sell the same lead to four contractors or take 20–30% of every job, which pushes the best Pros off the platform entirely. Quartermaster runs on low commissions and neighbour referrals, backed by a Good neighbour Guarantee that puts up to $2,500 behind every job. The result is a marketplace the city's most trusted Pros will actually say yes to.     Founded in 2015, Quartermaster has spent a decade assembling the pieces required for a genuine city-scale marketplace: network density, Pro supply, and a product good enough to compound. A two-year platform rebuild is now landing, and the company is heading into the most consequential stretch of its life — a run at building the first low-commission, citywide home services utility in North America.      Highlights    Founded 2015, HQ in Toronto  89 employees, up 34% year over year  Every Pro on the platform is referred by a verified homeowner — no paid placements, no shared leads  Good Neighbour Guarantee backs every job up to $2,500  Field canvassing converts 20–30% of homes in a targeted neighbourhood  Two-year platform rebuild completing in 2026, with a new consumer product rolling out through the fall       About the Role   This is the leadership seat over the entire Pro side of Quartermaster's marketplace — acquisition, activation, engagement, and long-term success. It exists because the Pro funnel is the constraint on everything: without deep, high-quality Pro supply, the homeowner experience doesn't work and the network doesn't compound.     Your job is to build a value equation Pros can't say no to, and a system that delivers it at scale. You'll report directly to Michael Phillips, Co-Founder and CEO, and operate as a true peer to the product leaders building alongside you.     Please note: this role is currently on-site in downtown Toronto. title: Senior Relationship Manager for External Asset Managers (Wealth Management) in Basel region

title: QNB3889 - Vice President Private Banking Business Lead
description: About QNB   Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.  QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.  QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.  Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.  QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.   Job Summary   The incumbent will be primarily responsible for developing and managing relationships with High Net Worth (UHNW) customers allocated to him, including members of the Ruling Family and Government officials and act as a 'one-stop solution' for all Private Banking services including banking and investment. fiduciary and ending services. The incumbent must be able to work closely as part of the team with domestic Private Bankers to develop referrals from their client bases. Provide inputs to the SVP Private Banking Sales in developing and implementing strategies and plans to achieve all volume, revenue, and profit targets for the Private Banking (IJHNW) segment.  Implements KPI's and best practices for VP Private Banking Sales role.  Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste. and optimise benefits for the bank.  Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.  Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial & non-financial performance.   Customer (Internal & External):  Inspire private banking team and lead by example to achieve business targets providing a very high level of service to clients.   Take responsibility for the most demanding clients (personal and corporate).  Build and maintain proactively, strong relationships with Private Banking client base. title: パートナーシップサクセスマネージャー (Partnership Success Manager)
description: エウレカは、真剣にパートナーを見つけたいと考えている方に向けた恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営している会社です。Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,500万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。 2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版・2025年に韓国版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、70万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。 2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。     Job Summary:  Pairsは、オンラインでの出会いを超え、リアルな場での「幸せな出会い」を創造する『Pairs Event Partnership』を加速させています。  本ポジションのミッションは、提携するイベント開催パートナー企業をオンボードし、各社の強みを活かしたイベント企画・運営を成功へと導くことで、パートナーとPairs双方の事業成長を最大化させることです。 パートナーの事業成功（ROI最大化）と、参加ユーザーの最高の体験の両立をリードする、極めて戦略的な役割を担っていただきます。      What You'll Do: 1. パートナー企業のオンボーディングと立ち上げ 初期導入支援：  基本契約締結後のパートナー企業に対し、Pairsのプラットフォーム活用方法や、イベント専用管理画面の操作、決済・集客の仕組みをレクチャーし、スムーズなプロジェクト始動を支援します。  サクセスロードマップの策定：  パートナーの施設やアセット（例：カラオケ店、飲食店、自治体施設等）を活かした年間開催計画や、目標数値（動員数・マッチング率）の合意形成を行います。     2. イベントプランニングと戦略立案   データに基づく企画支援：  累計2,500万登録の行動データや、ユーザーの趣味・価値観データを分析し、パートナー企業と共に「刺さる」イベント（例：趣味コン、体験型イベント）を共同企画します。  集客・告知戦略の最適化：  アプリ内告知や専用イベントページのクリエイティブ、公開タイミングをコントロールし、イベントごとの集客パフォーマンスを最大化させます。     3. イベントオペレーションの統括・品質管理 運営品質のモニタリング ： パートナーが実施する当日運営のフローがPairsの安全・安心基準を満たしているか管理し、必要に応じてオペレーションの改善提案を行います。  フィードバックループの構築 ： イベント後のアンケート結果やマッチングデータを分析し、次回開催に向けた改善策を提案。パートナーの「リピート開催」と「収益向上」を実現します。        ポジションの魅力: 新規事業のコアメンバー ： 2026年度のパートナーシップ始動期において、B2B2Cモデルの成功パターンを自ら作り上げる「0&rarr;1」の経験が積めます。   プラットフォームの圧倒的優位性 ： 国内最大級の会員基盤を背景とした「圧倒的な集客力」を武器に、パートナーへ高い付加価値を提供できます。   リアルな感動の創出 ： 自身のプランニングによって、実際にカップルが誕生する瞬間に立ち会える、社会的意義の大きい仕事です。   多様な業界とのアライアンス：  エンタメ、飲食、自治体など、幅広い業界のパートナーと深く関わり、事業開発視点でのサクセス経験を構築できます。       Basic Qualifications:     B2Bのカスタマーサクセス、アカウントマネジメント、または法人営業における3〜5年以上の経験。       イベントの企画・プロデュース、または店舗・施設の集客支援に関する実務経験。       パートナーの経営課題（集客、売上、認知）を理解し、データに基づいた論理的な提案ができる能力。       生成AI（ChatGPT等）を活用し、イベント企画案の作成や業務効率化を推進できるスキル。       日本語：ネイティブレベル（日本語の契約書の読み書きに不自由しないレベル必須）        Preferred Qualifications:     オンラインサービスとオフラインイベントを融合させたプロジェクトのマネジメント経験。       マッチングアプリやSNS業界に関する知識、または自身での利用経験。       SQLを用いたデータ分析、またはTableau等のBIツールの活用経験。       複数のステークホルダーを巻き込んだクロスファンクショナルなプロジェクトリード経験。     英語：ビジネスレベル（歓迎）      Characteristics:     パートナーの成功を自分の喜びと感じ、伴走できるホスピタリティと情熱をお持ちの方。       常に「なぜこのイベントが成功したのか/失敗したのか」を数字で考え、改善し続けられる方。       不確実な状況でも自ら動き、最適なオペレーションを型化できる仕組み化能力のある方。       誠実なコミュニケーションで、パートナーとの強固な信頼関係を築ける方。         #Eureka   .

title: Technical Engagement Manager
description: Company Overview   KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.   Job Description/Preferred Qualifications     Customer Engagement: Defines and executes customer specific product penetration, positioning, and market share strategies. Develops relationships with key customer technical buying influences and has a deep understanding of leading edge process and metrology technology.  Collaborates with the E-Beam Divisional Marketing and Engineering teams to position and deliver differentiated product value and resolve customer issues.  Works jointly with the BU and Service teams to execute PSA objectives.  Has a strong understanding of the customer sales cycle and process. Jointly develops sales strategies in collaboration with account managers. Knowledge and application of KLA sales processes (Value/People, SPIN, etc).  Able to mentor/coach engineers and can inspire and motivate team members.      Minimum Qualifications     Strong background in wafer process flow, Inspection/Metrology control, and E-Beam technology.  5 years IC/Fab experience with KLA tool knowledge (E-Beam or Metrology experience is preferred; defect/inspection is also considered).  Good Japanese/English interpersonal skills.  B.A./M.S. in an engineering/science-based field.  Good presentation and proficient in project management skill.  Good business acumen with understanding of customer technical issue with customer-focus.  Able to work under stress, full of energy to own the team and able to confront multi-level challenges.  Excellence in leadership and execution.  Deal with things proactively with accountability and insightfulness.      We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. title: Manager, Customer Success Management
description: MongoDB is looking for an experienced and results-oriented people leader to help grow our Customer Success program. You will play a key role in the growth and success of MongoDB, our customers and CS team members. Your team will be working directly with our customers, and you’ll help develop an outstanding program in one of its most exciting phases.  You will recruit and provide the coaching, mentoring and development that will enable both our high-touch and tech-touch Customer Success teams to positively impact customers, develop skills, and grow their careers over time. In addition to recruiting, retaining, and developing talent, you will also be responsible for crafting and executing initiatives to increase our customer retention and happiness, identify expansion opportunities, and promote customer adoption of MongoDB. description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     Consumer Protection Manager는 토스뱅크 소비자보호팀에 속해있어요.  토스뱅크 소비자보호팀은 은행의 혁신적인 상품과 서비스가 금융소비자보호법령 하에서 만들어지고 판매될 수 있게 하는 팀이에요.  금융소비자의 불편 사항을 담당 팀과 협의해 상품과 서비스의 고객 편의성을 배가하는 것에 앞장서요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요     소비자 민원을 직접 응대하며, 민원 내용에 관한 분석 수행과 개선점을 도출해요.  고객의 문제에 대한 적절한 대응 방향을 수립하고, 문제를 해결하기 위해 필요한 의사소통을 주도적으로 수행해요.  고객 상담 간 인지한 잠재적인 민원 요소를 조기에 해소해요.  상품 및 서비스 관련 고객의 의견을 수집하고, 서비스 개선 의견을 파악해 유관 부서에 전달해요.  고객응대근로자 보호, 문제행동소비자 대응, 금융취약계층 응대 등 임직원 교육을 기획·운영해요.  기타 리스크 상황에 대응하고, 문제가 발생하더라도 고객의 피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 서포트해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     금융업권에서의 커리어 경험을 통해 은행 및 금융 상품에 대한 이해도를 가지고 계신 분이 필요해요.  금융소비자보호법 등 관련 법령과 민원·분쟁조정 절차에 대한 이해를 갖추신 분이 필요해요.  민원 발생 시 상황을 신속히 파악하고 적절한 상담을 제공할 수 있는 문제해결 역량과 커뮤니케이션 스킬이 필요해요.  감독기관 회신문, 보고서, 품의문 등 공식 문서를 정확하고 논리적으로 작성할 수 있는 문서 작성 역량이 필요해요.  리스크 상황에 대응하여 적절한 조치를 취할 수 있는 위기 대응 능력이 필요해요.  문제를 해결함에 있어 유관부서와의 의사결정 과정을 주도적으로 이끌어갈 수 있는 협업 능력이 필요해요.  민원 응대에 대한 교육 등 도급사 운영/관리에 관한 업무 경험을 가지고 계신다면 더 좋아요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     기존 회사에서 해왔던 업무를 시계열로 작성하기보다는, 지원한 팀의 JD 기준으로 경험에 관한 내용을 구체적으로 기술해주시면 도움이 돼요.  해왔던 업무의 나열 및 성과도 중요하지만, 그 업무를 시작하게 된 배경 및 궁극적인 목적이 무엇이었는지 궁금해요.  본인이 담당했던 민원 및 해결 사례를 상세하게 소개해주시면 좋아요.       토스뱅크로의 합류 여정     서류 접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종합격 및 입사

title: Marketing Manager - Automotive
description: The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to strengthen the company’s automotive brand, increase vehicle sales and aftersales business, generate qualified leads, and enhance customer engagement. The role will oversee digital and traditional marketing activities, campaigns, events, promotions, brand communications, and marketing performance.    Key Responsibilities   1. Monitor social media engagement, customer feedback, reviews, and online reputation. Market Research & Competitor Analysis  Conduct regular market research on automotive trends, customer behavior, pricing

title: Gruppchef till avdelningen Studera och ställa om
description: Vi söker nu en gruppchef till avdelningen Studera och ställa om med placering i Kalmar. Du kommer tillsammans ett antal gruppchefer och en enhetschef att ingå i enhetsledningen för enheten Studiemedel 1.  Uppdraget innebär att du jobbar med uppföljning, utformar effektiva arbetssätt samt säkerställer en god arbetsmiljö och kompetensutveckling. Som gruppchef ansvarar du för att din verksamhet är en aktiv del av helheten och har ett arbetssätt som matchar kundens behov.  Rollen innebär att du, utifrån uppsatta riktlinjer, policys samt strategier och mål, utvecklar och driver verksamheten på ett rättssäkert sätt samt engagerar, motiverar, utvecklar och skapar förutsättningar för dina medarbetare så att verksamheten når CSN:s uppsatta vision och inriktningar.   Som Chef Och Ledare På CSN Kommer Du Att     Företräda myndigheten som arbetsgivare och ansvara för att uppdraget utförs i enlighet med styrningen från riksdag och regering samt den internt beslutade styrningen  Med ett nära och tillitsbaserat ledarskap planera, följa upp och kommunicera uppdraget för att nå önskade resultat  Skapa goda relationer som präglas av en öppen, tillitsfull och tydlig dialog  Arbeta aktivt för en god arbetsmiljö  Hålla individuella samtal, medarbetarsamtal och genomföra lönerevision för gruppen  Arbeta aktivt för att medarbetarna har rätt kompetens  Hantera rehabiliteringsärenden  Utveckla dynamiken i gruppen för att få gruppen jobbar bra tillsammans  Utveckla verksamheten genom ständiga förbättringar  Bidra till att enhetsledningen levererar och når uppsatta mål.     Kvalifikationer     Du Har     Akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant.  Minst 3 års aktuell erfarenhet som chef med personalansvar inom handläggande kundserviceverksamhet.  Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift  Goda kunskaper i engelska tal och skrift  God vana av MS-office (företrädesvis Word, Excel, Outlook och PowerPoint).     Meriterande Är     Ledarskapsutbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer är relevant för tjänsten  Aktuell erfarenhet av arbete som chef inom offentlig eller privat verksamhet  Aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta med förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete i större organisationer.     Vi Söker Dig Som Har    Ett tryggt och engagerat ledarskap  präglar ditt sätt att leda, motivera och skapa delaktighet. Genom tydlighet och engagemang skapar du goda förutsättningar för andra att nå gemensamma mål och samordnar arbetet på ett strukturerat sätt.   Trygghet, stabilitet och personlig mognad  är viktiga delar i ditt förhållningssätt. God självinsikt och förmåga att skilja mellan det personliga och det professionella bidrar till att du hanterar olika situationer på ett omdömesgillt och professionellt sätt.   Tydlig kommunikation  är en självklar del av ditt arbetssätt. Du säkerställer att budskap och förväntningar är klara för berörda parter och följer upp att det som beslutats också genomförs. title: Senior Associate, Account Management – Pacific Islands

Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in account management, payments, and market development while working across a diverse portfolio of issuer and acquirer customers. Track account priorities and key initiatives to help ensure timely execution and delivery.   Build knowledge of the payments ecosystem, customer needs and market dynamics across the Pacific Islands.   Over time, take ownership of customer relationships through increasing customer exposure, commercial responsibility and relationship ownership.      All About You      You enjoy building relationships and are confident interacting with customers and stakeholders.   You bring energy, curiosity and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and help get things done.   Experience in account management, client services, consulting, commercial operations or a related business function. title: Client Support Specialist
description: Job Summary    Location : Barcelona, Spain (hybrid)   Division : Ticketmaster Spain   Line Manager : Client Support Lead   Contract Terms : Permanent, Full-Time   THE TEAM   Global Client Support & Operations Organisation has the mission to build a global support & operations centre of excellence where all processes, tools & best practices are applied to all regions across the globe in order to achieve the highest levels of employee, fan & client satisfaction. Our clients demand and value high service levels and we believe our people are the foundation to deliver great service. We are fortunate to have the most experienced and skilled operations experts on the field around the globe, regionally and locally, that have a deep understanding of our clients’ needs.  We continuously invest in people development and promote wide collaboration and team spirit to leverage our knowledge and experience to excel in client satisfaction. Mastering our knowledge on our ticketing products is also key in improving our service proposition and solving for our clients’ and local Markets’ needs and challenges day-to-day.   THE JOB   As a Client Support Specialist, within the Client Support Team for the Spanish market, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality services that meet the day-to-day operational needs of clients, including event organisers and promoters, rely on your expertise to effectively use Ticketmaster’s ticketing systems and products throughout the entire lifecycle of their events. You will act as a key liaison between multiple internal departments, ensuring that clients experience a seamless and consistent service throughout the duration of their contract.  As the primary support contact for your assigned clients, you will work closely with them to continuously improve service levels, optimise sales performance, and enhance overall client satisfaction. You will be accountable for maintaining agreed service levels and delivering operational support, including training, sharing best practices, and managing system installations and upgrades.  Your role will also involve leveraging your knowledge of Ticketmaster products and processes to provide consultancy services, helping clients define solutions that meet their operational needs. You will coordinate these efforts with other functional experts across Ticketmaster, including Product Operations, Event Delivery, Sales, Fan Support, Finance, and Marketing.   What You Will Be Doing    Client Service      Provide front-line support to a portfolio of clients, ranging from moderate to high impact.  Collaborate closely with the Sales team to understand operational needs of both existing and prospective clients.  Lead the onboarding process for new clients and ensure ongoing operational maintenance.  Manage the full operational lifecycle of client events, ensuring smooth execution.  Build and maintain strong client relationships through personalised and proactive support.  Ensure se

title: Commercial Parts & Services Manager
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.   Sæt den kommercielle retning for vores Parts & Services-forretning   Vil du stå i spidsen for udviklingen af reservedele, serviceydelser, servicekontrakter og connected services hos Volvo Trucks Danmark? Vi søger en kommercielt stærk leder, der kan omsætte strategi og markedsindsigt til vækst, lønsomhed og værdi for kunder og forhandlernetværk.  Du får base på vores hovedkontor i Taastrup, refererer til Service Market & Retail Director og får ledelsesansvar for medarbejdere inden for Parts Offer, Service Contracts og Technical Service Agreements. Der må forventes rejseaktivitet i både Danmark og udlandet.   Din rolle   Som Commercial Parts & Services Manager får du det samlede kommercielle og ledelsesmæssige ansvar for Parts & Services Business Excellence. Du får ansvaret for at drive den kommercielle udvikling af et af Volvo Trucks Danmarks vigtigste forretningsområder og sikre fortsat vækst og lønsomhed på tværs af produkter, services og kontraktforretning.  Du sætter retningen, driver eksekveringen og udvikler forretningen, teamet og forhandlernetværkets kommercielle performance.    Udarbejde og gennemføre den kommercielle strategi for reservedele, serviceydelser og servicekontrakter  Drive vækst, øge markedspenetrationen og sikre lønsomhed  Eje og udvikle Volvo Trucks Danmarks service-, kontrakt- og connected services-portefølje samt drive udviklingen af nye kommercielle serviceydelser og løsninger.  Følge op på budget, forecast, KPI’er og handlingsplaner  Styrke forhandlernetværkets kommercielle performance og vækst gennem tæt dialog, løbende opfølgning, analyser, og sparring  Lede og udvikle dit team og sikre stærkt tværgående samarbejde     Hvem er du?   Du kombinerer stærk forretningsforståelse med dokumenteret ledelseserfaring. Du kan arbejde strategisk og analytisk, men trives også tæt på den operationelle forretning, hvor planer skal omsættes til resultater.    Erfaring fra servicemarkedet, aftermarket eller et tilsvarende forretningsområde  Indsigt i reservedele, servicekontrakter eller kommercielle serviceprodukter  Dokumenterede resultater inden for vækst og forretningsudvikling  Erfaring med budgettering, forecast, porteføljestyring og kommercielle KPI’er  Evne til at skabe følgeskab, udvikle medarbejdere og drive implementering gennem andre  Kommunikerer sikkert på både dansk og engelsk     Hvorfor Volvo?   Hos Volvo Trucks Danmark bliver du en del af et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med åben dialog, høj faglighed og fokus på udvikling. Du får en central lederrolle med stor forretningsmæssig indflydelse, stærke kolleger i Danmark og internationalt samt en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke inklusive pension og sund

title: Solutions Director Global Key Accounts

title: Project Manager
description: Want to deliver a seamless onboarding for some of the Nordics' largest commerce players?        Omnium develops a 100% cloud-based Order Management System (OMS) that helps businesses consolidate and handle orders from all sales channels – e-commerce, customer service, POS systems and more. The platform simplifies complex processes and enables seamless, efficient shopping experiences across channels.       We like to call ourselves a start-up with several years of experience. With some of the Nordics' largest retail and brand players in our customer portfolio and a rapidly growing market, we're heading into an exciting phase. At Omnium we know onboarding is a critical stage — it's where the foundation for long-term partnership, value realisation and customer success is established.        We're now looking for a structured and confident project manager who will take clear ownership of our onboarding projects and make sure customers get a solid, professional start with Omnium.       The role    As Onboarding Project Manager you'll own the coordination and delivery of the entire onboarding process for our customers. This is a key role that requires close collaboration with customers, partners and internal teams. You'll be the face of Omnium during implementation, and you'll make sure projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.    Onboarding is where our customers' commerce operations meet our platform — orders, inventory, fulfilment, returns, payments and the flows between channels. Running these projects well means understanding how each customer actually operates, so you can ask the right questions early and keep the project on track when reality differs from the plan.    Here's what you'll do:     Lead onboarding projects:   Coordinate and drive the full onboarding process, from kick-off to successful implementation, following up timelines, milestones and deliverables to keep projects moving    Be the link between everyone involved:   Act as the main point of contact between customer, partners and internal teams, making sure communication is clear and expectations are aligned    Own risk and quality:   Identify risk areas early and put the right measures in place, so the customer experiences a seamless transition into using Omnium    Keep financial control:   Follow up time tracking and invoicing for your projects to ensure transparency and predictability        We're looking for someone who has:     Solid experience as a project manager, preferably from IT projects or technically complex projects    Experience with B2B SaaS or similar technology products    Experience from retail or e-commerce    Fluent Norwegian, written and spoken. This is a firm requirement as a lot of customer dialogue, documentation and daily work happen in Norwegian. You also need to work comfortably in English.    A structured approach and a strong ability to follow up progress, timelines and deliverables    Strong communication skills and genuine enjoymen

title: Test and Release Manager
description: Bli vår nøkkelperson for kvalitet i D365 – vi ser etter en erfaren Test and Release Manager i Oslo.   Er du klar for å ta eierskap til kvalitet i noen av de mest komplekse D365-leveransene i markedet? Vi ser nå etter en erfaren D365 Test and Release Manager som vil lede både test- og releasearbeidet for våre norske kunder og bidra til å sikre kvalitet i hele leveranseløpet.  Som D365 Test and Release Manager i Columbus vil du ha et helhetlig ansvar for både test og release management i implementeringer, oppgraderinger og utrullinger av Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. Du vil jobbe tett med både kunder og interne leveransemiljøer, og være en sentral drivkraft for struktur, forutsigbarhet og kvalitet – fra utvikling til produksjon.  Dette er en senior rolle for deg som ønsker å kombinere strategisk ansvar med operativ gjennomføring – og som trives med å koordinere komplekse leveranser på tvers av team, teknologi og geografi.   Om rollen   Du vil være en integrert del av våre leveranser i Norge med base i Oslo, og jobbe med kunder innen blant annet finans, logistikk og produksjon. Prosjektene går typisk fra analysefase til go-live, og du vil ha ansvar for både test og release gjennom hele løpet.   Som Test And Release Manager Vil Du     Ha helhetlig ansvar for test og kvalitet i D365 F&O-prosjekter, fra strategi til gjennomføring og oppfølging  Definere testtilnærming, planer og kvalitetskriterier tilpasset prosjekt og kundebehov  Planlegge, koordinere og gjennomføre releaseprosesser frem mot produksjonssetting  Sikre gode og kontrollerte overganger mellom utvikling, test og produksjon  Lede og koordinere test- og leveranseteam på tvers av fagområder og lokasjoner  Følge opp fremdrift, risiko og kvalitet, og sikre tydelig og relevant rapportering til interessenter  Samarbeide tett med prosjektledelse, utvikling og forretning for å sikre gode leveranser  Bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring av test- og releaseprosesser, både hos kunde og internt     Hvem er du?   Vi ser etter deg som har erfaring med testledelse og/eller release management, og som motiveres av å ta eierskap til kvalitet og leveranse i komplekse prosjekter.  Samtidig ser vi etter deg som ønsker å være med å bygge opp og videreutvikle vårt fagmiljø og marked i Oslo. Du har mye engasjement, tar initiativ og jobber proaktivt i din tilnærming. Du trives med å arbeide selvstendig, men også med å bidra inn i team og miljø – og motiveres av å forme din egen rolle og utvikle deg videre i et sterkt faglig fellesskap. title: OFCI Manager
description: Overview   As an OFCI Manager at Linesight , you will work with highly experienced, culturally diverse, and passionate teams nurturing a strong social dynamic and a shared sense of achievement. You will gain vast industry experience that will open doors for you, extend your skillset and expand your perspective. We will empower, support, and enable you to take real responsibility in your role so that you can take charge of your career progression with us. For us lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.    The Opportunity      In this role you will:       Develop and provide a OFCI delivery strategy and drive stakeholder engagement in the implementation to deliver on all KPIs.    Support the delivery of a wide range of projects, work with Lead project PM and client to align vendor Equipment Schedule to overarching project schedule.    Engage with vendors at the early stage of equipment manufacturing and align required factory witness tests against milestones.    Work with appointed GC and specialist project subcontractors to ensure correct work methods and installation requirements are adhered to and ensure that appropriate method statements are in place and signed off by the relevant parties in advance of installation.    Manage all required paperwork and sign offs associated with all vendor equipment installation.    Engage with and advice the client design team on vendor equipment related elements.    Review with both the senior project manager and the program lead to ensure that all client specific requirements and deliverables are addressed.    Attend various FWT and FAT and have regular visits to off-site manufacturing plants to ensure quality control measures are implemented and inspect equipment prior to shipping.    Assist in preparation for meetings, chairing and recording all minutes.    Attend and monitor meetings and escalate any issues that may arise.    Implement project procedures and use reasonable endeavors to ensure that this procedure is always observed.    Assist in the change management process.    Assist in the implementation of all key project processes to support the project’s delivery and monitor these processes, reporting and making recommendations to the client team.    Take regular site walks to promote and observe safety and progress, report and track any corrective actions through to timely completion.    Conduct site inspections and obtain progress and quality reports.    Monitor site works, record, and report non-conforming work and drive the team for follow up, preventative and close out actions.    Assist in the review and assessment of proposed variations in the works and of any actual or anticipated delays to the progress of the works.    Assist in the handover plan, monitor, and track the preparation of documentation.    Coordinate with the client team, consultant team and the contractor on all snagging activities, including the schedule and stakeholder engagement.

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer (all genders) - Yocto · Python · IoT Edge
description:
This position sits close to the embedded world, but it isn't traditional microcontroller firmware work. You'll own the operating system foundation and platform layer of our IoT devices - building and evolving our next-generation embedded Linux image - and develop the Python application layer that runs on top of it, inside our dockerized main application.

You'll work down at the OS and hardware boundary while shipping features up in the application layer. Typical areas include:

  • Designing and maintaining our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM devices with limited compute

  • Security on device, inter-process communication, networking, scheduling, observation

  • Over-the-air (OTA) updates for both the OS and applications

  • Integrating peripherals - watchdog, modem, AI accelerator - and improving their observability

  • Bridging the system layer and the application layer through Python and Bash

The work spans from driver- and kernel-level integration in C/C++, to adapting our Linux distribution with Yocto to the underlying hardware layer, to debugging system-level failures such as memory leaks, up to writing the Python software that turns hardware capabilities into product features.

You will be expected to pass a live coding interview for this role.

What to expect

  • Embedded Linux Platform: Design, build, and continuously evolve the next generation of our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM-powered IoT

Most job ads are written by no one, for everyone. I want to do this differently.

title: Control System Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your role

You’ll shape how our robots move, sense, and respond, turning control theory into real-world performance

You’ll push existing products further and bring new prototypes to life with both state-of-the-art and experimental methods. In practice, that means: 

  • Exploring advanced algorithms, controllers, calibration, digital signal processing and finding what actually works on hardware
  • Implementing those algorithms in C++ and Python (and Matlab/Simulink when it fits)
  • Designing and running test benches that reveal true system performance
  • Building software for data acquisition and processing
  • Identifying dynamic system properties
  • Connecting the stack end to end: embedded firmware, middleware, backends, and analysis platforms
  • Hunting down and fixing interoperability issues across systems and devices


Your experience and qualifications

  • 3+ years as a control system engineer or mathematician

Wir bieten Privat- und Geschäftskunden ein umfangreiches Sortiment aus den Bereichen Heizung, Badezimmer, Klima, Pumpen uvm.   • Controlling und Reporting: Aufbau von Auswertungen, Kennzahlen und Planung, mit denen Geschäftsführung und Fachbereiche arbeiten
  • Liquiditätsplanung und rollierender Forecast als feste Routine
  • Working Capital Analyse, von Zahlungszielen bis zu den Kosten unserer Zahlungsanbieter
  • Ansprechpartner für das Management-Team in Finanzfragen
  • Ansprechpartner für unsere Lieferanten, etwa bei zurückgewiesenen Rechnungen, Kontenabstimmungen und sonstigem Abstimmungsbedarf
  • Klärung unklarer Rechnungen und Zahlungen sowie Analyse wiederkehrender Fehlerquellen, damit sie dauerhaft verschwinden
  • Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerkanzlei bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen sowie laufenden buchhalterischen Fragen

Qualifikation

  • Du bist als Student eingeschrieben, idealerweise in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Finance oder einem vergleichbaren Fach, und hast noch mindestens zwei Jahre Studium vor Dir.

Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen.

title: Quereinsteiger im Recruiting & Vertrieb (m/w/d)
description:
Jobbeschreibung

Quereinsteiger im Recruiting & Vertrieb (m/w/d)

Du hast in deinem jetzigen Job das Gefühl, unter deinen Möglichkeiten zu bleiben? Und du weißt: Wenn du mit Menschen arbeitest, läufst du zur Höchstform auf? Dann brauchst du keinen passenden Lebenslauf – du brauchst nur den Willen, neu anzufangen.

Viele unserer stärksten Leute kommen nicht aus der Personalbranche. Sie haben vorher im Einzelhandel beraten, in der Gastronomie unter Druck funktioniert, im Handwerk Kunden betreut oder am Telefon verkauft. Was sie mitbrachten, war kein Fachwissen, sondern Menschenverstand, Ausdauer und Lust auf Ergebnisse. Das Handwerkliche haben sie bei uns gelernt – und du kannst das auch.

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in Bielefeld. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, als Arbeitgeber wahrgenommen zu werden und verlässlich passende Bewerbungen zu bekommen. Weil Fachkräfte in fast jeder Branche knapp sind, wächst unser Markt Jahr für Jahr weiter – ein guter Zeitpunkt also, hier einzusteigen.

Warum ein Quereinstieg bei uns funktioniert

  • Wir bilden dich aus, statt dich ins Wasser zu werfen: Du startest mit einem strukturierten Onboarding, bekommst Schulungen zu Akquise, Beratung und Personalgewinnung und hast von Anfang an feste Feedbackgespräche.
  • Du lernst am echten Fall: Statt wochenlanger Theorie arbeitest du früh mit eigenen Kunden – begleitet, aber nicht bevormundet.
  • Der weitere Weg steht fest: Recruiter, danach Junior Consultant, danach Senior Consultant. Wie schnell du diese Stufen nimmst, entscheidest du.
  • Du baust zwei Kompetenzen gleichzeitig auf: Vertrieb und Recruiting. Diese Kombination ist am Arbeitsmarkt selten und macht dich unabhängig.

Das erwartet dich im Alltag

title: Senior Berater (w/m/d) – Intelligent Document Processing / Input Management
description:

IDP ist die nächste Generation des Input Managements und revolutioniert die Verarbeitung von Geschäftsdokumenten. Es nutzt fortschrittliche Technologien wie:

  • Künstliche Intelligenz (KI)
  • Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache (NLP)
  • Cloud Computing

IDP-Lösungen wandeln unstrukturierte Daten in strukturierte, verwertbare Informationen um. Sie können auch komplexe Dokumente identifizieren, klassifizieren, relevante Daten extrahieren und ermöglichen so einen höheren Automatisierungsgrad.

Unsere Anforderungen

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Digitalen Transformation mit ausgeprägtem IDP- bzw. IM Schwerpunkt
  • Erfahrung in der Technologieberatung, insbesondere mit Cloud-basierten IDP-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung in der Verantwortung von Inputmanagement-Projekten und Führung agiler Teams
  • Projektverantwortung und erfolgreiche Implementierungen von IDP-Systemen
  • Vorteilhaft: Erfahrung in der Versicherungs- oder Gesundheitsbranche

Deine verantworteten Themen

  • Beratung zu Cloud-basierten IDP-Plattformen und Archivlösungen
  • Aufzeigen von KI-Potenzialen im Inputmanagement
  • Planung und Durchführung von IDP-Kundenprojekten
  • Integration von IDP-Lösungen in bestehende Geschäftsprozesse
  • Begleitung von Veränderungsmaßnahmen im Inputmanagement

Dein neuer Arbeitsalltag

  • Du übst deine Tätigkeit in einem dezentral organisierten Unternehmen aus, das heißt, dein Hauptarbeitsplatz ist zu 80-90% dein Home-Office am Wohnsitz

description:
Arbeiten, wo Wohn- und Arbeitswelten zu Leidenschaft werden.

Seit vielen Jahren stehen wir als familiengeführtes Einrichtungsunternehmen für Interior-Design, exklusive Designermöbel und individuelle ganzheitliche Beratung auf höchstem Niveau.

Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der Innenarchitektur und hochwertigen Einrichtung, ob Business, In- oder Outdoor. Unser Anspruch ist es, unsere KundInnen dabei jederzeit in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Marketing-Teams suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Social Media nicht nur bespielt, sondern versteht, wie aus einer starken Marke relevanter Content entsteht, strategisch gedacht, hochwertig umgesetzt und nah an unseren unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen.

Aufgaben

  • Social Media weiterdenken: Du entwickelst unsere Social-Media-Präsenz für B2B- und B2C-Zielgruppen kontinuierlich weiter und übersetzt unsere Marke in relevante digitale Formate.
  • Content produzieren: Du entwickelst Ideen und setzt Social-Media-Content eigenständig um, von Text und Storytelling über Foto und Video bis hin zu wiederkehrenden Formaten.
  • Produktionen steuern: Du koordinierst Foto-, Video- und Grafikproduktionen und arbeitest dabei mit KollegInnen sowie externen Partnern zusammen.

title: AI Associate - Voice-Agents (m/w/d)
description:
Verändere, wie Unternehmen telefonieren.

Voice-Agents übernehmen heute schon echte Arbeit. Sie vereinbaren Termine, bearbeiten Anfragen und wickeln Prozesse ab, die tief in die Systeme unserer Kunden eingreifen. Bei Lane One bauen und betreiben wir genau das für den Mittelstand in Deutschland und Österreich, vor allem in Branchen, in denen ein verpasster Anruf bares Geld kostet.

**
Deine Rolle: Du machst aus Kundenanforderungen einen Agenten, der wirklich funktioniert.**

Du sitzt im Workshop beim Kunden, verstehst seine Prozesse und sein System of Record und übersetzt das anschließend in einen Voice-Agents auf unserer Plattform, der genau das kann, was gebraucht wird.

Aufgaben

Was du tust

  • Workshops leiten – Du führst Anforderungsworkshops mit Kunden durch, von der Geschäftsführung bis zur Fachabteilung, und erarbeitest gemeinsam, wie der Agent arbeiten soll.
  • Agenten bauen – Du entwickelst den Agenten auf unserer Plattform, integrierst ihn über Custom-MCP-Tools ins System des Kunden und testest ihn gründlich.
  • Kunden langfristig begleiten – Nach dem Go-Live bleibst du Ansprechpartner für Weiterentwicklung und Feintuning des Agenten.
  • Produkt mitgestalten – Du bringst Kundenfeedback strukturiert ins Team zurück, damit Plattform und Templates immer besser werden.

Qualifikation

Was dich auszeichnet

  • Strukturiertes Denken – Du übersetzt komplexe, oft unklare Kundenprozesse in klare, umsetzbare Logik.
  • Kommunikationsstärke – Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführern genauso sicher wie mit IT-Ansprechpartnern und erklärst technische Themen verständlich.
  • Genauigkeit – Ein Agent, der im Livebetrieb mit echten Anrufern spricht, muss sauber funktionieren und auch Edge-Cases abbilden.

Samenlevingszaken   Bij Samenlevingszaken maken we software waarmee gemeenten hun dienstverlening in het sociaal domein toekomstbestendig organiseren. Denk aan vraagstukken rond werk, inkomen en participatie. Met iSamenleving ondersteunen we de consulent, met iParticipatie de inwoner. Zo helpen we gemeenten om overzicht te houden en sneller te handelen, zodat inwoners de ondersteuning krijgen op de momenten die ertoe doen.      Jouw opdracht   Klantvertrouwen ontstaat niet door goede bedoelingen, maar door duidelijkheid. Door afspraken die helder zijn en resultaten die zichtbaar worden gehaald. Jij weet als eerste waar klanten vastlopen en waar meer mogelijk is, en vertaalt die signalen naar wat de organisatie moet oppakken. Daarmee stuur je op tevreden klanten die iedere keer opnieuw voor ons kiezen.     Concreet werk je aan:      Klantsucces: jij zorgt dat gemeenten hun doelen halen met onze software. Denk aan een inwoner die sneller weet of hij een uitkering krijgt, of een gemeente die eerder ziet wie hulp nodig heeft.  Adoptie: jij maakt adoptie een vast onderdeel van het klantcontact, en laat klanten zien wat er nog meer mogelijk is.  Servicemanagement: SLA's, rapportages en periodiek overleg. Jij maakt zichtbaar wat we leveren, en wat we van klanten nodig hebben om dat te kunnen.  Escalatiemanagement: als een gemeente vastloopt in haar eigen dienstverlening, sta jij vooraan. Niet alleen om het op te lossen, maar om de oorzaak weg te nemen.  Doorontwikkeling van je team: van meldingen afhandelen naar meedenken met klanten. Jij haalt het routinewerk eruit, onder meer met AI, en geeft je team de ruimte om zich inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen.  De operatie: je zit zelf bij gemeenten aan tafel en springt bij als het ergens vastloopt.       Positie in de organisatie   Als lid van ons managementteam geef je leiding aan een team van 6 fte, bestaande uit Customer Care specialisten, een Customer Success Manager en Functioneel Beheer. De unit telt zo'n 70 collega's. Je werkt intensief samen met Productmanagement, Professional Services, Sales en Development, en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Managing Director. Samenlevingszaken is onderdeel van PinkRoccade Local Government; met de kracht van het beursgenoteerde CSI en TSS achter ons combineren we de slagkracht van een grote organisatie met de wendbaarheid van het MKB.      Wat mag jij van ons verwachten?   Deze rol is nieuw. Customer Care krijgt een eigen plek in het managementteam. Wat er moet gebeuren is duidelijk. Hoe je dat aanpakt, bepaal jij.     Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:      Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week.  Een competitief vast salaris met een resultaatafh

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager

With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. description:
Über uns

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwasgrundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern

Unsere Technologie

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mitComputernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischerKommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuenGrößenordnung

Kurz gesagt, wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels unserer Graphenlösung

Strategiska bemötande- och tonalitetsfrågor ingår också i enhetens ansvarsområde, liksom övergripande samordning av extern samverkan.  Din placeringsort blir Sundbyberg, Uppsala, Örebro eller Linköping.  Enhetsledningen håller sina ledningsmöten i Sundbyberg och vi ser gärna att du kan delta på dessa på plats.  Vår verksamhet är i ständig utveckling och förändring. Vi har en gemensam syn på hur ledarskapet bidrar till det, hur vi når resultat och främjar en förändringskultur. Som chef och ledare hos oss är du med och driver utveckling av både verksamhet och ledarskap.   Om dig   För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss på Skatteverket behöver du vara lyhörd, tänka nytt och ta ansvar. I arbetet är gott omdöme och förståelse för rättssäkerhet och säkerhet viktigt. Du ska också leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy. title: Service Manager

Nel Hydrogen is looking for an experienced and collaborative Service Manager to lead our technical support and service team. In this role, you will oversee technical customer support, aftermarket activities, service deliveries, and the continuous improvement of service processes.  This is a great opportunity for a hands-on service leader who enjoys developing people, solving complex customer issues, and working across engineering, production, and sales to deliver professional and efficient support. If this resonates with you, this could be an exciting opportunity to help strengthen a customer-oriented service culture and contribute to growth within aftermarket and service.    Your New Role   Reporting to the Site Support Director, you will have overall responsibility for the company's technical support and service function. You will be responsible for high-quality technical support and service agreements, while contributing to aftermarket development, spare parts-related processes, and coordination with field service activities. Working closely with customers, partners, engineering, production, and sales, you will coordinate complex cases, handle escalations, and contribute to develop service concepts that increase customer value and profitability. Prioritize and coordinate complex technical cases and escalations. title: Key Account Manager | Mecenat
description: Flera av världens starkaste varumärken använder Mecenat som samarbetspartner för att erbjuda rabatter till våra medlemmar. Vi är en direkt försäljningskanal som kommunicerar till över 2,4 miljoner medlemmar i Sverige - fördelat på 1 miljon studenter, 1,2 miljoner alumner och 250 000 seniorer. Vi hjälper våra partners att driva försäljning, bygga varumärkeskännedom och skapa engagemang genom relevanta kommunikationsvägar.     Idag samarbetar vi med en mängd välkända varumärken inom olika branscher - däribland Lidl, Comviq, Apple, Google, ICA, Zalando, TV4, Adidas och Bokus. Läs mer på www.mecenat.com eller partner.mecenat.com för att se hur vi arbetar med våra partners.      Vi söker nu en affärsdriven Key Account Manager till vårt team på Lindholmen. Läs mer och ansök nedan.        Om rollen   I rollen kommer du att vara Mecenats ansikte utåt och arbeta med både etablerade B2B-kunder och nykundsbearbetning. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med större kundkonton och komplexa kundrelationer. Du ansvarar för inkommande förfrågningar samt för försäljnings- och kundutveckling, med målet att skapa långsiktiga, lönsamma och hållbara samarbeten.     Du har ett starkt affärsdriv och strävar kontinuerligt efter att utveckla kunden genom att proaktivt supporta och stötta utifrån deras behov. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att arbeta mot en ung och attraktiv målgrupp samt tillsammans med partners som har starka och välkända varumärken.  Tjänsten innebär 1–2 resor per månad, främst till Stockholm. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och resultatinriktat försäljningsteam bestående av 12 säljare och rapporterar direkt till Sales Team Lead. Du utgår ifrån vårt kontor på Lindholmen, Göteborg.       Vem söker vi?   Vi söker dig som är en driven och kreativ B2B-säljare med stark relationsbyggande förmåga och ett analytiskt affärstänk. Du har flera års erfarenhet av försäljning och affärsutveckling inom B2B, där kundfokus alltid är centralt i ditt arbete.     Som person har du en positiv framåtanda och trivs både med att utveckla befintliga kundrelationer och att identifiera och etablera nya kundsamarbeten. Du är förtroendeingivande, engagerad och trygg i din roll, vilket gör att kunder upplever dig som en långsiktig och pålitlig partner.     Du är självgående och affärsdriven samt motiveras av att driva affärer hela vägen i mål. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med digitala lösningar, e‑handel, mediebyråer eller affiliate-marknadsföring.      Eftergymnasial utbildning inom försäljning, ekonomi, marknadsföring eller motsvarande är meriterande. Du kommunicerar obehindrat i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska samt har god systemvana, framför allt inom Officepaketet och affärssystem generellt.      Vad kan Mecenat erbjuda dig?   Hos oss får du en nyckelroll i ett växande bolag med ett starkt erbjudande och möjlighet att arbeta med välkända varumärken som vill nå en ung och attraktiv målgrupp. Vår kultur präglas av delaktighet, transpare

title: Strategic Account Manager
description: Localisation : Lyon, France    Rémunération : 50-75 k€ + BSPCE (Stock Options)       À propos de nous   Chez Wavo, nous construisons le futur du financement de stocks. Pour les PME, le stock est à la fois une opportunité et une contrainte. Il immobilise de la trésorerie, freine la croissance et crée du risque. Les solutions de financement traditionnelles sont lentes, rigides et basées sur l’historique financier plutôt que sur le potentiel business en temps réel.  Nous adoptons une approche différente. Wavo achète et finance les stocks en amont, sans dette ni garantie personnelle. Les entreprises peuvent ainsi accélérer leur croissance, améliorer leur trésorerie et se concentrer sur leur développement, sans friction financière.  Nous avons levé 3,5M€ pour accélérer notre expansion et déployer notre modèle auprès de plus d’entreprises. Nous sommes soutenus par des investisseurs et des leaders du secteur qui nous donnent les moyens d’aller vite. Notre objectif est clair : devenir la référence du financement de stocks intégré en Europe.  Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons un Strategic Account Manager, pour accompagner nos clients de bout en bout et jouer un rôle central dans l’exécution et la qualité de notre modèle.      Ce que tu feras   En tant que Strategic Account Manager chez Wavo, tu prendras en charge la relation client dans la durée, depuis les premiers échanges jusqu’au suivi des financements dans le temps. Il s’agit d’un rôle central, au croisement du commercial, de l’analyse et de l’opérationnel.     Tu interviendras en amont sur la qualification des prospects, principalement issus de l’inbound. À travers des échanges structurés, tu chercheras à comprendre le business des entreprises, la nature de leurs produits, leur modèle économique et leur capacité à s’inscrire dans notre solution. Ton rôle sera d’évaluer si Wavo est pertinent pour eux, et dans quelles conditions.     Lorsque le dossier avance, tu travailleras sur l’analyse des données mises à disposition par le prospect afin de définir un périmètre finançable cohérent. Cela implique de comprendre la typologie des produits, leur rotation, leur valorisation et leur liquidité, afin de proposer un financement adapté et maîtrisé. Ce volet analytique est central dans le poste : il conditionne la qualité des décisions et la performance du modèle dans la durée.     Tu piloteras ensuite toute la phase d’onboarding et de contractualisation, en lien avec les équipes internes, jusqu’à la mise en place effective du financement. Une fois le financement activé, tu assureras un suivi régulier des clients : monitoring des ventes, ajustements éventuels du périmètre financé, anticipation des prochaines étapes et identification d’opportunités de refinancement.     Au quotidien, tu seras en contact avec des entreprises très différentes, issues de secteurs variés, avec des business models et des contraintes propres. Con casi 80 años de experiencia internacional, ofrecemos a las empresas una gama completa de soluciones: Seguro de Crédito, Información Comercial y Recobro de deudas, todo ello impulsado por una base de datos única, tecnología de vanguardia, innovación y un profundo conocimiento de la economía global.  Unirse a Coface significa formar parte de una organización internacional muy unida, donde tus ideas importan. Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje, colaboración e inclusión en la que asumirás responsabilidades y podrás ver el impacto de tus acciones.  Da forma al futuro del comercio internacional con nosotros. ¡Únete a nuestros Happeners!   Descripción del empleo   ¿Te apasiona construir relaciones sólidas con clientes y ayudarles a alcanzar sus objetivos?  ¿Tienes experiencia B2B en el sector financiero y buscas un nuevo reto profesional?  ¡Esta puede ser tu oportunidad!  Como  Account Manager , serás responsable de gestionar una cartera de clientes, asegurando su satisfacción, fidelización y crecimiento.  Tus principales funciones incluirán:    Implementar la estrategia y los estándares de gestión de las relaciones con clientes según las directrices del grupo, teniendo en cuenta las especificidades locales, y proponiendo las adaptaciones más adecuadas a la necesidad de incrementar eficiencia, flexibilidad y equilibrar el nivel de servicio a la rentabilidad esperada por cliente.   Velar porque los requerimientos de los clientes sean atendidos oportunamente, negociando y definiendo alternativas de solución, en equilibrio con los recursos a proporcionar según el segmento al que pertenecen.   Realizar los actos de atención diaria a los clientes: explicaciones de decisiones de riesgos, aclaraciones respecto a la facturación, funcionamiento del contrato en general, y mantenimiento del mismo.   Llevar a cabo diversas acciones de seguimiento de los contratos.   Controlar la implementación, información y correcta ejecución de la estrategia y estándares definidos por el Customer Journey.   Revisar periódicamente los expedientes de cada cliente según el calendario de mantenimiento.   Realizar el control y seguimiento de los informes correspondientes en el CRM.   Preparar y negociar las renovaciones de contratos.      Requisitos     Formación: preferentemente Administración de Empresas – Económicas o similar.   Experiencia mínima de 4 años en gestión de clientes, desarrollo de negocio o Account Management en entornos B2B. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en el sector del seguro de crédito y en posiciones relacionadas con la gestión del riesgo comercial.   Orientación al cliente: Te motiva ofrecer un servicio

title: Teamlead Customer Management P&C Privatkunden (all genders)
description: 80-100% in Winterthur / Smart Working   Gestalte deine Zukunft – gemeinsam mit uns!   Als  Teamlead Customer Management P&C Privatkunden  übernimmst du die operative und personelle Führung des P&C-Privatkunden-Teams und sorgst für eine wirkungsvolle Marktbearbeitung und kundenorientierte Angebotsentwicklungen über alle P&C P Branchen. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team kreierst du auf der Basis eines datenbasierten Kunden- und Marktverständnisses differenzierende Value Propositions & Angebote und vermarktest diese aktiv mit dem Ziel, profitables Wachstum zu stärken.  Dein Fokus liegt auf der konkreten Umsetzung der P&C-Themen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit allen Marketing-Teams, dem Produktmanagement und Vertrieb.  Im Bereich  Customer Experience & Strategy  engagieren wir uns tagtäglich mit viel Herzblut dafür, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden genauso begeistert von der AXA sind wie wir selbst. Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, entwickeln wir unsere Produkte und Strategien ständig weiter. Wir erarbeiten innovative, inspirierende Lösungen – und präsentieren diese einfach und verständlich unseren Kundinnen und Kunden, unseren Mitarbeitenden und unseren Partnern sowie Medienschaffenden.   Das erwartet dich     Leadership: Du führst, coachst und entwickelst die Mitarbeitenden im Team Customer Management Privatkunden P&C P und übernimmst den Umsetzungslead durch klare Priorisierung und Ressourcenplanung der laufenden P&C-Themen.  Marktbearbeitung: Du stellst die Umsetzung von wachstumsorientierten Marktbearbeitung P&C P inkl. Weiterentwicklung der Marktbearbeitungsmassnahmen.  Segmentsbearbeitung: Du entwickelst und koordinierst die Segmentsbearbeitung für P&C Privatkunden.  Angebotsentwicklung: Du stellst die kunden- und marktorientierte Angebotsentwicklung im P&C-Privatkundensegment sicher.  Projektlead: Du übernimmst den Lead in Projekten und Arbeitsgruppen zu Angeboten, Kundenprozessen und Marktbearbeitung.     Das bringst du mit     Ausbildung: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Fach- oder Hochschulstudium in BWL, VWL, Marketing, Natur- oder Sozialwissenschaften.  Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung mit und hast damit ein möglichst breites Verständnis in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche:   P&C-Privatkunden-Geschäft (Produkte, Systeme, Prozesse)  Marktbearbeitungsinstrumente und -kanäle  Customer Centric Design (in Angebots-, Service- oder Prozessentwicklung)  Sales Funnel / Vertrieb (AD- und Online-Verständnis)  Unternehmergeist: Du hast einen hohen unternehmerischen Drive, eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und übernimmst Verantwortung über deinen eigenen Bereich hinaus.  Organisationstalent: Du zeichnest dich durch starkes Organisations- und Priorisierungstalent aus – auch bei vielen parallelen Themen.  Kommunikation: Du kannst Menschen auf allen Hierarchiestufen begeistern und überzeugen, unter anderem dank gutem Storytelling.  Analytisch & konzeptionell: Du denks

title: VIP Excellence Manager
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a VIP Excellence Manager based in Switzerland.   This role focuses on maximizing the performance, retention, and development of a high-value VIP customer portfolio within a fast-moving international iGaming environment.  You will combine customer activity analysis, operational oversight, product expertise, and data-driven decision-making to identify growth opportunities.  Working across regions, you will monitor top players, identify behavioral trends and anomalies, and ensure timely coordination with local teams.  The position offers broad exposure to Product, Analytics, Operations, and regional stakeholders, with a direct influence on VIP customer experience.  You will also leverage AI tools and new technologies to strengthen monitoring, automate analysis, and develop more effective VIP strategies.  The role requires strong analytical judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to respond quickly when regional teams need additional support.  It is well suited to an experienced VIP professional who enjoys autonomy, continuous improvement, and solving complex operational challenges. Track high-value players closely and maintain prompt communication with regional teams regarding their activity, status, and development. Develop approaches, mechanics, and initiatives designed to grow VIP activity and increase the number of high-value players integrated into regional teams.   Prepare recurring analytics, reports, and summaries covering the behavior and performance of top VIP clients.   Identify anomalies, deviations, and potential risks in VIP gaming activity, including indicators associated with fraudulent behavior.   Apply AI-powered tools to deepen analysis, automate monitoring, improve operational efficiency, and uncover new approaches to VIP portfolio development.   Monitor the quality and effectiveness of the VIP product, identifying customer experience issues and opportunities for product improvement.   Collaborate with Product, Analytics, Operations, and regional teams on VIP product development and customer experience initiatives.   Handle ad-hoc VIP priorities, including urgent OSINT research, customer calls, migrations, data summaries, and temporary regional coverage.   Provide rapid operational support to regions requiring additional VIP expertise or temporary coverage.   Identify, evaluate, and implement new tools, approaches, and practices that can improve the effectiveness of VIP operations. title: Regional Customer Service Manager (Based in Yokohama)
description: About Agoda   At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.  Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.  No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.   Get to Know our Team:   Agoda’s Customer Support Team understands that travel can be an everchanging environment. That is why we provide in-person, real-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly, doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer experience.  We quickly adapt to challenges by collaborating with other teams and experimenting on everything we can. This has allowed us to develop new and effective products that produce meaningful results and continue to drive Agoda’s business performance. Our Customer Support Team serves a daily role in contributing to the core strength and service of Agoda with a clear vision and a focus on efficient and satisfying customer support.  This role is responsible for leading the customer service teams supporting Japanese Language as they provide support to customers across voice, email, chat, and back-office activities.  The Manager of Customer Experience Group provides vision, leadership, and guidance to each team leader and associates in the key operating areas through performance and goal setting. Effectively communicates with the team, developing a climate in which information is shared openly. Clearly defines team goals and expectations. Develops tactical plans to reach these goals.  This role requires a high level of personal and professional skills associated with running global operations teams. First and foremost, this is a people leader role and enabling local teams to be successful is core to the role.  In addition to being a brilliant people leader and communicator, the ideal candidate will bring a vision, a sense of curiosity, a passion for travel, keen analytical skills, a tech-centric mindset, and a willingness to lead by example. This position will report to the Head of Customer Service Delivery.
